title: Why Your Crypto Payment Shows Underpaid (and How to Fix It)
summary: Seen an underpaid message? Price movement, fees deducted by an exchange or a typo can leave a payment short. Here is how to resolve it.
body:
An underpaid status means we found a transfer to our wallet that is smaller than your order total. It is a common message and it is usually easy to fix, but it can be worrying if you are not sure what it means. At One Stop Vape Store, the system compares the dollar value of the transfer it finds with the total of your order, allowing a small tolerance for normal price movement. If the transfer is clearly short, the order is marked underpaid and the status page shows the amount we received. This guide explains the common causes, how we decide, exactly how to fix it step by step, how to avoid it next time, what to do if you overpaid and how it differs from other problems. It is written for adults aged 21 and over and is not financial advice.

## What underpaid means
Underpaid means a matching transfer exists but its value is below your total by more than the tolerance. It does not mean your payment was lost, and it does not mean you did anything wrong in a serious way. It means the amount that arrived is not enough yet. Your order is not cancelled, and the transfer is held against it while you complete the balance. The status page shows the received amount so you can see exactly how much is missing.

## Common causes
- **Exchange fee deducted:** some exchanges subtract their withdrawal fee from the amount, so less arrives than you entered. This is the most common cause.
- **Price movement:** a volatile coin can drop between the quote and your transfer, so the dollar value of what you sent is lower than your total.
- **Rounding or a typo:** a missing digit in the amount, or rounding down to a neat number.
- **Partial payment:** you meant to pay in two parts, or sent only one of two planned transfers.
- **Stale quote:** you left the payment window open for a long time and used an old amount instead of refreshing.
- **Wrong amount copied:** you copied the wrong figure, for example the dollar total instead of the coin amount.

## How we decide
We compare the dollar value of the received transfer to your order total, allowing a small tolerance for normal movement between the quote and the confirmation. The value is calculated at a market rate for the coin at the time. Anything clearly short is marked underpaid, and the status page shows the amount we received. We also check the other conditions: the right network and address, the right token, a recent time and a transaction that has not paid another order. See [how we detect your crypto payment](/blog/how-we-detect-your-crypto-payment/).

## How to fix it, step by step
1. **Check the received amount** on your status page. It shows how much we found.
2. **Work out the missing balance** in dollars, and convert it to the coin you are using, using the current quote in a fresh payment window if needed.
3. **Send the missing balance** to the same address and network you used for the first payment.
4. **Add the new transaction hash** on the status page and press "I have paid", or upload a screenshot of the second transfer.
5. **If you are unsure,** contact us from the [contact page](/contact/) with your order reference and both transaction hashes. We will tell you the exact balance and confirm when both transfers are matched.

Please do not resend the whole amount. Sending the full amount again would overpay the order, and while we can review an overpayment, it is simpler and cheaper to send only the difference.

## Why it happens so often with exchanges
Exchanges commonly deduct their withdrawal fee from the amount you enter. For example, if you enter 100 USDT and the fee is 1 USDT, only 99 arrives. The payment is 1% short, and since that is more than a tiny tolerance, it shows as underpaid. The fix next time is to add the fee on top: enter 101 so that 100 arrives. Read [sending crypto from an exchange to a wallet](/blog/send-crypto-from-an-exchange-to-a-wallet/) for a walkthrough, and [crypto network fees explained](/blog/crypto-network-fees-explained/) for how fees work.

## Avoiding it
- **Use stablecoins** such as [USDT](/blog/usdt-erc20-vs-trc20-which-network/) or [USDC](/blog/pay-with-usdc-on-solana/) for exact amounts, because the price does not move.
- **Add the exchange withdrawal fee on top** if it is deducted from the amount.
- **Send soon after the quote loads,** and refresh the window if it has been open a while.
- **Copy the amount** with the copy button instead of typing it.
- **Check the amount** on the final send screen before you confirm.
- **Send one transaction** for the full amount, not several.

## Overpaid?
If you sent more than needed, tell us. We will review it and let you know how it can be handled. We do not automatically refund an overpayment, because it depends on the size of the difference and the coin, and we will explain the options clearly. The simplest approach is to avoid overpaying by sending the amount shown.

## How underpaid differs from other problems
- **Waiting:** no matching transfer yet. Check your wallet and the network.
- **Detected:** a transfer is visible but not fully confirmed. Wait a few minutes.
- **Underpaid:** a transfer exists but it is short.
- **Wrong network or token:** the funds may not have arrived at our address at all. See [sent crypto on the wrong network](/blog/sent-crypto-on-the-wrong-network/).

Knowing which state you are in saves time, because the fixes are different.

## A worked example
Suppose your order total after the 10% discount is $162.00 and you pay in USDT. The window shows 162 USDT. Your exchange deducts a 1.5 USDT fee from what you enter, and you enter 162. Only 160.5 arrives. The status page shows underpaid with a received amount of 160.5, so the balance is 1.5 USDT. You send 1.5 USDT, plus the exchange fee if it applies, to the same address and network, add the new transaction hash and press "I have paid". We match both transfers to your order and confirm it.

## Frequently asked questions in depth
### Is a very small shortfall a problem?
A tiny difference caused by normal market movement is tolerated. A larger shortfall is marked underpaid.

### Do I need to wait for you before sending the balance?
You can send the balance straight away if you know the amount, and tell us. If you are unsure, contact us first so we confirm the exact figure.

### Will my order be cancelled?
No, not simply because it is underpaid. Unpaid or underpaid orders may eventually be released if no further payment arrives, so complete the balance promptly or contact us.

### Can I switch to a different payment method for the balance?
Please contact us. We can advise on the simplest way to complete the order.

## After your payment is confirmed
Once your payment is confirmed you receive an email, and your order status changes to payment confirmed. The order then enters processing, which takes 24 to 72 business hours at our Phoenix, Arizona Stock Warehouse. When it ships, you receive a tracking email, and a regional carrier delivers it. An adult aged 21 or older must sign on delivery and may be asked to show photo ID, so choose an address where that is possible. You can follow every stage from the private link in your order email, and the meaning of each status is explained in [order status meanings](/blog/order-status-meanings/). Read [shipping times from Phoenix, Arizona](/blog/shipping-times-from-phoenix-arizona/) and [adult signature on delivery](/blog/adult-signature-on-delivery-what-to-expect/) to prepare. All products are for adults aged 21 and over, and nicotine is addictive.

## Reading the status page
The status page shows your order total, the amount received and the remaining balance in a simple layout. If the received amount is zero, no matching transfer has been found yet, which is a different state from underpaid. If the received amount is positive but below the total, the page shows underpaid and the difference. If the received amount equals or exceeds the total within tolerance, the page shows detected or confirmed. Reading these three figures tells you immediately what to do next, and it is worth checking them before you contact us, because the answer is often visible right there.

## Why we allow a tolerance at all
Crypto prices can move in the seconds between when the window shows a quote and when your transfer is confirmed. A strict match to the cent would reject honest payments that were correct when sent. The tolerance is deliberately small, so it does not let meaningful shortfalls through, but it prevents trivial movement from causing trouble. That balance keeps matching fair for you and accurate for us.

## What not to do
Do not send random small amounts hoping they will tip the order over the line, because each transfer is matched separately and extra transfers create more to reconcile. Do not send the balance to a new address, because only the address in your payment window is watched for your order. Do not change networks for the balance, because a different network means a different address and a different matching process. And do not wait silently: if you are unsure, contact us, because a short message with your order reference and the transaction hash usually resolves it within the same day during business hours.

faq.q: What does underpaid mean?
faq.a: We found a transfer that is smaller than your order total by more than the tolerance. The order is not cancelled, and the status page shows what we received.

faq.q: What is the most common cause?
faq.a: An exchange deducting its withdrawal fee from the amount, so less arrives than you entered.

faq.q: How do I fix it?
faq.a: Send the missing balance to the same address and network, add the new transaction hash on the status page and press I have paid, or contact us with your order reference.

faq.q: Should I resend the whole amount?
faq.a: No. Send only the difference. Resending the full amount would overpay the order.

faq.q: What if I overpaid?
faq.a: Tell us. We will review it and explain how it can be handled.

faq.q: How do I avoid it?
faq.a: Use stablecoins for exact amounts, add exchange fees on top, copy the amount with the copy button and refresh the window if it has been open a while.

title: Paying With Cash App: How Our Payment Details Process Works
summary: Choose Cash App at checkout and we send you the payment details. Learn each step, from placing the order to uploading your receipt.
body:
Cash App is one of the payment options at One Stop Vape Store. It works differently from cryptocurrency: instead of showing payment details in a window at checkout, we send them to you after you place the order, so they are always current and tied to your order. This guide explains each step from checkout to confirmation, what the emails and the payment page contain, how to avoid the mistakes that slow orders down, what to do if something goes wrong and how Cash App compares with other methods. It is for adults aged 21 and over.

## Why Cash App details arrive after you order
Cash App payments need a recipient handle, called a $Cashtag, and an exact amount. We send those after you order for three reasons. First, the details are matched to your specific order, so the amount is right. Second, we can confirm stock and pricing before you pay. Third, it protects you from out-of-date or copied details, because payment instructions only come from our official email, WhatsApp number or private order page.

## Step 1: place your order
Add products to your cart and go to checkout. Choose options such as strength and pack size on the product page first so they appear in your cart. At checkout, enter your contact and shipping details, confirm you are 21 or older, choose Cash App as the payment method and place the order. We need your email and phone number so we can reach you. The minimum order is $100, and orders of $200 or more after discounts ship free; smaller orders pay a flat $15 shipping fee. Your order is saved with the status "awaiting payment", and you receive an order number.

Cash App does not carry the 10% discount that cryptocurrency and gift cards do. If saving matters, compare options in [payment methods compared](/blog/payment-methods-compared/).

## Step 2: wait for our message
We email you the Cash App payment details, usually within minutes during business hours. If WhatsApp is easier for you, we can send them there as well; see [ordering via WhatsApp](/blog/ordering-via-whatsapp/). The thank-you page after checkout tells you to watch your inbox, and the email contains your order number, the amount due and a link to your private payment page.

If the message has not arrived after a short wait, check your spam or promotions folder and confirm the email address you entered. Our guide to [order confirmation emails not arriving](/blog/order-confirmation-email-not-arriving/) lists the common causes.

## Step 3: open the payment page
Our email links to a private page where every detail has its own tap-to-copy button. Email programs cannot run copy buttons, which is why the page exists. You will see the $Cashtag, the exact amount to pay and the note to include. The link contains a unique token, so only someone who has the link can open the page. Do not share it. Read [how payment details reach you](/blog/how-payment-details-reach-you/) for how the email, WhatsApp message and page fit together.

## Step 4: pay in the Cash App
Open the Cash App, choose Pay, enter the $Cashtag exactly as shown, enter the exact amount and add your order ID in the note field. Typing the order ID in the note is what lets us match the payment to the right order quickly. Review the recipient name and amount on the confirmation screen before you send, then confirm.

Pay the exact amount shown. If you round up or down, we may need to contact you, which delays the order. If your Cash App balance is low, add money from your linked bank first so the payment does not fail.

## Step 5: upload your receipt
After paying, use the link in the email to open your payment page and upload a screenshot of the Cash App confirmation. The screenshot should show the amount, the recipient and the time. This tells us a payment is on its way and speeds up the check. See [how to upload a payment screenshot](/blog/how-to-upload-a-payment-screenshot/) for what makes a good screenshot. Keep the confirmation screen open until you have uploaded it.

## Step 6: we confirm and ship
When we confirm the payment, you receive another email and your order status changes to payment confirmed. Orders ship once payment is confirmed. We process orders within 24 to 72 business hours at our Phoenix, Arizona Stock Warehouse and ship with tracking by a regional carrier. An adult aged 21 or older must sign on delivery. See [shipping times from Phoenix, Arizona](/blog/shipping-times-from-phoenix-arizona/) and [adult signature on delivery](/blog/adult-signature-on-delivery-what-to-expect/). You can follow every stage in [order status meanings](/blog/order-status-meanings/).

## Tips for a smooth Cash App order
- **Pay within 24 hours.** Unpaid orders may be released so stock is not held indefinitely.
- **Use the exact amount.** It makes matching immediate.
- **Add the order ID.** Put it in the note every time.
- **Keep the screenshot.** Upload it as soon as you pay.
- **Use only our official details.** Never pay to a handle sent by someone who contacted you unexpectedly.
- **Check the recipient name.** If it does not look right, stop and contact us.

## If something goes wrong
### The payment failed
Cash App can decline a payment for a low balance, a bank issue or a security check. Fix the cause in the app and try again, and let us know through the [contact page](/contact/) if you are unsure whether it went through.

### I paid the wrong amount
Tell us your order number and the amount you sent. If you overpaid, we will let you know how it is resolved. If you underpaid, we will tell you the balance and how to send it.

### I sent it to the wrong handle
Contact Cash App support immediately, because we cannot reverse payments sent elsewhere. Then contact us with your order number so we can help with the next step.

### I cannot find the email
Check spam, check the address on your order and then contact us with your order number. See [how to contact support](/blog/how-to-contact-support/).

## Refunds and returns
If a refund is ever due, it goes back through the payment method the payment was received through, which here means Cash App. Our returns policy allows returns within 30 days for unopened items in original packaging, less a 15% restocking fee, and opened or used items cannot be returned. See [refund and return policy explained](/blog/refund-and-return-policy-explained/).

## Alternatives
If you prefer a different method, you can pay with [Apple Pay](/blog/apple-pay-payments-guide/) or [Chime](/blog/chime-payments-guide/), which follow the same send-details-after-ordering process. If you want the 10% discount, choose cryptocurrency or a gift card; see [how the crypto and gift card discount works](/blog/crypto-discount-how-it-works/). All products are for adults aged 21 and over, and nicotine is addictive.

## Staying protected
Only trust payment details that come through our official email, our WhatsApp number or your private order page. Never share your Cash App PIN or sign-in codes with anyone, and be wary of anyone who asks you to pay a different handle or pay outside the order. If anything looks unusual, stop and contact us before you pay.

## Frequently asked questions in depth
### Can I pay from a Cash App balance and a bank account at the same time?
Cash App lets you choose the funding source on the payment screen. Use whichever you prefer, but make sure the full amount is sent in a single payment, because we match one payment to one order.

### Does Cash App show the name of the recipient?
Yes. The confirmation screen shows the recipient's name and $Cashtag. Check them against the details on your private payment page before you confirm. If they do not match, stop and contact us.

### Will my payment be matched if I forget the order ID in the note?
Usually yes, because we also match by amount and time, but it takes longer. Add the order ID every time and upload your screenshot, and matching is quick.

### Can I pay for two orders in one payment?
Please do not. Each order has its own amount and reference, and a combined payment makes matching harder. Send one payment per order, with the right order ID in each note.

### What happens if my payment is held by Cash App for review?
Cash App sometimes holds payments for security checks. If it shows as pending, upload your screenshot anyway and tell us. We will wait for it to complete before confirming the order.

### Can I change to a different method after ordering?
Yes, if you have not paid. Contact us with your order number and we can switch the method and send the right details. Note that cryptocurrency and gift cards carry the 10% discount and the order total will update accordingly.

### How does this compare with other app payments?
Cash App, Apple Pay and Chime all follow the same pattern: place the order, receive details, pay, upload a receipt and wait for confirmation. The best choice is simply the app you use most. If you want a discount, choose crypto or a gift card instead.

### How quickly should I pay after ordering?
As soon as you can, and within 24 hours. Paying promptly keeps your stock reserved and gets your order into processing sooner, because processing starts only once your payment is confirmed.

### Can I add another item after I receive the details?
Yes, but tell us before you pay. We will update the order, recalculate the total, check whether you now qualify for free shipping and send fresh details so you pay the right amount once.

title: Paying With Apple Pay: Step-by-Step Order and Receipt Guide
summary: Using Apple Pay for your order? We send the number or details to pay, you pay from your phone, then upload the receipt. Here is the flow.
body:
Apple Pay is supported at One Stop Vape Store through a simple flow: you place the order, we send you the payment details, and you pay and send proof. It does not carry the 10% discount that cryptocurrency and gift cards do, but it is convenient if you already use Apple Pay and your phone for payments every day. This guide explains each step, what the email and the private payment page contain, how to make sure your payment is matched quickly, what to do about the most common problems and how Apple Pay compares with other methods. It is for adults aged 21 and over.

## Why Apple Pay details arrive after you order
We do not show payment details at checkout for Apple Pay. Instead, we send them after the order is saved. This keeps the details tied to your order, lets us confirm the amount before you pay and makes sure you always use current instructions. The same pattern applies to Cash App and Chime. Read [how payment details reach you](/blog/how-payment-details-reach-you/) for how the email, WhatsApp message and private page fit together.

## Place the order
Add products to your cart, choose options such as strength and pack size on the product page, and go to checkout. Enter your contact and shipping details, confirm you are 21 or older, choose Apple Pay and place the order. The minimum order is $100, and orders of $200 or more after discounts ship free; smaller orders pay a flat $15 shipping fee. We email you, and optionally WhatsApp you, after the order is saved, and your order number appears on the confirmation page.

## Receive the payment details
Our message contains the details to send payment to, and a link to a tap-to-copy page. The page is private to your order, and it shows the amount due and your order ID. The link contains a unique token, so only someone who has the link can open it. Do not share it. If the message has not arrived within a few minutes, check spam and the email address you entered, and see [order confirmation emails not arriving](/blog/order-confirmation-email-not-arriving/).

## Pay from your phone
Open the Apple Pay or Wallet flow you normally use for person-to-person payments and enter the details we sent. Pay the exact amount shown, and add your order ID in the notes so we can match it quickly. Check the recipient name on the confirmation screen against the details on your private payment page before you confirm. If your card or balance is declined, fix the issue in your Wallet and try again.

## Upload the receipt
Take a screenshot of the confirmation and upload it using the link in our email. The screenshot should show the amount, the recipient and the time. You can attach more than one image if needed, for example if the payment shows on two screens. Uploads are private and compressed so they load quickly. See [how to upload a payment screenshot](/blog/how-to-upload-a-payment-screenshot/) for what makes a good one.

## Confirmation
We check our account, mark the order paid and email you. Orders then move into processing, which takes 24 to 72 business hours at our Phoenix, Arizona Stock Warehouse, followed by carrier delivery with tracking by a regional carrier. An adult aged 21 or older must sign on delivery. See [shipping times from Phoenix, Arizona](/blog/shipping-times-from-phoenix-arizona/) and [adult signature on delivery](/blog/adult-signature-on-delivery-what-to-expect/). You can follow each stage in [order status meanings](/blog/order-status-meanings/).

## Tips for a smooth order
- **Pay within 24 hours.** Unpaid orders may be released so stock is not held indefinitely.
- **Use the exact amount.** It speeds matching.
- **Add the order ID.** Put it in the note every time.
- **Keep the screenshot.** Upload it as soon as you pay.
- **Use only our official details.** Never pay a recipient sent by someone who contacted you unexpectedly.
- **Check the recipient.** If the name does not look right, stop and contact us.

## Common problems
### No email received
Check your spam folder and the address you entered. Then contact us through the [contact page](/contact/) with your order number or the name and email you used.

### Wrong amount
If you underpaid, pay the difference and mention it in the notes. If you overpaid, tell us your order number and we will explain how it is resolved.

### Paid to the wrong details
Contact us immediately with a screenshot. We cannot reverse payments sent elsewhere, but we can help work out the next step.

### The payment is pending
Upload your screenshot anyway and tell us it is pending. We will wait for it to complete before confirming the order.

## Refunds
If a refund is ever due, it goes back through the payment method the payment was received through, which here means the same Apple Pay route. Our returns policy allows returns within 30 days for unopened items in original packaging, less a 15% restocking fee, and opened or used items cannot be returned. See [refund and return policy explained](/blog/refund-and-return-policy-explained/).

## Frequently asked questions in depth
### Is Apple Pay cheaper or more expensive than other methods?
The price is the standard price with no discount. Cryptocurrency and gift cards save 10%, which can matter on larger orders. See [the 10% crypto and gift card discount](/blog/crypto-discount-how-it-works/).

### Can I pay for two orders in one payment?
Please send one payment per order with the right order ID in each note, because each order has its own amount and reference.

### Can I change my payment method after ordering?
Yes, before you pay. Contact us with your order number and we will switch it and send the right details.

### How fast is confirmation?
Usually quick during business hours once you have uploaded your screenshot. Customer service hours are Monday to Friday, 8AM to 5PM Arizona time.

## More options
Read the [Cash App](/blog/cash-app-payments-guide/) and [Chime](/blog/chime-payments-guide/) guides, or compare everything in [payment methods compared](/blog/payment-methods-compared/). Browse [vape juice](/shop/vape-juice/) and [disposable vapes](/shop/disposables/). All products are for adults aged 21 and over, and nicotine is addictive.

## What happens after you pay with Apple Pay
After you upload your screenshot, we check our account for your payment and match it to your order. Once your payment is confirmed, you receive an email and your order status changes to payment confirmed. The order then enters processing, which takes 24 to 72 business hours at our Phoenix, Arizona Stock Warehouse. When it ships, you receive a tracking email, and the regional carrier delivers it. An adult aged 21 or older must sign on delivery and may be asked to show photo ID, so choose an address where that is possible. You can follow every stage from the private link in your order email, and the meaning of each status is explained in [order status meanings](/blog/order-status-meanings/). If you need to change something, read [how to change or cancel an order](/blog/how-to-change-or-cancel-an-order/) before your order ships.

## Staying protected when you pay with Apple Pay
Only trust payment instructions that come through our official email, our WhatsApp number or your private order page. Check the recipient name on the Apple Pay confirmation screen against the details on your private payment page, and do not pay anyone who sends different details. We never ask for your passwords, PINs, card numbers, private keys or recovery phrases, and no genuine order needs them. Be wary of anyone who contacts you out of the blue claiming to represent the store, offers a different address or account to pay or pushes you to pay quickly outside the order. If a message does not match your order number and amount exactly, stop and contact us through the [contact page](/contact/) before you send anything. For more on keeping your account details secure, see [gift card code security tips](/blog/gift-card-code-security-tips/) and [why we need your email and phone](/blog/why-we-need-your-email-and-phone/).

## A worked example
Suppose your cart is $130. Apple Pay carries no discount, so the product total is $130.00. Because that is under $200, the flat $15 shipping fee applies, and the amount due is $145.00. You choose Apple Pay at checkout and place the order. A few minutes later you receive an email with the details and your private payment page. You open your Wallet, send exactly $145.00 to the details shown and type your order ID in the note. You take a screenshot of the confirmation and upload it from the private page. During business hours we check our account, mark the order paid and email you. Compare that with paying by crypto: the same cart would be $117.00 plus $15 shipping, so $132.00. See [the 10% discount guide](/blog/crypto-discount-how-it-works/).

## A final checklist before you send
- Place the order and wait for the details email.
- Pay the exact amount and put your order ID in the note.
- Upload a screenshot straight away.
- Keep the confirmation until the order is confirmed.

Apple Pay orders move quickly in business hours once the screenshot is uploaded. If anything is unclear, ask before you pay.

### What if I am paying from a shared family phone?
Use the Wallet that holds the payment method you intend to use, and make sure the name on the payment is clear and matches your order, or tell us whose name it will appear under so we can match it. Keep your private payment page to yourself, and sign out of shared accounts when you finish.

### Does paying by Apple Pay change my delivery?
No. Delivery is identical for every method: processing within 24 to 72 business hours, tracking by a regional carrier and an adult 21+ signature on delivery.

title: How Payment Details Reach You: Email, WhatsApp and the Copy Page
summary: For Cash App, Apple Pay and Chime we send payment details after you order. See where they arrive and how the tap-to-copy page works.
body:
For some payment methods we do not show payment details at checkout. Instead, we send them after you place the order. That applies to Cash App, Apple Pay and Chime, and to the buy-and-upload instructions for gift cards. If you have ordered this way before you may already know the pattern, but many customers wonder why it works like this, where exactly the details will arrive, what each message contains, how to tell a genuine message from a fake one and what to do if nothing turns up. This guide explains all of it. It is written for adults aged 21 and over.

## Why we do it this way
Payment details are tied to your order and kept current. Sending them after the order lets us do several useful things. We can confirm the amount and the products before you pay, which reduces mistakes. We can send the details through the channel you prefer. And we can make sure each customer receives instructions that match their order, rather than a generic set that might be out of date. For cryptocurrency the situation is different, because the payment window shows a live quote and a QR code immediately; see [how to pay with Bitcoin](/blog/how-to-pay-with-bitcoin/) for that flow.

## The three places you will see payment details
1. **Email:** a clear message with the amount due, each payment field and the payment terms. It also contains your order number and the link to your private order page.
2. **WhatsApp:** the same fields in a chat message with a link, if you placed the order through WhatsApp or asked for the details there. See [ordering via WhatsApp](/blog/ordering-via-whatsapp/).
3. **The payment page:** a private link where each field has a tap-to-copy button and where you can upload your receipt. Email programs cannot run copy buttons, so the page exists to make copying a single tap.

These three always agree with each other. If you receive details that do not match across them, stop and contact us.

## What each message contains
Every payment message includes your order number, the exact amount due, the payment method, the field or fields you need (such as a $Cashtag for Cash App), the note to include so we can match your payment and a link to your private order page. For gift cards the message also includes a buy link and an upload link, as described in [how gift card payment works](/blog/how-gift-card-payment-works/). The tone is plain and practical: it tells you what to do and by when.

## Why a link rather than only details
The private page lets you copy each detail with one tap and upload your receipt from the same place, so you do not have to go back and forth between apps. The link contains a unique token, which means only people who have the link can open it. Treat it like a ticket: do not post it publicly or forward it to someone you do not trust. If you think someone else has seen it, contact us and we can help.

## What to do when the details arrive
1. Open the private page from the email or WhatsApp message.
2. Open your payment app, such as Cash App, Apple Pay or Chime.
3. Pay the exact amount, adding your order ID in the note where the method allows it.
4. Return to the page and upload a screenshot of your confirmation. See [how to upload a payment screenshot](/blog/how-to-upload-a-payment-screenshot/).
5. Wait for our confirmation email. Orders ship once payment is confirmed.

Each method has its own quirks. The guides for [Cash App](/blog/cash-app-payments-guide/), [Apple Pay](/blog/apple-pay-payments-guide/) and [Chime](/blog/chime-payments-guide/) cover the details.

## How long should the message take?
During business hours we usually send details within minutes. Outside business hours, or when order volume is high, it may take longer, but you will receive them. Customer service hours are Monday to Friday, 8AM to 5PM Arizona time. If you place an order at night, expect the message in the morning. You can check the status of your order at any time from the private link in your order email; see [order status meanings](/blog/order-status-meanings/).

## If nothing arrives
Work through this short list:

- **Check spam and promotions folders.** Messages from a new sender sometimes land there.
- **Check the address.** A typo in the email address at checkout is the most common cause.
- **Check your phone number.** If you asked for WhatsApp, make sure the number was entered with the country code.
- **Wait a few minutes.** Email delivery is not always instant.
- **Contact us.** Use the [contact page](/contact/) or WhatsApp with your order number or the email and name you used.

Our article on [order confirmation emails not arriving](/blog/order-confirmation-email-not-arriving/) covers the common technical causes in detail, including mailbox filters and full inboxes.

## Spotting genuine messages
Genuine payment instructions come from three places only: our official email at the store's own domain, our official WhatsApp number and the private order page linked from those messages. We do not ask customers to pay through social media direct messages, random phone numbers or links that do not belong to us. We never ask for your card number, PIN, password or recovery phrase. If a message asks for any of those, or pushes you to pay urgently outside the order, treat it as suspicious and do not pay.

When in doubt, compare the amount and order number in the message with your order. They should match exactly. If they do not, or if the sender is not one of the official channels, stop and contact us through the website.

## What if I need the details again?
Open the original email and use the link to your private payment page, which always shows the current details. If you cannot find the email, contact us and we will resend it. Do not use details from an old order for a new order, because each order has its own amount and note.

## What if I need to change something?
If you notice a mistake in the amount or the order, tell us before you pay. We can correct the order and send updated details. If you have already paid, send us your order number and a screenshot so we can match and adjust. See [how to change or cancel an order](/blog/how-to-change-or-cancel-an-order/).

## After you pay
Once we confirm your payment you receive an email and your status updates. We then process the order within 24 to 72 business hours at our Phoenix, Arizona Stock Warehouse and ship with tracking by a regional carrier. An adult aged 21 or older must sign on delivery. Read [shipping times from Phoenix, Arizona](/blog/shipping-times-from-phoenix-arizona/) and [adult signature on delivery](/blog/adult-signature-on-delivery-what-to-expect/) to prepare.

## Which method should you choose?
If speed and automation matter most, cryptocurrency is checked on the blockchain automatically. If you already use a payment app daily, Cash App, Apple Pay or Chime may be more convenient even without the 10% discount. If you have a gift card, our gift card process lets you use it, and it earns the discount too. Our [payment methods comparison](/blog/payment-methods-compared/) puts them side by side. All products are for adults aged 21 and over, and nicotine is addictive.

## Frequently asked questions in depth
### Can I ask for the details to go to a different email?
Yes. Tell us before you pay and we will update the order and resend the details to the new address. For security, we will confirm the change with the original contact details on the order.

### Do payment details ever change on the same order?
The details tied to your order stay the same unless the order changes, for example if you add items or switch method. If anything changes, we send updated details and tell you clearly which to use.

### Should I forward the payment email to a friend who will pay for me?
It is better not to. The private link is meant for the customer on the order. If someone else pays on your behalf, ask them to use the exact details and put your order ID in the note, and tell us so we can match it.

### What if I opened the page on a different device?
The private link works on any device, because it carries its own token. Use whichever device has your payment app. Just keep the link private.

### Do I need to keep the link after the order ships?
It is useful for tracking and for any later question about the order, so keep the email. It stops being needed for payment once the order is confirmed.

### Can I get help choosing a method?
Yes. Message us on WhatsApp or through the [contact page](/contact/) and tell us which methods you have available, and we will point you to the quickest option for you.

### How quickly should I pay after the details arrive?
Within 24 hours is the guideline. Paying promptly keeps your stock reserved and starts processing sooner, because we only begin once the payment is confirmed.

### Can I add another item after I receive the details?
Yes, but tell us before you pay. We will update the order, recalculate the total and send fresh details so you pay the right amount once.

### What if I want to pay a different way after all?
Tell us before you pay and we will switch the method and send the right details. Cryptocurrency and gift cards carry the 10% discount, so the total will update if you switch to one of them.

faq.a: By email, and by WhatsApp if you used or asked for it. Both link to a private payment page with tap-to-copy buttons.

title: Payment Methods Compared: Crypto, Gift Cards, Cash App, Apple Pay, Chime
summary: Five ways to pay, with different discounts and speeds. Compare them side by side and pick the one that fits your order.
body:
We accept several payment methods at One Stop Vape Store, and each has trade-offs in price, speed, effort and risk. This guide compares them side by side so you can choose the one that suits your order. The five options are cryptocurrency, gift cards, Cash App, Apple Pay and Chime. Cryptocurrency and gift cards earn a 10% discount. The others pay the standard price but are convenient if you already use them. We explain how each works, what it costs, how fast it is, what could go wrong and which situations each is best for. It is written for adults aged 21 and over and is not financial advice.

## The quick comparison
- **Cryptocurrency:** 10% discount; payment window at checkout; automatic detection on most networks; best for people who already hold crypto.
- **Gift cards:** 10% discount; buy a card, then upload it; best for people without crypto who prefer a card purchase.
- **Cash App:** no discount; details sent after ordering; best if you already use Cash App.
- **Apple Pay:** no discount; details sent after ordering; best for iPhone users who want to pay from their phone.
- **Chime:** no discount; details sent after ordering; best for Chime account holders.

## Cryptocurrency
**Discount:** 10% on your product subtotal.
**Speed:** minutes after confirmation. Bitcoin, Ethereum, Solana, USDT and USDC are matched automatically on their networks, while BNB is confirmed by our team after you upload a screenshot.
**How it works:** at checkout choose Cryptocurrency and a coin, and a payment window shows the amount, a QR code and the address. You send from your wallet, press "I have paid" and your order is matched.
**Best for:** people already holding crypto, or stablecoin users.
**Watch for:** network choice and fees. See [what a crypto network is](/blog/what-is-a-crypto-network/), [network fees explained](/blog/crypto-network-fees-explained/) and [how we detect your crypto payment](/blog/how-we-detect-your-crypto-payment/). Individual guides cover [Bitcoin](/blog/how-to-pay-with-bitcoin/), [USDT](/blog/usdt-erc20-vs-trc20-which-network/), [USDC on Solana](/blog/pay-with-usdc-on-solana/), [Ethereum](/blog/pay-with-ethereum-eth/), [BNB](/blog/pay-with-bnb-smart-chain/) and [Solana](/blog/pay-with-solana-sol/).
**If you do not have crypto:** read [how to buy crypto with a card](/blog/how-to-buy-crypto-with-a-card/).

## Gift cards
**Discount:** 10% on your product subtotal.
**Speed:** depends on how quickly you buy the card and upload it, plus a manual check by our team.
**How it works:** choose Gift cards at checkout and place the order. We send a buy link and an upload link. You buy the card, upload the details and we confirm.
**Cards:** Apple, Razer Gold, Paysafe, Sephora and Macy's. See [how gift card payment works](/blog/how-gift-card-payment-works/) and the individual guides.
**Best for:** people without crypto who prefer a card purchase.
**Watch for:** buy only from the official links we send, and never share codes with anyone who contacts you unexpectedly. See [gift card code security tips](/blog/gift-card-code-security-tips/).

## Cash App
**Discount:** none.
**Speed:** quick once you have our details.
**How it works:** place the order, receive the $Cashtag and amount, pay in the app with your order ID in the note and upload a screenshot.
**Best for:** simplicity if you already use Cash App. See the [Cash App guide](/blog/cash-app-payments-guide/).

## Apple Pay
**Discount:** none.
**How it works:** the same flow as Cash App, using Apple Pay or Wallet.
**Best for:** iPhone users who want to pay from their phone. See the [Apple Pay guide](/blog/apple-pay-payments-guide/).

## Chime
**Discount:** none.
**How it works:** the same flow, using the Chime app.
**Best for:** Chime account holders. See the [Chime guide](/blog/chime-payments-guide/).

## What all methods share
- **Minimum order:** $100.
- **Shipping:** free on orders of $200 or more after discount; otherwise a flat $15.
- **Processing:** 24 to 72 business hours after payment is confirmed, from our Phoenix, Arizona Stock Warehouse.
- **Delivery:** tracked a regional carrier, with adult signature (21+) required.
- **Refunds:** back through the payment method used, less a 15% restocking fee, for eligible returns within 30 days. See [refund and return policy explained](/blog/refund-and-return-policy-explained/).
- **Security:** payment details come only from our official email, our WhatsApp number or your private order page. We never ask for PINs, passwords or recovery phrases.

## How the discount changes the picture
The 10% discount is the biggest differentiator, and it grows with the order. On a $100 order it is $10. On a $300 order it is $30. But remember free shipping is calculated after discount: a $215 order paid by crypto becomes $193.50 and pays $15 shipping, while the same order by Cash App stays above $200 and ships free. Always check the order summary before you pay. See [the 10% crypto and gift card discount](/blog/crypto-discount-how-it-works/) for worked examples.

## Which should you choose?
### If the discount matters most
Choose crypto or a gift card. If you already hold crypto, it is the clear winner. If you do not, weigh the cost of buying it against the saving, or use a gift card.

### If speed matters most
Crypto on a fast network such as Solana is matched automatically within minutes. Apps are quick once you have the details and upload a screenshot during business hours.

### If simplicity matters most
Use the app you already use daily, such as Cash App, Apple Pay or Chime. There is nothing new to learn.

### If you worry about price movement
Choose a stablecoin such as USDC or USDT, or an app payment, so the amount is exact.

### If you want the lowest fees
Compare the fee on each route. App payments have no extra fee from us, crypto has a network fee, and buying crypto adds provider fees.

## Frequently asked questions in depth
### Can I split a payment between two methods?
Please choose one method per order. If you have a special situation, contact us before ordering so we can advise.

### Which method is best for a first order?
If you have crypto or a gift card, take the discount. Otherwise use the app you already trust. Either way, follow the steps in the relevant guide.

### Are all methods available to everyone?
All methods are available to adults aged 21 and over who can receive a delivery with an adult signature. Laws on vapor products differ by state, and it is your responsibility to follow them where you live.

## Ready to order
Add products from [disposable vapes](/shop/disposables/), [vape juice](/shop/vape-juice/) or [vape kits](/shop/vape-kits/) and open checkout. All products are for adults aged 21 and over, and nicotine is addictive.

## Choosing in practice: three example orders
### A $110 first order from someone with no crypto
The standard-price total with Cash App, Apple Pay or Chime is $110.00 plus $15 shipping, so $125.00. A gift card would save $11.00 on the product total, giving $99.00 plus $15 shipping, or $114.00. If the gift card is easy to buy, it is cheaper. If not, use the app you already trust.

### A $260 order from someone who holds USDC
With crypto the product total is $234.00 after the discount, and shipping is free because it is above $200. That is $26.00 less than the same order paid by an app. The network fee on Solana is a fraction of a cent, so almost the entire saving is kept.

### A $205 order from someone choosing between crypto and Cash App
With Cash App the total is $205.00 and shipping is free. With crypto the product total is $184.50, which is under $200, so shipping of $15 is added, giving $199.50. Crypto is still cheaper by $5.50, but the saving is smaller than the headline 10% because of the shipping fee. That is why it pays to check the order summary before you choose.

## Common mistakes when choosing a method
- **Choosing by habit without checking the total.** The order summary shows each method's total, so compare before you pay.
- **Ignoring fees on the way in.** Buying crypto or a gift card can cost more than the discount on a small order.
- **Forgetting about timing.** Identity checks on a new exchange account can take days, so start early or use a method you already have.
- **Using unofficial details.** Pay only to details from our official channels.
- **Paying the wrong amount.** Send the exact amount shown, with your order ID where the method allows a note.

## After you choose
Whatever you pick, the next steps are in the individual guides, and you can switch method before you pay by contacting us with your order number. For help choosing, message us on WhatsApp or through the [contact page](/contact/).

## Frequently asked questions about choosing a method
### Does the method change what I receive?
No. Every order ships the same way and carries the same returns rights, whichever method you use. Only the price, speed and steps differ.

### Can I use a different method for a second order?
Yes. Each order is independent, so you can use crypto one time and an app the next.

### Which method is best for wholesale orders?
Wholesale orders are arranged through the [wholesale page](/wholesale/) and the [wholesale ordering guide](/blog/wholesale-ordering-guide/), where payment options are explained for larger volumes.

### Where can I get help choosing?
Message us on WhatsApp, call or use the [contact page](/contact/), and tell us what you have available. We will point you to the quickest route.

### Does the method affect how quickly my order ships?
Only through how quickly your payment is confirmed. Orders enter processing once payment is confirmed, so a method that is matched automatically, such as crypto on a supported network, or one you complete promptly will start the clock sooner.

title: How to Upload Your Payment Screenshot or Receipt Correctly
summary: A clear screenshot speeds up confirmation. See what to capture, how to upload from your phone and what happens afterwards.
body:
After you pay with Cash App, Apple Pay, Chime, a gift card or cryptocurrency, you can upload proof so we can confirm your payment quickly. A clear screenshot or receipt lets the person checking your order match it in seconds, while a blurry or incomplete one can lead to a back-and-forth that delays your order. This guide explains where to upload, what to capture for each payment method, how to make an image readable, how uploading works on a phone, which optional fields help, what happens after you upload and how to keep your uploads private. It is written for adults aged 21 and over.

## Where to upload
Use the link in your payment email or the order status page. It opens a private page with an upload box for your order. The link contains a unique token, so only the person with your order link can open the page. You do not need to sign in or create an account. If you cannot find the link, open the original email, or contact us through the [contact page](/contact/) with your order number and we will resend it.

## What to capture
Different methods need different proof. Here is what helps most for each.

### App payments: Cash App, Apple Pay and Chime
Capture the confirmation screen with the amount, the recipient and the date and time. If the app shows a transaction ID or a payment note with your order ID, make sure it is visible. If the confirmation spans two screens, capture both. See the guides for [Cash App](/blog/cash-app-payments-guide/), [Apple Pay](/blog/apple-pay-payments-guide/) and [Chime](/blog/chime-payments-guide/).

### Cryptocurrency
Capture the transaction ID or hash and the wallet or exchange confirmation that shows the coin, amount, network and time. The hash is the most useful item, because it lets us find the exact transfer on the blockchain. Paste it into the transaction field as well as including it in the screenshot. See [how we detect your crypto payment](/blog/how-we-detect-your-crypto-payment/).

### Gift cards
Capture the card code or PIN, photos of the card (front and back if it is physical) and your purchase receipt. For e-gift cards, a screenshot of the delivery email is enough. Check every digit of the code. See [how gift card payment works](/blog/how-gift-card-payment-works/) and the individual card guides.

## Make it readable
A clear image is the single biggest factor in how quickly your payment is confirmed. Follow these habits:

- **Capture the whole screen,** not a tiny crop. We need the amount, date and reference visible.
- **Crop out private details unrelated to the payment,** such as other contacts or balances, but keep the amount, date and reference.
- **Avoid blurry photos.** Hold the phone steady and tap to focus if you are photographing a card or receipt.
- **Use good light.** Glare and shadows make numbers unreadable.
- **Do not edit the image.** Annotations or filters can make it look altered. A plain screenshot is best.
- **Make sure the text is large enough.** If you zoom in, the numbers should still be sharp.

## Uploading from a phone
Tap the upload box, choose images from your gallery or take a photo. You can add up to four images. They are compressed on your device before sending, so large photos upload quickly, even on a slow connection. If an image does not upload, check your connection and try again, or choose a smaller or cropped version. Wait until you see the confirmation that the upload succeeded before you close the page.

## Uploading from a computer
You can upload from a desktop as well. Transfer the screenshot to your computer, or take a screenshot on the computer, then choose the files in the upload box. The same limits and compression apply.

## Optional fields
Add the transaction hash for crypto, the gift card code, and a short note if something is unusual. Notes that help include paying the difference for an underpaid order, buying a gift card in the next amount up, paying in two parts or paying from a different name. Short, clear notes save questions later.

## After you upload
Your order status changes to proof submitted and our team reviews it. We match your proof to the payment, and when payment is confirmed you receive an email. Review is a manual step for gift cards and some other cases, and it is quickest during business hours, Monday to Friday, 8AM to 5PM Arizona time. See [how ordering works](/blog/how-ordering-works/) for timing and [order status meanings](/blog/order-status-meanings/) for what each status means. Once payment is confirmed, the order enters processing, which takes 24 to 72 business hours at our Phoenix, Arizona Stock Warehouse.

## Keep it private
Only the person with your order link can open the page, so do not share the link. Do not share your gift card code or PIN publicly or with anyone who contacts you unexpectedly. Your uploaded images are stored with your order and are used only to check your payment. Our [privacy policy](/privacy/) explains what we collect and how we use it. For gift card specifics, read [gift card code security tips](/blog/gift-card-code-security-tips/).

## Common problems
### The upload fails
Check your connection and try a smaller image. If it still fails, email us the image from the address on your order, with your order number.

### I uploaded the wrong image
Tell us right away with your order number and upload the right image. We will use the latest one.

### I forgot to include the amount
Upload a new screenshot that shows it, or add the amount in the note field.

### I cannot find the link
Check spam, then contact us with your order number and we will resend it.

## Frequently asked questions in depth
### Do I have to upload a screenshot for crypto?
Usually not, because we match payments automatically on most networks. A transaction hash helps when a manual check is needed.

### How many images can I upload?
Up to four. If you need more, tell us in the notes and email the rest.

### Can I upload later?
Yes, but sooner is better, because we cannot confirm some payments until we have the proof. Unpaid orders may be released after 24 hours.

### Can someone else upload for me?
It is better if you do, because the private link is meant for the customer on the order. If someone else pays or uploads for you, tell us so we can match it.

## After your payment is confirmed
Once your payment is confirmed you receive an email, and your order status changes to payment confirmed. The order then enters processing, which takes 24 to 72 business hours at our Phoenix, Arizona Stock Warehouse. When it ships, you receive a tracking email, and a regional carrier delivers it. An adult aged 21 or older must sign on delivery and may be asked to show photo ID, so choose an address where that is possible. You can follow every stage from the private link in your order email, and the meaning of each status is explained in [order status meanings](/blog/order-status-meanings/). Read [shipping times from Phoenix, Arizona](/blog/shipping-times-from-phoenix-arizona/) and [adult signature on delivery](/blog/adult-signature-on-delivery-what-to-expect/) to prepare. All products are for adults aged 21 and over, and nicotine is addictive.

## A quick guide to good screenshots on each device
On an iPhone, press the side button and the volume up button together to take a screenshot, then find it in Photos. On most Android phones, press the power and volume down buttons together. On a Windows computer, use the Snipping Tool or press the Windows key, Shift and S. On a Mac, press Command, Shift and 4. Take the screenshot while the confirmation is on screen, check it is readable and then upload it. If you are photographing a physical card or receipt, place it flat on a plain surface in good light, hold the phone directly above it and tap to focus before you take the picture.

## What not to upload
Do not upload images that show unrelated private information, such as other people's messages, your full bank statement or your passwords. Crop to the payment. Do not upload edited images, because filters and markups can make a genuine screenshot look altered. And do not upload your wallet recovery phrase or private keys under any circumstances; we never need them, and no genuine process does.

## How long should you keep your proof?
Keep the original screenshots, receipts and emails until your order is delivered and for a few weeks afterward, in case a question about payment or a return comes up. After that, delete screenshots that contain gift card codes or other sensitive details from shared albums and cloud folders. Keeping a tidy record protects you, and deleting sensitive images when you no longer need them protects you even more, because it removes the chance that someone with access to your gallery could misuse them.

### Frequently asked questions in depth
**What if my screenshot shows a different name from the one on the order?** That is fine if someone else paid for you or the payment app uses a different display name. Add a short note saying whose name appears and why, and we will match it.

**What if the payment is still pending in my app?** Upload the screenshot anyway and say that it is pending. We will wait for it to complete before confirming, and your note helps us know what to expect.

**Do I need to upload again if I already did?** Only if we ask, or if you have new information, such as a second payment for a balance. Uploading the same image twice does not speed things up.

title: How Gift Card Payment Works: Apple, Razer, Paysafe, Sephora, Macy's
summary: Pay with a gift card and save 10%. This guide covers selecting a card at checkout, the email we send and how to upload the details.
body:
Gift cards are a payment option for people who prefer not to use cryptocurrency or payment apps, and they earn the same 10% discount as crypto. At One Stop Vape Store you can pay with an Apple, Razer Gold, Paysafe (paysafecard), Sephora or Macy's gift card. The process has five steps: choose gift cards at checkout, place your order, buy a card for the exact amount, upload the details through a private link and wait while we verify and ship. This guide explains every step in detail, how to handle denominations that do not match, how timing works, how to keep your card details protected and which card to choose. It is written for adults aged 21 and over.

## Why we accept gift cards
Not everyone holds crypto or wants to use a payment app, and gift cards are easy to buy online or in a store. They also give you the same 10% discount as cryptocurrency, which can make a noticeable difference on a larger order. The trade-off is that gift card payments need a manual check, so they are not instant. If speed matters most, compare options in [payment methods compared](/blog/payment-methods-compared/) and [gift card or crypto, which is better](/blog/gift-card-vs-crypto-which-is-better/).

## Step 1: choose Gift cards at checkout
Add products to your cart, choose options such as strength and pack size on the product page and go to checkout. Enter your contact and shipping details and confirm you are 21 or older. Select Gift cards, then pick which card you will use: Apple, Razer Gold, Paysafe, Sephora or Macy's. A short guide appears with a link to the official place to buy that card online. The order summary shows the 10% discount and your total, so you can see the exact amount before you continue.

## Step 2: place your order
Complete the order. We immediately email you, and can message you on WhatsApp if you prefer, with the exact amount due, a link to buy that card online and a private upload link. Your order is saved with the status awaiting payment and a unique order number. The minimum order is $100, and orders of $200 or more after the discount ship free; smaller orders pay a flat $15 shipping fee. See [minimum order and free shipping explained](/blog/minimum-order-and-free-shipping-explained/).

## Step 3: buy a card for the exact amount
Open the official store link and buy a gift card for the amount due, delivered to your own email address. Do not redeem the card to your own account, and do not use it for anything else. Gift cards come in fixed denominations, so sometimes the exact amount is not available. If the denominations do not match, buy the next amount up and tell us in the notes, and we will review it with you. If the amount due is larger than the maximum for a single card, buy two or more cards and upload them all.

## Step 4: upload the details
Use the private upload link to add the card code or PIN, clear photos or screenshots of the card email or the physical card, and your purchase receipt. The link contains a unique token, so only people who have it can open the page, and uploads are private. Check each digit of the code before you send, because a typo is the most common reason a card cannot be verified. See [how to upload a payment screenshot](/blog/how-to-upload-a-payment-screenshot/) for tips on clear images.

## Step 5: verification and shipping
We verify the card and mark the order paid. You receive a confirmation email, and the order proceeds to processing as described in the [shipping policy](/shipping/). Processing takes 24 to 72 business hours at our Phoenix, Arizona Stock Warehouse, followed by carrier delivery with tracking by a regional carrier. An adult aged 21 or older must sign on delivery. See [shipping times from Phoenix, Arizona](/blog/shipping-times-from-phoenix-arizona/) and [adult signature on delivery](/blog/adult-signature-on-delivery-what-to-expect/).

title: Gift Card Code Security Tips: Avoiding Scams When You Pay
summary: Gift cards are common in scams. Use these tips to protect your codes and make sure you only send them through our official order link.
body:
Gift cards are convenient, which is also why scammers like them. A gift card code works like cash: anyone who has it can spend the balance, and a spent card cannot be reversed. If you pay with a gift card at One Stop Vape Store, a few simple habits keep your money and your codes protected. This guide explains how scams that target gift card buyers work, what to do before, during and after you buy, how to recognize genuine messages from us, what to do if a code is compromised and how to handle the details of each supported card. It is written for adults aged 21 and over.

## Why gift cards attract scammers
A gift card code is a string of characters that can be spent online without any further check. That makes it attractive to anyone who wants quick, hard-to-trace value. Typical scams include fake customer-service messages that say your account is in trouble, fake invoices, marketplace sellers selling "discounted" cards that turn out to be stolen or already used and pressure to pay immediately and keep the payment secret. Understanding how they work is the best defense, because the pressure is what makes them succeed.

## Only use official links
We send you a private link by email or WhatsApp when you choose gift cards. That link, and only that link, is where you should upload card details. Do not send a gift card code to anyone who contacts you out of the blue, even if they claim to work for us. Our messages come from our official email at the store's own domain and our official WhatsApp number, and they match your order number and amount exactly. We do not ask for codes by text message, social media or a phone call you did not expect. If you are unsure, contact us through the [contact page](/contact/) before you share anything.

## Buy from the source
Purchase cards from the brand's own site or a major retailer. Avoid marketplace sellers and auction sites selling discounted cards, because those cards may be stolen, counterfeit or already used, and you will not be able to recover your money. Official links for each supported card are in our guides: [Apple](/blog/pay-with-apple-gift-card/), [Razer Gold](/blog/pay-with-razer-gold/), [paysafecard](/blog/pay-with-paysafecard/), [Sephora](/blog/pay-with-sephora-gift-card/) and [Macy's](/blog/pay-with-macys-gift-card/).

## Never reveal a code publicly
Do not post pictures of codes online or in public chats, and do not send them to friends for safekeeping. Photograph only what we ask for: the code or PIN, the card email or the physical card and your receipt. Delete screenshots from shared albums and cloud folders after your order is complete, because anyone with access to those folders could spend the balance if the card still holds value.

## Keep the receipt
Your receipt proves the purchase. If something goes wrong, it helps the card issuer investigate and helps us check your order. Keep the email, the receipt and any screenshots until we confirm your payment, and for a few weeks afterward in case a question comes up.

## Check the amount
Buy for the amount due. Do not buy more than you need unless you plan to use the rest for another order, because we cannot return unused balance to you. If the exact denomination is not offered, buy the next amount up and tell us in the notes so we can review it. If the amount is larger than a single card allows, buy two or more.

## Beware of pressure
Real orders never require you to hurry or keep the transaction secret. If someone insists that you must pay immediately, must buy several cards or must read the codes to them over the phone, stop and contact us at the number on our [contact page](/contact/). Scammers use urgency because it works. A genuine order can wait while you check.

## Report problems early
If you think a card code was compromised, contact the card issuer immediately. Many issuers can freeze a card if the balance has not yet been spent. Then tell us, with your order number, so we can note it against your order. The sooner you act, the better the chance of recovering the balance.

## Before, during and after: a checklist
### Before you buy
- Confirm the amount due in our order email.
- Open the official link for the card you plan to use.
- Make sure you are on the real site by typing the address yourself.

### During the purchase
- Send the card to your own email address.
- Do not redeem or spend any of the balance.
- Take a screenshot of the delivery email.

### After you upload
- Wait for our confirmation email.
- Keep the receipt for a few weeks.
- Delete screenshots from shared places once the order is complete.

## Frequently asked questions in depth
### What if someone contacts me claiming to be from the store and asks for a code?
Do not send it. Contact us through the [contact page](/contact/) with details of the message. We will confirm whether it came from us.

### What if I sent a code to the wrong person?
Contact the card issuer immediately and ask if the card can be frozen. Then tell us so we can note it. Be honest about what happened, because the quicker we know, the better we can help.

### Can I buy a card from a friend?
Only if you know the card is unused and the friend owns it. Otherwise buy directly from the official site.

### Are physical cards or e-gift cards better?
Both work. E-gift cards are delivered instantly to your email and are easy to screenshot. Physical cards need clear photos of both sides. Either way, keep the receipt.

## Related guides
See [how gift card payment works](/blog/how-gift-card-payment-works/) and [uploading proof](/blog/how-to-upload-a-payment-screenshot/). For more on spotting fake products and messages, read [how to spot counterfeit vapes](/blog/how-to-spot-counterfeit-vapes/). Browse [disposable vapes](/shop/disposables/). All products are for adults aged 21 and over, and nicotine is addictive.

## Special situations
### Buying for someone else
If a friend or relative buys the card for you, make sure they send it to your email and that you are the person who uploads the code. Do not ask them to message us on your behalf, because we match payments to the contact details on your order.

### Using a physical card from a store
Buy it directly from the store and keep the receipt. Avoid cards from displays that look tampered with, such as damaged packaging or scratched-off codes, because those may have been compromised before you bought them.

### Using a card you have held for a while
Check the balance with the issuer before you use it, because it may have been spent or partly used. If it is a supported brand and the full balance is intact, it can be used for an order.

### Using more than one card
Upload every code in a single message through the private link, and tell us in the notes how many you are sending. That keeps everything attached to one order and makes verification faster.

## A final checklist for gift card security
1. Use only the private link from our official email or WhatsApp number.
2. Buy only from the brand or a reputable retailer.
3. Never share a code publicly or with anyone who contacts you unexpectedly.
4. Keep the receipt and the email.
5. Report a compromised code to the issuer immediately, then to us.

If everything on the list is ticked, your payment should be verified without any questions. If something is unclear, contact us through the [contact page](/contact/) or WhatsApp before you upload, and we will help. Remember that all products are for adults aged 21 and over, and nicotine is addictive.

## How genuine contact from us looks
It helps to know exactly what a real message from us contains, so you can spot a fake one. After you place an order with gift cards, you receive one email from our official address that includes your order number, the exact amount due, a link to the official page where you can buy the card and a private link for uploading the details. If you asked for WhatsApp, you receive the same information from our official number. The amounts and order number always match your order. We do not ask you to buy several cards, we do not ask you to read codes aloud on a call and we do not ask you to keep the payment secret. If a message differs from this pattern, treat it with suspicion.

## What to do if you already shared a code with the wrong person
Act quickly, because balances can be spent within minutes. First, contact the card issuer through its official support channel and ask whether the card can be frozen or the balance protected. Second, keep every message and receipt, because they help the issuer investigate. Third, tell us the order number and what happened, so we can note it against the order and advise on the next step. Fourth, change the password on any email account involved if you think it may have been accessed. Finally, report the scam to the appropriate consumer protection authority in your state, which helps others avoid it. We cannot recover a spent balance, but quick action sometimes saves it.

## Teaching others to stay protected
Gift card scams often target people who are less familiar with online payments. If you are helping a friend or relative with an order, walk them through the rules above: official links only, official retailers only, no public codes and no pressure. A short conversation before they buy is worth far more than a complicated recovery afterward.

faq.a: No. We only use the private link in our order email or WhatsApp message.

faq.q: Should I keep my receipt?
faq.a: Yes. It proves the purchase and helps if anything goes wrong.
