title: Gift Card or Crypto? Which Discounted Payment Fits You
summary: Both earn a 10% discount. Compare speed, effort, fees and privacy considerations to decide between gift cards and cryptocurrency.
body:
Both gift card and cryptocurrency payments earn a 10% discount at One Stop Vape Store, so for many shoppers the real question is not whether to take the discount but which route to take to get it. They suit different people. Crypto is faster and automatically matched on most networks, but it needs a wallet or an exchange. Gift cards are familiar and quick to buy, but they need a manual check and come in fixed amounts. This guide compares them on speed, effort, fees, exact amounts, reversibility, security and timing, with worked examples, and helps you decide which fits you. It is written for adults aged 21 and over and is not financial advice.

## The discount is the same
Both methods save 10% on your product subtotal, applied automatically at checkout. Shipping is added after the discount, and free shipping applies to orders of $200 or more after the discount. That means the saving does not depend on the method you choose, only on your order. See [the 10% crypto and gift card discount](/blog/crypto-discount-how-it-works/) for worked examples. The differences are in how you pay.

## Speed
Crypto on a fast network can be confirmed within minutes, and detection is automatic on most networks, so a payment can be matched even outside business hours. Gift cards depend on you buying the card and uploading the details, then us verifying them, which is a manual check done during business hours, Monday to Friday, 8AM to 5PM Arizona time. Typically crypto is quicker once you hold coins. Since orders begin processing only after payment is confirmed, a faster payment can mean an earlier dispatch. See [how we detect your crypto payment](/blog/how-we-detect-your-crypto-payment/).

## Effort
If you have never used crypto, setting up a wallet or an exchange account takes time, including identity verification on a regulated exchange, which can take from minutes to days. Gift cards can be bought in minutes from a familiar site, and many people have bought one before. See [how gift card payment works](/blog/how-gift-card-payment-works/) and [how to buy crypto with a card](/blog/how-to-buy-crypto-with-a-card/). If you already hold crypto, the effort is small: choose a coin, send and press the button.

## Fees
Crypto has network fees and sometimes exchange or provider fees. Gift cards usually have no extra fee beyond the card price, though some retailers add small charges or processing fees. Compare the total cost against the 10% saving. On a small order, buying crypto with a card can cost more than the discount, while a gift card often leaves most of it intact. On a large order, both can be worthwhile. See [crypto network fees explained](/blog/crypto-network-fees-explained/).

## Exact amounts
Stablecoins such as [USDT](/blog/usdt-erc20-vs-trc20-which-network/) and [USDC](/blog/pay-with-usdc-on-solana/) let you send exact amounts, down to the cent. Gift cards come in set amounts, so you may need to round up and tell us in the notes, and any difference cannot be returned to you. If you need precision, crypto is better. If a small round-up does not bother you, a gift card is fine.

## Reversibility and security
Crypto transfers are final. Gift cards are also hard to recover once the code is sent. Be careful in both cases: check the address and network for crypto, and send gift card codes only through our private link. Read [gift card code security tips](/blog/gift-card-code-security-tips/) and [sent crypto on the wrong network](/blog/sent-crypto-on-the-wrong-network/) so you know what to avoid.

## Worked examples
### A $120 first order
With a gift card, the product total is $108.00 plus $15 shipping, so $123.00. With crypto it is the same $123.00, minus whatever fees you pay to get and send the crypto. If you have neither, the gift card route is usually simpler for a first order.

### A $260 order from someone who holds USDC
With crypto the product total is $234.00 and shipping is free, so $234.00, and the Solana fee is a fraction of a cent. A gift card would also total $234.00 but you would need to buy cards in set amounts and wait for a manual check. Crypto is faster and exact.

### A $205 order
With either method the product total is $184.50, which is under $200, so shipping of $15 is added, for $199.50. Choose whichever is easier for you, because the totals match.

## Who should use which
- **Already hold crypto:** use crypto.
- **Prefer a familiar checkout:** use a gift card.
- **Want exact amounts:** use stablecoins.
- **Order outside business hours and want it matched fast:** use crypto on a network with automatic detection.
- **Do not want to create a wallet or an exchange account:** use a gift card.

## Questions to ask yourself
1. Do I already hold crypto or a gift card from a supported brand?
2. How soon do I want the order to enter processing?
3. Would fees on the way in cancel the saving?
4. Do I need to pay an exact amount?
5. Am I comfortable with the steps of the method I am considering?

If you answer yes to the first question for either method, that is usually your answer.

## Frequently asked questions in depth
### Can I use both in one order?
Please choose one method per order. If you have a special situation, contact us before ordering.

### Which is easier for a beginner?
Usually gift cards, because the purchase is familiar. If you are curious about crypto, a stablecoin on a low-fee network is the gentlest start.

### Which is less likely to go wrong?
Both go smoothly when you follow the steps. Crypto mistakes usually involve the wrong network or address. Gift card mistakes usually involve a typo in the code or a mismatched amount. Check carefully in either case.

## See the full list
Read [payment methods compared](/blog/payment-methods-compared/) and the guides for [Bitcoin](/blog/how-to-pay-with-bitcoin/), [Apple gift cards](/blog/pay-with-apple-gift-card/) and [Razer Gold](/blog/pay-with-razer-gold/). Browse [disposable vapes](/shop/disposables/) and [vape juice](/shop/vape-juice/). All products are for adults aged 21 and over, and nicotine is addictive.

## What if I am not sure?
If you are on the fence, try the route that needs the fewest new steps. If you already have a gift card from one of our supported brands, use it. If you already have crypto in a wallet, use that. If you have neither, think about which one you could set up fastest. A gift card can usually be bought in a few minutes with a card or cash, while a first crypto purchase may involve identity checks. For a first order, many people prefer the gift card, then explore crypto later if they like the idea. There is no wrong choice here, because both earn the same discount and both lead to the same delivery.

## A note on privacy
Gift cards and crypto are both ways to pay without sharing your bank card details with us, and we never ask for card numbers, PINs of your bank cards, passwords or recovery phrases. Crypto uses public blockchain data to match your payment, while gift cards use the code and receipt you upload. Neither requires an account with us. Our [privacy policy](/privacy/) explains what we collect and how we use it.

## A final checklist for choosing a method
1. Check the order summary for both totals.
2. Think about how soon you want the order to enter processing.
3. Compare any fees on the way in with the 10% saving.
4. Pick the method you are comfortable with.
5. Follow the steps in the matching guide.

If everything on the list is ticked, your payment should be verified without any questions. If something is unclear, contact us through the [contact page](/contact/) or WhatsApp before you upload, and we will help. Remember that all products are for adults aged 21 and over, and nicotine is addictive.

## How the two methods differ after you pay
Once payment is confirmed, the two routes converge. The order moves into processing, which takes 24 to 72 business hours at our Phoenix, Arizona Stock Warehouse, and then ships with tracking by a regional carrier. An adult aged 21 or older must sign on delivery. The order page, the emails and the returns rights are identical. If you ever return an eligible item within 30 days, the refund goes back through the payment method you used, less the 15% restocking fee, so for gift card orders we explain how the refund is returned and for crypto orders it is returned in the coin you used.

## Common regrets and how to avoid them
- **Buying crypto only for one small order.** Fees can cancel the saving, so check first or use a gift card.
- **Buying a gift card for far more than the amount due.** The surplus cannot be returned through us, so match the amount.
- **Sending crypto on the wrong network.** Always match the network in the window.
- **Typing a gift card code by hand.** Copy it or check every digit.
- **Waiting until the last minute.** Both methods are quick when you are prepared and slow when you are rushing.

Planning ahead, choosing the method you are comfortable with and following the matching guide will give you the discount without the stress.

title: How Ordering Works: From Cart to Delivery in Six Steps
summary: A clear walkthrough of our order process: cart, checkout, payment, confirmation, dispatch and adult-signature delivery.
body:
Placing an order with One Stop Vape Store is straightforward, but it has more steps than a typical online purchase because vapor products are age-restricted and because several of our payment methods work differently from a card checkout. This guide follows the full journey of an order, from the moment you add an item to your cart to the moment an adult signs for the parcel. It explains what happens at each stage, what you need to do, what we do, how long each part takes and where to look if you need help. It is written for adults aged 21 and over.

## Before you order: the basics
Everything we sell is for adults aged 21 and over, and nicotine is addictive. You confirm your age when you enter the store and again at checkout. The minimum order is $100 before discounts, and orders of $200 or more after discount and before tax qualify for free domestic shipping on most of the 48 contiguous states; smaller orders pay the flat shipping fee shown in your order summary. We do not ship internationally. See [minimum order and free shipping explained](/blog/minimum-order-and-free-shipping-explained/) and [where we ship and where we do not](/blog/where-we-ship-and-where-we-do-not/).

## Step 1: build your cart
Browse a category or search for a product, then open its page. Where a product offers options, such as nicotine strength or pack size, choose them above the Add to Cart button. The price updates to match your choice, and the choice appears in your cart and on your order. Set the quantity and add the item. You can keep shopping, and your cart is saved in your browser on this device, so it is still there when you come back. Check the cart page: it shows each line, the subtotal and how much more you need to reach the minimum order or free shipping.

## Step 2: enter your details
At checkout we ask for your name, email, phone and shipping address, and for you to confirm you are 21 or older. We use your email for confirmations and payment details, and your phone number so that we or the carrier can reach you if there is a problem. Use an address where an adult can sign for the parcel, because signature is required on delivery. Check the address carefully, because we cannot change it after the parcel is handed to the carrier. See [shipping address tips](/blog/shipping-address-tips/) and [why we need your email and phone](/blog/why-we-need-your-email-and-phone/).

## Step 3: choose how to pay
Pick Cash App, Apple Pay, Chime, Cryptocurrency or Gift cards. Cryptocurrency and gift cards give a 10% discount on the product subtotal, and the free-shipping check is applied after that discount. The order summary shows each method's total as you switch. Compare the methods in [payment methods compared](/blog/payment-methods-compared/) and read [the 10% discount guide](/blog/crypto-discount-how-it-works/) if you are close to the free-shipping line.

## Step 4: pay and confirm
How you pay depends on the method:

- **Cryptocurrency:** a payment window opens straight away with the amount, a QR code and the address. You send from your wallet and press "I have paid". See [how to pay with Bitcoin](/blog/how-to-pay-with-bitcoin/) and the other coin guides.
- **Cash App, Apple Pay and Chime:** we email you the payment details after you place the order, with a link to a private tap-to-copy page. You pay, add your order ID in the note and upload a screenshot. See [how payment details reach you](/blog/how-payment-details-reach-you/).
- **Gift cards:** we send a buy link and an upload link. You buy a card for the amount due and upload the details. See [how gift card payment works](/blog/how-gift-card-payment-works/).

Pay within 24 hours of ordering, because unpaid orders may be released so stock is not held indefinitely.

## Step 5: we confirm your payment
Crypto on most networks is matched automatically. Other methods are checked by a team member, which is quickest during business hours, Monday to Friday, 8AM to 5PM Arizona time. When your payment is confirmed you receive an email and your order status changes to payment confirmed. Orders may also be reviewed for accuracy and security, and if yours is under review we will contact you the same day.

## Step 6: processing and dispatch
Orders have a processing time of 24 to 72 business hours, and most ship within 48 hours. Business days are Monday to Friday, and we do not process orders on weekends or federal holidays; your order continues processing the next business day. When your order ships you receive a tracking email with the carrier and tracking number. Tracking can take some time to start updating after the label is created. See [shipping times from Phoenix, Arizona](/blog/shipping-times-from-phoenix-arizona/) and [how to track your order](/blog/how-to-track-your-order/).

## Step 7: carrier delivery
We use regional carriers to deliver parcels, so transit time depends on where you live. Our published estimates are 3 to 7 business days for the West Coast (Arizona, Nevada, Washington and Idaho) and 11 to 18 business days for the eastern half of the US. Weather, holidays and signature attempts can add days. Plan for the longer end if you are in the east, and order early if you need a product by a certain date.

## Step 8: delivery with adult signature
Federal rules require adult signature confirmation (21+) for packages containing vapor products. The recipient shows government-issued photo ID to the delivery employee. If no one is available to sign and the carrier returns the parcel, we process a refund minus the 15% restocking fee and the shipping cost, as described in the [shipping policy](/shipping/). See [adult signature on delivery](/blog/adult-signature-on-delivery-what-to-expect/) to prepare, and [discreet packaging](/blog/discreet-packaging-what-to-expect/) for what the parcel looks like.

## What each status means
Your private order page shows a status at each stage: awaiting payment, payment details sent, proof submitted, payment detected, payment confirmed, shipped or cancelled. Each is explained in [order status meanings](/blog/order-status-meanings/).

## If something needs to change
Contact us as early as you can with your order ID. Before the order is processing we can often update flavors, quantities and the address. After it is handed to the carrier we cannot. See [how to change or cancel an order](/blog/how-to-change-or-cancel-an-order/).

## Where to get help
Use the support chat on any page, the [contact page](/contact/), WhatsApp, phone or email. Customer service hours are Monday to Friday, 8AM to 5PM Arizona time. Include your order ID. If a confirmation email does not arrive, read [order confirmation emails not arriving](/blog/order-confirmation-email-not-arriving/). See [how to contact support](/blog/how-to-contact-support/).

## Returns, refunds and problems
Returns must be arranged within 30 days of purchase, and opened or used e-liquid, devices and accessories cannot be returned. Refunds go back through the payment method the payment was received through, less a 15% restocking fee. Puffco products do not qualify for refunds or exchanges. If a parcel arrives damaged, photograph the items and the invoice straight away and email us. Read [refund and return policy explained](/blog/refund-and-return-policy-explained/) and [damaged or missing items](/blog/damaged-or-missing-items-what-to-do/).

## A typical timeline
Here is how a normal order might run. You order on a Monday morning and pay within an hour. We confirm payment that afternoon. Processing takes 24 to 72 business hours, and your order ships on Wednesday. The tracking email arrives, and if you are on the West Coast the parcel is delivered in 3 to 7 business days, so between the following Monday and the Monday after. If you are in the eastern half of the country, allow 11 to 18 business days, so roughly two to three and a half weeks. These are estimates, not guarantees, and signature attempts can add time.

## Tips for a smooth order
- Choose options on the product page before you add to cart.
- Double-check the address and use one where an adult can sign.
- Pay promptly and upload proof straight away if your method needs it.
- Keep your confirmation email and order ID.
- Watch for the tracking email and the delivery window.
- Contact us early if anything needs to change.

Browse [disposable vapes](/shop/disposables/), [vape juice](/shop/vape-juice/) and [vape kits](/shop/vape-kits/) when you are ready. All products are for adults aged 21 and over, and nicotine is addictive.

## Frequently asked questions in depth
### Do I need an account to order?
No. You can check out as a guest. Your cart and wishlist are saved in your browser on this device, and each order email contains a private link to that order, so you can follow it without signing in.

### What if I want to order the same items again?
Your order confirmation lists everything you bought, including the options you chose. Add the same products to your cart again, choose the same options and check out. If you are ordering regularly, our [bulk buying tips](/blog/bulk-buying-vapes-save-money/) explain how to reduce your cost per item.

### Can I order for someone else?
You can ship to another adult's address, but delivery needs an adult aged 21 or older to sign and show photo ID, so make sure they will be there. Tell us in the order notes if the recipient's name is different from yours.

### What if a product is out of stock?
Out-of-stock products cannot be added to an order. If an item you want is unavailable, check related products on the same page, or contact us and we will tell you when it may be back.

### What if I am ordering for my shop?
Retailers can ask about wholesale pricing through the [wholesale page](/wholesale/). See the [wholesale ordering guide](/blog/wholesale-ordering-guide/) for how larger orders work.

faq.q: What is the minimum order?
faq.a: The minimum order is $100 before discounts. Orders of $200 or more after discount and before tax ship free on most of the 48 contiguous states.

faq.q: How long does processing take?
faq.a: 24 to 72 business hours, and most orders ship within 48 hours. We do not process orders on weekends or federal holidays.

faq.q: How long does delivery take after shipping?
faq.a: Our published estimates are 3 to 7 business days for the West Coast and 11 to 18 business days for the eastern half of the US, using regional carriers.

faq.q: Why is a signature required?
faq.a: Federal rules require adult signature confirmation (21+) with government photo ID for packages containing vapor products.

faq.q: Can I change my order?
faq.a: Often yes, before it is processing. Contact us with your order ID as soon as possible. After the carrier has the parcel, we cannot change it.

faq.q: Where do refunds go?
faq.a: Back through the payment method the payment was received through, less a 15% restocking fee where it applies.

title: Minimum Order and Free Shipping Explained
summary: We have a $100 minimum order and free shipping from $200 after discount. See how the numbers work with discounts and flat shipping.
body:
Two numbers decide your total at checkout at One Stop Vape Store: the minimum order and the free-shipping threshold. They are simple on their own, but they interact with the 10% discount for cryptocurrency and gift cards in a way that surprises many customers. This guide explains both numbers, how the discount changes the free-shipping check, which areas are excluded from free shipping, how to plan your cart to land on the best total and what to do if you are close to a threshold. It follows our published [shipping policy](/shipping/) and is written for adults aged 21 and over.

## Minimum order: $100
Checkout requires a product subtotal of at least $100 before any discount. The cart page shows how much more you need if you fall short, and checkout will not complete until you reach it. The minimum applies to the value of the products, not to shipping or tax. It exists so that we can keep wholesale-competitive pricing and process orders efficiently. If you only need a small amount, consider combining a few items you will use over time, or ordering together with a friend.

## Free shipping: $200 or more after discount
Free domestic shipping applies to orders of $200 or more after discount and before tax, for most of the 48 contiguous U.S. states. Orders below that pay the flat shipping fee shown in your order summary, currently $15. The check is made on the amount after any discount, and before any tax, so the order summary always shows exactly what will be charged. If your order qualifies, shipping shows as free in the summary, and if it does not, the flat fee is added to the total.

## How the 10% discount interacts
If you pay with cryptocurrency or a supported gift card, you get 10% off the product subtotal, and the free-shipping check is applied after that discount. This is the part that surprises people. A $210 cart paid with crypto becomes $189.00 after the discount, which is under $200, so it does not qualify and the $15 fee is added, making $204.00. The same $210 cart paid with Cash App has no discount, stays above $200 and ships free, so it totals $210.00. Read the full explanation in [how the 10% discount works](/blog/crypto-discount-how-it-works/).

## Worked examples
- **$100 cart, Cash App:** no discount, under $200, so $100.00 plus $15.00 shipping is $115.00.
- **$100 cart, crypto:** $10.00 discount gives $90.00, plus $15.00 shipping, so $105.00.
- **$150 cart, Cash App:** $150.00 plus $15.00 is $165.00.
- **$150 cart, crypto:** $135.00 plus $15.00 is $150.00.
- **$200 cart, Cash App:** exactly $200, so shipping is free and the total is $200.00.
- **$200 cart, crypto:** $180.00 after discount is under $200, so $15.00 is added, giving $195.00. Crypto is still $5.00 cheaper.
- **$215 cart, crypto:** $193.50 after discount, so $15.00 is added, giving $208.50. Compare Cash App at $215.00 with free shipping: crypto is $6.50 cheaper.
- **$230 cart, crypto:** $207.00 after discount, so shipping is free, and the total is $207.00. Cash App is $230.00.
- **$300 cart, crypto:** $270.00 after discount, shipping free, total $270.00.

In almost every case the discount still beats the flat fee, but the saving shrinks when the discount pushes you under the free-shipping line.

## Where free shipping does not apply
Free shipping is valid for most of the 48 contiguous U.S. states. It does not apply to Alaska, Hawaii, Puerto Rico, Guam, the U.S. Virgin Islands or APO, DPO, FPO and other U.S. military addresses. We do not ship internationally, and orders placed with an international address will be cancelled and refunded. See [where we ship and where we do not](/blog/where-we-ship-and-where-we-do-not/).

## How to plan your cart
1. **Decide your payment method first,** because the discount changes the maths.
2. **Look at the order summary** for each method and compare totals.
3. **If you are just under a threshold,** consider whether one more item gets you over it.
4. **If the discount drops you under $200,** compare the final totals before you pay.
5. **If you need only a little more to reach $100,** add a small item you will use.

Combining items to cross a threshold is also a good way to stock up. See [bulk buying tips](/blog/bulk-buying-vapes-save-money/).

## Does the minimum include the discount?
No. The $100 minimum is checked on the product subtotal before the discount. A $100 cart paid with crypto is allowed, and the discount takes it to $90.00 before shipping.

## Is tax included in the check?
Free shipping is measured after discount and before tax, so tax does not push you over or under the line. Any tax that applies is shown in your order summary before you pay.

## Do options and quantities count?
Yes. The subtotal is the sum of every line at the price for the option you chose, multiplied by the quantity. If you change a strength or pack size on a product page, the line price changes, and so does the subtotal.

## Common questions
### Can I split an order to get free shipping twice?
Free shipping is measured per order. Splitting a larger order into two smaller ones usually costs more, because each could fall under the threshold and each pays shipping. Keep it as one order where you can.

### What if my cart is just under $200?
Check whether adding a small item gets you over the line. If you are paying with crypto or a gift card, remember that the check is after the discount, so you need a subtotal of about $222.23 or more to reach $200 after a 10% discount.

### Does shipping speed change with the free option?
No. Free and paid shipping use the same processing time of 24 to 72 business hours and the same regional carriers. See [shipping times from Phoenix, Arizona](/blog/shipping-times-from-phoenix-arizona/).

### Is the minimum order negotiable for retailers?
Wholesale orders are arranged separately. See the [wholesale ordering guide](/blog/wholesale-ordering-guide/) and [how to become a wholesale customer](/blog/how-to-become-a-wholesale-customer/).

## Why the rules exist
The minimum order lets us offer competitive pricing and process orders efficiently. The free-shipping line rewards larger orders, which cost less to ship per item. Measuring free shipping after the discount keeps the offer consistent whichever method you use: it depends on what you actually pay for products, not on a list price.

## Putting it together
Pick your items, choose the options you want, compare the order summary for each payment method and choose the one that costs you least while suiting your habits. If you are close to a threshold, a small change can save you the shipping fee. For help, message us through the [contact page](/contact/) before you pay. Browse [disposable vapes](/shop/disposables/) and [vape juice](/shop/vape-juice/). All products are for adults aged 21 and over, and nicotine is addictive.

## More ways to think about your total
### Compare the cost per item, not only the total
A larger order spreads the shipping fee across more items. If you are paying $15 on a $100 order, shipping adds 15% to the cost. On a $200 order that ships free, it adds nothing. Thinking in terms of cost per item makes it easier to decide whether to add a few more products now or order again later. If you vape regularly and the products keep well, a larger order less often is usually the better value. See [how to store e-liquid](/blog/how-to-store-e-liquid/) and [how to store disposable vapes](/blog/how-to-store-disposable-vapes/) so that stock stays in good condition.

### Do not buy what you will not use
It is tempting to add filler to reach $200. Choose items you will actually use, because an unused product is wasted money, and opened items cannot be returned. If you are a few dollars short, a small accessory or a spare pod you will need anyway is a better choice than something you are unsure about.

### Remember that options change the price
If you choose a larger pack size or a different strength, the line price changes, and so does your subtotal. Check the order summary after you change an option, because it can move you across a threshold in either direction.

### Ask us if you are stuck
If you are close to a threshold and cannot decide, message us through the [contact page](/contact/) with what you want to buy. We will work through the numbers with you and point out whether a small change saves the shipping fee.

### A quick formula for the free-shipping line
If you are paying by crypto or gift card, divide $200 by 0.9 to find the subtotal you need: about $222.23. If you are paying by Cash App, Apple Pay or Chime, you need a subtotal of $200. Keep those two numbers in mind when you plan a cart, and check the order summary to confirm. If you are somewhere between the two, the app route may give free shipping while the discounted route adds the $15 fee, and the discounted route can still be cheaper overall, so always compare the final totals rather than guessing.

### What if I am ordering for a group?
Some customers combine an order with friends or colleagues to reach $200 or more and share the shipping saving. If you do, make sure one adult will receive and sign for the parcel, and agree who pays what before you order, because each order has a single payment method and a single delivery address.

title: Shipping Times From Phoenix, Arizona: What to Expect
summary: Processing time plus carrier transit equals your delivery time. See our published estimates for the West Coast and the eastern half of the US.
body:
Delivery time has two parts: how long we take to process your order, and how long the carrier takes to deliver it. Understanding both helps you plan, especially if you need a product by a certain date. This guide explains our processing time, the carrier transit estimates published in our [shipping policy](/shipping/), why times vary across the country, what can add days, how to plan around them, what to do if a parcel is late and what our shipping area covers. It is written for adults aged 21 and over, and all estimates are estimates, not guarantees.

## Processing: 24 to 72 business hours
All orders have a processing time of 24 to 72 business hours, and most ship within 48 hours. The clock starts once your payment is confirmed, not when you place the order, so paying promptly matters. Business days are Monday to Friday. We do not process orders on weekends or federal holidays, and your order continues processing the following business day. Orders may also be reviewed to ensure security and accuracy, and if yours is under review we will contact you the same day.

### What happens during processing
Your order is checked against the products and options you selected, picked from our Stock Warehouse in Phoenix, Arizona, packed in standard discreet packaging, labelled for adult signature delivery and handed to the carrier. A tracking email is then sent automatically. You do not need to do anything during processing, but you can follow the status on your private order page. See [order status meanings](/blog/order-status-meanings/).

## Carrier transit
After processing, a tracking email is sent automatically to confirm the package is in the final stages of fulfillment. Carrier delivery times vary by region. Our published estimates are:

- **West Coast (Arizona, Nevada, Washington and Idaho):** 3 to 7 business days in transit.
- **Eastern half of the US:** 11 to 18 business days in transit.

Those ranges are in business days, Monday to Friday, so a parcel that ships on a Wednesday and has a 3 to 7 business-day estimate would typically arrive between the following Monday and the Monday after.

## Why times vary
We use regional carriers rather than one national network, so speed depends on where you live and on how your parcel is routed. A parcel to Arizona or a neighboring state moves quickly. A parcel to the east passes through more hand-offs and takes longer. Weather, holidays, high-volume periods and adult-signature attempts can add days. Errors and delays caused by regional carriers are outside our control, but we will help you follow up. Read [what to do if your package is delayed](/blog/what-to-do-if-your-package-is-delayed/).

## Adding it up: a timeline
Here is a realistic picture for two customers who order on a Monday and pay the same day.

### A customer in Nevada
Payment is confirmed on Monday. Processing takes 24 to 72 business hours, so the parcel ships between Tuesday and Thursday, most likely by Wednesday. Transit takes 3 to 7 business days, so delivery falls between the following Monday and the Monday after that. In total, roughly one to two weeks from ordering.

### A customer in New York
Payment is confirmed on Monday, and the parcel ships by Wednesday. Transit takes 11 to 18 business days, so delivery falls roughly in the third to fifth week after ordering. If you are in the east, plan well ahead and do not leave it until you are running low.

## Signature attempts and delays
Delivery requires an adult aged 21 or older to sign and show photo ID. If no one is available, the carrier typically leaves a notice and tries again, which can add a day or more. If the parcel is returned because no one was available to sign, we process a refund minus the 15% restocking fee and the shipping cost. Choose an address where an adult is usually present, and watch your tracking email. See [adult signature on delivery](/blog/adult-signature-on-delivery-what-to-expect/).

## Planning tips
- **Order early** if you want a product by a certain date, especially in the eastern half of the country.
- **Pay promptly,** because processing starts when payment is confirmed.
- **Use an address where an adult is usually present,** such as a workplace if allowed.
- **Keep your phone number current,** so the carrier can reach you.
- **Watch the tracking email** for the carrier and tracking number.
- **Allow for holidays,** because processing and carrier schedules slow down around them.

## Tracking after it ships
Tracking can take some time to start updating after the label is created, so do not worry if it shows little at first. Use the carrier's website with the tracking number from your email, and your private order page for our own status. See [how to track your order](/blog/how-to-track-your-order/).

## If your package is late
First, check the tracking and compare the date with the estimate for your region. If the time exceeds the range, contact us through the [contact page](/contact/) with your order ID. We will help you follow up with the carrier. Our shipping policy describes how lost, stolen and damaged shipments are handled, including package protection where it applies, and the guides on [what to do if your package is delayed](/blog/what-to-do-if-your-package-is-delayed/) and [damaged or missing items](/blog/damaged-or-missing-items-what-to-do/) explain the steps.

## Where we ship
We ship within the United States, and free shipping is valid for most of the 48 contiguous states. We do not ship to Guam, the U.S. Virgin Islands, Puerto Rico, Hawaii, Alaska or APO, DPO and FPO military addresses with free shipping, and we do not offer international shipping. Orders placed with international shipping will be cancelled and refunded. See [where we ship and where we do not](/blog/where-we-ship-and-where-we-do-not/).

## Frequently asked questions in depth
### Does paying with crypto speed up delivery?
Crypto on most networks is matched automatically, so your payment can be confirmed outside business hours, which starts processing sooner. Delivery time after shipping depends on the carrier.

### Does free shipping take longer?
No. Free and paid shipping use the same processing time and carriers.

### Can I pay for faster shipping?
Our published estimates apply to every order. If timing is critical, contact us before you order and we will advise what is realistic.

### What if I need a delivery date?
We cannot guarantee dates, because carrier times vary. Use the ranges as a guide, and order early.

## Related reading
See [how ordering works](/blog/how-ordering-works/) for the full journey, [minimum order and free shipping explained](/blog/minimum-order-and-free-shipping-explained/) for costs and [refund and return policy explained](/blog/refund-and-return-policy-explained/) for returns. Browse [disposable vapes](/shop/disposables/) and [vape juice](/shop/vape-juice/). All products are for adults aged 21 and over, and nicotine is addictive.

## How to read delivery estimates sensibly
Estimates are ranges because real journeys vary. The lower end is what happens when everything goes smoothly: the parcel is scanned quickly, takes a direct route and is delivered on the first attempt. The higher end allows for slower routing, weather and a missed signature. Plan around the higher end if the date matters, and treat the lower end as a pleasant bonus. If you are ordering for a particular day, add a few business days of buffer beyond the upper estimate.

### Holidays and busy periods
Around federal holidays and during busy shopping periods, processing and carrier networks both slow down. Orders placed just before a long weekend start processing on the next business day, and carriers may run reduced schedules. If you are ordering around a holiday, expect the upper end of every range and place your order earlier than you normally would.

### What you can control
You cannot change how fast a carrier moves a parcel, but you can control four things: paying promptly so processing starts sooner, choosing an address where an adult can sign on the first attempt, keeping your phone reachable and acting quickly on delivery notices. Together these remove most avoidable delays, and they cost nothing.

### If your region sits between the two ranges
The published ranges cover the West Coast and the eastern half of the country. If you live in between, expect a time between the two estimates, nearer the lower end if you are close to Arizona and nearer the upper end if you are closer to the east. If you need a firmer idea, contact us with your state and we will tell you what customers there typically see.

### Frequently asked questions in depth
**Do you ship from the same place every time?** Yes. Orders ship from our Stock Warehouse at 4908 E McDowell Road, Phoenix, Arizona. That is why the West Coast sees the shortest transit times and the east the longest.

**Will I get an email when my order leaves?** Yes. After processing, a tracking email is sent automatically with the carrier and tracking number.

**Does the estimate include the processing time?** No. The 3 to 7 and 11 to 18 business-day ranges are carrier transit time after the order ships. Add 24 to 72 business hours of processing before that.

**What if I order on a Friday?** If your payment is confirmed on a Friday, processing starts that day or the next business day, and weekends are not counted. Your order is likely to ship early in the following week.

faq.a: 24 to 72 business hours from payment confirmation, and most orders ship within 48 hours. We do not process on weekends or federal holidays.

faq.q: How long does the carrier take?
faq.a: Our published estimates are 3 to 7 business days for the West Coast (Arizona, Nevada, Washington, Idaho) and 11 to 18 business days for the eastern half of the US.

faq.q: Why are the times so different?
faq.a: We use regional carriers, so speed depends on where you live and how the parcel is routed.

faq.q: What can cause delays?
faq.a: Weather, holidays, busy periods and missed adult-signature attempts.

faq.q: What if my parcel is later than the estimate?
faq.a: Contact us with your order ID and we will help you follow up with the carrier.

faq.a: No. Orders placed with international addresses are cancelled and refunded.

title: How to Track Your Order and Understand Each Status
summary: Your order moves through statuses from awaiting payment to shipped. Learn where to see updates and what each message means.
body:
Every order at One Stop Vape Store has an order ID, a private status page and, once it ships, a tracking number. Knowing where to look for each one means you always know what is happening with your order and what, if anything, you need to do. This guide explains your order ID, the private status page, each status you may see, how package tracking works, how long it takes to start updating, what to do when nothing seems to move and how to get help. It is written for adults aged 21 and over.

## Your order ID
When you place an order you receive an ID such as OSV-XXXXXX in the confirmation email and on screen. It identifies your order everywhere: in emails, on your private page and when you contact support. Keep it handy, and include it in any message to us, because it lets us find your order immediately. If you pay with an app, add it in the payment note too.

## Where to look
Use the link in your confirmation email to open the private status page. The link contains a unique token, so only someone who has it can open the page, and no sign-in is needed. The page shows the amount due, payment instructions where relevant, the current status and any updates. Bookmark it, or keep the email, because it is the easiest way to check your order at any time. Do not share the link, because it gives access to your order details.

## Status meanings
Your order moves through a sequence of statuses. Each tells you what is happening and whether you need to act.

- **Awaiting payment:** your order is saved and we are waiting for payment or sending you details. For crypto, make or complete the transfer. For Cash App, Apple Pay or Chime, watch for our details. For gift cards, buy the card and upload it.
- **Payment details sent:** we have emailed or messaged you how to pay. Pay the exact amount and upload your receipt.
- **Proof submitted:** you uploaded a screenshot, a transaction hash or gift card details, and we are checking them, normally within business hours.
- **Payment detected on-chain:** a crypto transfer is visible on the network and awaiting confirmation. No action is needed unless it stays that way for a long time.
- **Payment confirmed:** we have confirmed your payment and the order is being prepared. You receive an email.
- **Shipped:** your package has left, and tracking is on its way.
- **Cancelled:** the order was cancelled, for example because payment was not received in time.

A fuller explanation of each is in [order status meanings](/blog/order-status-meanings/).

## Tracking the package
After processing, a tracking email arrives with the carrier and the tracking number. We use regional carriers, so the carrier's name and tracking page may be less familiar than a national courier's. Open the carrier's tracking page, enter the number and follow the progress. Tracking can take some time to start updating after the label is created, because the carrier scans the parcel only when it first moves through its system. A tracking number that shows no movement for a day or two is not unusual.

## What the tracking events mean
Different carriers use different wording, but the stages are similar:

- **Label created:** the carrier has been told about the parcel but does not have it yet.
- **Accepted or picked up:** the parcel is in the carrier's hands.
- **In transit:** it is moving between facilities.
- **Out for delivery:** it is on the vehicle for your address. An adult 21+ must be available to sign.
- **Delivery attempted:** no one was available to sign. The carrier usually leaves a notice and tries again.
- **Delivered:** the parcel has been signed for.

If the event feed pauses for several days, that is common on long routes. Compare the dates with our estimates: 3 to 7 business days in transit for the West Coast and 11 to 18 business days for the eastern half of the US. See [shipping times from Phoenix, Arizona](/blog/shipping-times-from-phoenix-arizona/).

## No update?
Allow the processing time described in the [shipping policy](/shipping/): 24 to 72 business hours after payment is confirmed, excluding weekends and federal holidays. If that time has passed and your status has not changed, or if your tracking has shown nothing for longer than the estimate for your region, contact us through the [contact page](/contact/) with your order ID. We will check the order and the carrier. For late packages, see [what to do if your package is delayed](/blog/what-to-do-if-your-package-is-delayed/).

## Get ready for delivery
Delivery needs an adult aged 21 or older to sign and show government-issued photo ID. Watch the tracking for the out-for-delivery event, and make sure someone is available. Keep your phone number current, because the carrier may call. Read [adult signature on delivery](/blog/adult-signature-on-delivery-what-to-expect/) so you know what to expect, and [discreet packaging](/blog/discreet-packaging-what-to-expect/) for what the parcel looks like.

## If something looks wrong
- **Wrong address on the tracking:** contact us immediately. We can sometimes help before the carrier has the parcel, but not after.
- **Status stuck on awaiting payment:** check whether you completed the payment steps, and look for our email. See [how payment details reach you](/blog/how-payment-details-reach-you/).
- **Proof submitted for a long time:** it is a manual check, quickest during business hours. If it is outside the normal time, contact us.
- **Delivered but you do not have it:** check with neighbors and the delivery address, then contact us. See [damaged or missing items](/blog/damaged-or-missing-items-what-to-do/).

## Tips
- Save your confirmation email and your order ID.
- Keep your phone number current so the carrier can reach you.
- Check the status page after paying, to confirm the order moves forward.
- Use the carrier's tracking page for the latest movement.
- Contact us early, not after weeks, if something looks wrong.

## Frequently asked questions in depth
### Can I track an order without the email?
Contact us with your name and email and we will resend the link. For security, we confirm the details on the order first.

### Why does the carrier show different dates from your estimate?
Carriers publish their own scan times, which can differ from our estimates. Use both as guides.

### Does tracking show the signature?
Most carriers record that the parcel was signed for, and some show the signer's name. It confirms delivery.

### Can I change the address after it ships?
No. After the parcel is handed to the carrier we cannot change the address or contents. See [how to change or cancel an order](/blog/how-to-change-or-cancel-an-order/).

Browse [vape juice](/shop/vape-juice/) and [disposable vapes](/shop/disposables/). All products are for adults aged 21 and over, and nicotine is addictive.

## Tracking tips that save time
### Use the right link for the right question
Our private order page answers questions about payment, processing and our own status. The carrier's tracking page answers questions about where the parcel is. If you are asking "has my payment been confirmed?" use our page. If you are asking "where is my parcel?" use the carrier's page. Mixing them up is the most common reason people think an order is stuck when it is not.

### Set up notifications
Many carriers let you subscribe to text or email updates from the tracking page, using your tracking number. Doing so means you hear about an out-for-delivery event as soon as it happens, which helps you be present to sign. Keep your phone number current on the order so the carrier can reach you if the address needs clarifying.

### Keep a record
Screenshot the tracking page when it shows a delivery attempt or a delivered status. If a parcel is later reported missing or damaged, those records help us and the carrier investigate quickly. Keep your confirmation email, the tracking email and any delivery notices together until the order is complete.

### Know when to wait and when to write
Waiting is right when the tracking is within the estimate for your region and the status is moving, even slowly. Writing to us is right when the estimate has passed, when the tracking shows an exception such as a returned parcel or when the status has not changed for longer than the processing time. Include your order ID and a screenshot of the tracking page, and we can usually tell you what is happening within the same business day.

### Frequently asked questions in depth
**What if the tracking number does not work?** Wait a day. Tracking numbers often take time to activate after the label is created. If it still does not work after a day or two, send us the number and your order ID and we will check it.

**Can I track from my phone?** Yes. Our private order page and the carrier's tracking page both work on a phone, and your confirmation email has the link to the first.

**Will the carrier tell me before delivery?** Many carriers offer text or email alerts if you subscribe through their tracking page. It is worth doing, because it helps you be available to sign.

**What does it mean if tracking says the parcel was returned?** It means the carrier is sending it back, often because no adult was available to sign. Contact us right away with your order ID to discuss the options.

faq.q: What if my status does not change?

title: Adult Signature on Delivery: What to Expect and How to Prepare
summary: Every vape delivery needs an adult signature with photo ID. Here is how the process works and how to avoid missed deliveries.
body:
Packages containing vaping products require adult signature confirmation, and this applies in every state. It can be a surprise if you have never ordered vapor products online, because most parcels are left at the door. This guide explains what the rule means, who can sign, what ID the carrier asks for, how to prepare, what happens if you miss the delivery, why the rule exists and how it connects with other parts of our service such as packaging and refunds. It follows our published [shipping policy](/shipping/) and is written for adults aged 21 and over.

## What the rule means
In accordance with federal law, all vape mail orders require the use of Adult Signature Confirmation (21+) on delivery for packages containing e-cigarette related products. The carrier asks the recipient to sign and to show a government-issued photo identification that confirms they are 21 or older. The delivery employee compares the ID with the delivery and may record the details. A parcel is not left unattended, and it is not handed to a minor.

## What counts as acceptable ID
The carrier accepts a current, valid government-issued photo ID that shows your date of birth, such as a driver's license, a state ID card or a passport. The ID must be unexpired and legible, and it needs to show that you are at least 21. Digital copies and photos of IDs are generally not accepted, so have the physical document ready.

## Who can sign
An adult aged 21 or over. The recipient name should match the ID where the carrier requires it. If another adult at the address will receive the parcel, tell us in the order notes and check with the carrier, because some carriers require the named recipient to sign and others allow any adult at the address. If you are not sure, it is simplest to be present yourself, or to choose an address where the named person will be.

## Preparing for delivery
- **Keep a valid photo ID ready,** where you can reach it quickly.
- **Watch your tracking email** for the delivery window.
- **Be available during the likely window,** or arrange for an authorized adult to be.
- **Consider a workplace address,** if your employer allows it and someone is usually present.
- **Keep your phone on,** because the carrier may call to coordinate.
- **Make sure the address is complete,** including apartment or suite numbers.

See [shipping address tips](/blog/shipping-address-tips/) for more on choosing an address, and [shipping times from Phoenix, Arizona](/blog/shipping-times-from-phoenix-arizona/) for how long delivery takes.

## What the delivery looks like
The delivery employee arrives, asks for the recipient, checks the ID against the age requirement and asks for a signature, often on a handheld device. The process takes a minute or two. If no adult is available to sign, the parcel is not left, and the employee records an attempt. The ID check is mandatory and not something the delivery employee can waive, even for a regular customer.

## If you miss delivery
Carriers typically leave a notice and retry, and after a limited number of attempts return the package to the sender. If the package is returned because no one was available to sign, we can issue a refund less the 15% restocking fee and the shipping cost, as explained in the [shipping policy](/shipping/). That is why it matters to plan: a missed delivery can cost you more than the delay. If you see a delivery notice, contact the carrier to arrange a redelivery window as soon as you can, and let us know if you need help.

## Why this rule exists
Adult signature confirmation is part of federal and state rules for remote vape sales, designed to keep age-restricted products out of the hands of minors. It is covered in our [PACT Act overview](/blog/pact-act-explained-for-vape-buyers/) and in [what 21+ age verification means](/blog/what-21-plus-age-verification-means/). We apply it to every order, whatever the payment method or the size of the order, because the rule applies to the product.

## Packaging
Parcels are shipped in standard packaging without product names or logos on the outside, but packages carry the labels required by law. See [discreet packaging](/blog/discreet-packaging-what-to-expect/) for details. The label does not change the signature requirement.

## Common situations
### I live in an apartment building
Give the complete address including the unit number, and tell the carrier how to reach you, such as a buzzer code. If a front desk accepts packages, check whether they can sign for adult-signature parcels, because many cannot.

### I work from several places
Choose the address where an adult is most likely to be present during the day, and let us know in the order notes if there is a specific contact.

### Someone else will receive it
Tell us in the order notes and check with the carrier. The person needs to be 21 or older and show ID.

### The name on my ID is different
Use a name that matches your ID for the order, or tell us in the notes. A mismatch can cause the carrier to refuse delivery.

## Frequently asked questions in depth
### Can I request a different delivery option?
Adult signature is required, so there is no option to leave the parcel unattended. You can arrange the best time and place through the carrier's tracking page.

### Does the rule apply to wholesale orders?
Yes. Adult signature applies to every shipment of vapor products.

### What if the carrier says my ID is not valid?
Ask which part is a problem. If it is expired or illegible, you will need a valid ID to receive the parcel, and we can help if redelivery is needed.

### Will you ever ask me to send a photo of my ID?
We confirm age through the age gate and checkout. If we ever need further verification, we will explain why and how, and we will never ask for it in an unexpected message. See our [privacy policy](/privacy/).

## Related reading
Read [how ordering works](/blog/how-ordering-works/) and [what to do if your package is delayed](/blog/what-to-do-if-your-package-is-delayed/). Ask questions through the [contact page](/contact/). Browse [disposable vapes](/shop/disposables/). All products are for adults aged 21 and over, and nicotine is addictive.

## Making delivery easy
### Talk to the carrier early
When your tracking email arrives, open the carrier's tracking page and look for delivery options. Many carriers let you pick a delivery window, request a redelivery, or hold the parcel at a facility where you can collect it with ID. These options are not always available for adult-signature parcels, but when they are, they remove most of the stress. If you cannot find them, call the carrier's customer service with the tracking number.

### Think about timing
Delivery windows are often during working hours. If you work away from home, consider a workplace address, ask a trusted adult at home to be present or take a short break at the expected time. If you live in a building with a front desk, ask whether staff can sign for adult-signature parcels, because many cannot, and the carrier may need to return when you are present.

### Be courteous
Delivery employees are following federal rules and cannot make exceptions. A polite, prepared recipient with ID in hand makes the process quick for everyone. If you cannot be there, tell the carrier rather than leaving it to chance, because repeated failed attempts end in a returned parcel and a refund minus the 15% restocking fee and shipping cost.

### Keep the products out of reach afterward
Once you have signed for the parcel, store the contents away from children and pets, as explained in [keeping vapes away from children and pets](/blog/keeping-vapes-away-from-children-and-pets/). Responsible storage is part of using age-restricted products. Recycle the packaging, and keep the invoice until you are sure you will keep every item.

### Frequently asked questions in depth
**Does the carrier keep a copy of my ID?** Carriers check the ID and may record details such as the type and the last digits of the number, according to their own procedures. They do not usually keep a copy of the card.

**Can I sign for someone else's parcel?** Only if you are 21 or older and the carrier's rules allow it. If the parcel is addressed to another person, check the rules for that delivery before you assume you can sign.

**What if I look younger than I am?** The carrier will ask for ID, and that is exactly what it is for. Keep your ID ready, and the process is quick.

**Is there anything I can do before delivery day?** Check your tracking, confirm the address and phone number, tell anyone else at the address what to expect and make sure your ID is easy to find.

### A note on regional carriers
Because we use regional carriers, the delivery employee and the process can differ a little from what you may be used to with a national courier. The rule is the same everywhere: an adult 21 or older must sign and show government photo ID. If you are unsure how your local carrier handles a delivery, check the carrier's own help pages or call them with your tracking number before the day, and tell us if anything about the delivery arrangement concerns you so that we can pass it on.

### After the signature
Once you have signed, the parcel is yours. Check the contents against the invoice straight away and photograph anything that looks wrong before you discard the packaging, as explained in [damaged or missing items](/blog/damaged-or-missing-items-what-to-do/).

title: Discreet Packaging: What Your Parcel Looks Like on Arrival
summary: We ship in plain, standard cartons. Learn what is on the outside, what is on the label and what is inside your package.
body:
Your order arrives in a plain, sturdy carton without product names or logos on the outside. That is what most customers mean by discreet packaging, and it is how we ship every order. It does not mean the parcel is unlabelled: federal rules require a label on parcels containing vaping products, and adult signature is required on delivery. This guide explains what the outside and the inside of your parcel look like, why the legal label is there, how we protect your details, what to check when you open it, how to store your products and how packaging connects with returns and damage claims. It follows our [shipping policy](/shipping/) and is written for adults aged 21 and over.

## Outside the box
The exterior carries a shipping label with your address and our return address. There is no product description, no brand name and no logo on the outside, so the parcel looks like any ordinary shipment. Federal rules require a label on parcels containing vaping products, and the label states that federal law requires the payment of applicable excise taxes and compliance with licensing and tax-stamping obligations. This is a legal requirement for remote vape shipments, not a choice we make, and it applies to every seller. The label is small and factual, and it does not name the products inside.

## Inside the box
Items are packed with padding to reduce damage in transit. Bottles of liquid are sealed and upright where possible, wrapped to protect them from knocks, and devices are cushioned. An invoice with your order ID is included, listing what you ordered, so you can check the contents. If you ordered several products, they are packed together in a single carton where size allows. The packing is designed to survive regional carrier handling, which can involve several hand-offs.

## Why the label matters
The label is part of rules for remote vape shipments, which also require adult signature on delivery and compliance with state and federal tax obligations. Our [PACT Act overview](/blog/pact-act-explained-for-vape-buyers/) explains these rules in detail. The label also helps the carrier handle the parcel correctly, because it signals that signature is required. Removing or covering the label would be a problem for the carrier and for the delivery.

## Privacy of your details
We only use your information to fulfill the order and contact you. Your name and address appear on the shipping label, because the carrier needs them, and your order details are stored with your order in our systems. The outside of the box never carries product names, and the invoice inside lists the items only for you. Read the [privacy policy](/privacy/) for how we collect, use and protect information, and [why we need your email and phone](/blog/why-we-need-your-email-and-phone/).

## What the carrier sees
The carrier sees the label: the addresses, the adult-signature requirement and the legal statement. The carrier does not see the invoice inside, and the box does not describe its contents. That is the extent of the "discreet" part: it is about not advertising what is inside, not about hiding that the parcel contains a regulated product.

## Opening your parcel
Check the contents against your invoice as soon as you open the parcel. Look for damage to the box, the bottles and the devices. If something is damaged, photograph the items and the invoice immediately and email us, as described in our shipping policy; we will help you reorder damaged items. If something is missing, tell us right away with your order ID and a photo of the invoice and contents. See [damaged or missing items](/blog/damaged-or-missing-items-what-to-do/).

### A short checklist when you open it
1. Check the label on the box matches your name and address.
2. Open carefully, keeping the invoice and packing material.
3. Compare each item with the invoice.
4. Look for leaks, dents or cracks.
5. Photograph any problem straight away, before you throw anything away.
6. Contact us with your order ID and the photos.

## Storage after delivery
Keep products away from children and pets and out of heat and direct sunlight. Store e-liquid upright and capped in a cool, dark place, and store devices at room temperature. Do not leave products in a hot car or on a windowsill. See [how to store e-liquid](/blog/how-to-store-e-liquid/), [how to store disposable vapes](/blog/how-to-store-disposable-vapes/) and [keeping vapes away from children and pets](/blog/keeping-vapes-away-from-children-and-pets/). If you will not use a product for a long time, check its date and use older items first.

## Recycling the packaging
The carton and padding are ordinary packaging materials and can usually be recycled according to your local rules. Remove labels with your address before recycling if you prefer. Batteries and electronic devices should be taken to a collection point. See [how to dispose of vapes and batteries](/blog/how-to-dispose-of-vapes-and-batteries/).

## Returns and the original packaging
Our returns policy allows returns within 30 days for unopened items in original packaging, and opened or used products cannot be returned. Keep the original packaging and the invoice until you are sure you will keep an item. Refunds go back through the payment method the payment was received through, less a 15% restocking fee, and you are responsible for shipping the product back to us. Contact us before you return anything so we can provide an RMA form. See [refund and return policy explained](/blog/refund-and-return-policy-explained/) and the [refund policy](/refunds/).

## Frequently asked questions in depth
### Is the packaging completely plain?
The outside is plain, with no product names or logos, but it carries the shipping label and the legal label that federal rules require.

### Can I ask for different packaging?
We use standard packaging for all orders to keep the process consistent and compliant. If you have a specific concern, contact us before you order.

### Will the carrier know what is inside?
The carrier knows the parcel requires adult signature and carries the legal label. The box does not list the products.

### Will the invoice show prices?
The invoice shows your order ID and the items. If you need a different format for your records, contact us.

### Can I have it delivered to a locker or PO box?
Adult signature is required, so delivery must be to a street address where an adult can sign. See [shipping address tips](/blog/shipping-address-tips/).

## Related reading
Read [adult signature on delivery](/blog/adult-signature-on-delivery-what-to-expect/) and [how ordering works](/blog/how-ordering-works/). Browse [vape juice](/shop/vape-juice/) and [disposable vapes](/shop/disposables/). All products are for adults aged 21 and over, and nicotine is addictive.

## Common concerns about packaging
### Will neighbors or family know what is inside?
The outside does not name the contents or show a logo, so the parcel looks like any ordinary delivery. The legal label is small and factual. Delivery requires a signature from an adult, which a neighbor or family member may notice, but the signature requirement does not reveal the contents either.

### What about the return address?
The return address is our business address at 4908 E McDowell Road, Phoenix, Arizona, without a product description. It is there so that the carrier can return the parcel if delivery fails.

### Can I choose a different shipping name?
Use the name that matches the ID of the person who will sign, because the carrier may compare them. If the name on the order differs from the person receiving, tell us in the order notes.

### Is the invoice inside necessary?
It lists the items and the order ID so that you can check the contents and so that we can help quickly if something is wrong. Keep it until you have checked everything, and until any return window has passed.

### What if the packaging looks damaged on arrival?
Take photos of the outside and inside before you open anything else, and mention the carrier's name and the date. Photos of the box, the items and the invoice give us what we need to help. Then email us with your order ID. See [damaged or missing items](/blog/damaged-or-missing-items-what-to-do/).

### Frequently asked questions in depth
**Why does the carton not mention the shop?** To avoid advertising what is inside on the outside of a parcel that may sit on a doorstep or pass through many hands. The label contains only what is needed for delivery and what the law requires.

**Is the packaging recyclable?** The carton and padding are ordinary materials and can usually be recycled. Follow your local rules.

**Can I request extra padding?** We pack every order to survive regional carrier handling. If you order fragile or high-value items and have a concern, contact us before you order.

**Will the invoice be in the box if I have the order shipped elsewhere?** Yes. The invoice lists the items and order ID, and it goes in every parcel.

### If you are not at home when it arrives
Because adult signature is required, a parcel is not left on the doorstep. The carrier will leave a notice and try again, or hold the parcel for collection depending on its own rules. That means no one will find it unattended, which is part of how the process protects the contents and keeps age-restricted products out of the wrong hands. Follow the instructions on the notice, and have your ID ready when you collect or when the carrier returns.

### Keeping your own records
Keep the invoice, the tracking email and any delivery notices until you are sure you are happy with everything in the parcel. If you ever need to contact us about an item, the order ID on the invoice and the photos you took when you opened the box make it quick for us to help.

faq.a: A plain carton with a shipping label, our return address and the legal label federal rules require. There are no product names or logos.

faq.q: Why is there a legal label?
faq.a: Federal rules require a label on parcels containing vaping products, stating that federal law requires payment of excise taxes and compliance with licensing and tax-stamping obligations.

faq.q: What is inside the box?
faq.a: Your items, padded and sealed, plus an invoice with your order ID.

faq.q: What should I do if something is damaged?
faq.a: Photograph the items and the invoice immediately and email us. We will help you reorder damaged items.

faq.a: Keep the original packaging and invoice until you are sure you will keep an item, because returns require unopened items in original packaging.
