title: Order Status Meanings: Awaiting Payment, Proof Submitted and More
summary: Confused by an order status? This glossary explains each stage, what we are doing and what you may need to do next.
body:
Your private order page at One Stop Vape Store shows a status. Each status tells you what is happening to your order and what, if anything, you should do next. Understanding them takes the guesswork out of waiting, and it helps you spot when something needs attention. This guide explains every status in the order you are likely to see it, what triggers each change, how long each usually lasts, what to do at each stage and what to do if an order seems stuck. It is written for adults aged 21 and over.

## How statuses work
An order moves forward through a short sequence as payment is received and confirmed and the parcel is prepared and shipped. Some statuses depend on you, such as paying or uploading proof. Others depend on us, such as confirming payment and shipping. Some are automatic, such as a crypto payment being detected on the network. The status changes on your private page, and you receive an email at key points, so you do not have to keep refreshing. The link to your page is in your confirmation email.

## Awaiting payment
We have your order but no confirmed payment. This is the first status for every order. What to do depends on the method:

- **Cryptocurrency:** make or complete the transfer, and press "I have paid" in the payment window. See [how to pay with Bitcoin](/blog/how-to-pay-with-bitcoin/).
- **Cash App, Apple Pay and Chime:** watch for our details, which usually arrive within minutes in business hours. See [how payment details reach you](/blog/how-payment-details-reach-you/).
- **Gift cards:** buy the card and upload it through the private link. See [how gift card payment works](/blog/how-gift-card-payment-works/).

Pay within 24 hours of ordering, because unpaid orders may be released so stock is not held indefinitely.

## Payment details sent
We emailed or messaged you the details. Pay the exact amount, add your order ID in the note and upload your receipt. If you have not received the details, check spam and the email address you entered, and contact us if they do not arrive. See [order confirmation emails not arriving](/blog/order-confirmation-email-not-arriving/).

## Proof submitted
You uploaded a screenshot, a transaction hash or gift card details. A team member is reviewing it, normally within business hours, Monday to Friday, 8AM to 5PM Arizona time. You do not need to do anything unless we contact you. If you uploaded the wrong image or need to add information, tell us and upload again. See [how to upload a payment screenshot](/blog/how-to-upload-a-payment-screenshot/).

## Payment detected on-chain
For crypto, a transfer is visible on the network but not fully confirmed yet. This is automatic, and no action is needed unless it stays that way for a long time. The time depends on the network: Solana and Tron are usually quick, Ethereum and BNB Smart Chain take a few minutes, and Bitcoin often needs a block confirmation of around ten minutes. See [how we detect your crypto payment](/blog/how-we-detect-your-crypto-payment/). If the status shows underpaid instead, see [why your crypto payment shows underpaid](/blog/why-your-crypto-payment-shows-underpaid/).

## Payment confirmed
We have confirmed your payment, and your order enters processing. You receive an email. Processing takes 24 to 72 business hours, and most orders ship within 48 hours. Business days are Monday to Friday, and we do not process orders on weekends or federal holidays. Your order may also be reviewed to ensure security and accuracy, and if so we will contact you the same day. You do not need to do anything, but this is the last point at which changes are easy, so tell us now if something needs to change. See [how to change or cancel an order](/blog/how-to-change-or-cancel-an-order/).

## Shipped
Your package is on its way. A tracking email follows with the carrier and tracking number. Tracking can take some time to start updating after the label is created. Delivery needs an adult aged 21 or older to sign and show photo ID. See [how to track your order](/blog/how-to-track-your-order/) and [adult signature on delivery](/blog/adult-signature-on-delivery-what-to-expect/). Estimated transit is 3 to 7 business days for the West Coast and 11 to 18 business days for the eastern half of the US.

## Cancelled
The order was cancelled. The most common reason is that payment was not received in time. An order can also be cancelled at your request before it ships, or if it cannot be fulfilled lawfully, for example if the address is outside our shipping area. If you paid and the order is cancelled, refunds follow our policy and go back through the payment method used. If you did not expect the cancellation, contact us right away with your order ID.

## A typical sequence
For a crypto order: awaiting payment, payment detected, payment confirmed, shipped. For an app order: awaiting payment, payment details sent, proof submitted, payment confirmed, shipped. For a gift card order: awaiting payment, payment details sent, proof submitted, payment confirmed, shipped. Some steps pass quickly and you may not see them, because the page updates as events happen.

## How long should each status last?
- **Awaiting payment:** minutes to a few hours, depending on how quickly you pay.
- **Payment details sent:** until you pay.
- **Proof submitted:** typically within business hours of uploading.
- **Payment detected:** minutes, longer for Bitcoin.
- **Payment confirmed:** 24 to 72 business hours of processing.
- **Shipped:** the carrier's transit time, 3 to 7 or 11 to 18 business days depending on your region.

## What to do if stuck
If an order sits in one status longer than expected, contact us from the [contact page](/contact/) with your order ID. Tell us the status you see and when it last changed. Read [how ordering works](/blog/how-ordering-works/) for the typical timeline. Do not pay twice, and do not resend crypto, until we have checked what we can see.

## Emails you will receive
You receive an email when your order is placed, when payment details are sent where relevant, when payment is confirmed and when the order ships with tracking. If you do not see one, check spam. Emails come from our official address and always show your order ID.

## Frequently asked questions in depth
### Can I see the history of my statuses?
Your page shows the current status and the key updates. If you need the full history, contact us with your order ID.

### Does a status change mean something went wrong?
No. Statuses are normal stages. Only a long wait in one status, or a cancelled status you did not expect, calls for action.

### Can I go back to an earlier status?
Statuses move forward. If something needs to be redone, such as a second payment for a balance, we explain in the notes.

### Who updates the status?
Some changes are automatic, such as crypto detection. Others are made by our team after a check, such as confirming an app or gift card payment and marking an order shipped.

Browse [disposable vapes](/shop/disposables/) and see [uploading proof](/blog/how-to-upload-a-payment-screenshot/) for more. All products are for adults aged 21 and over, and nicotine is addictive.

## Reading statuses alongside your emails
### The email trail
Each important status change comes with an email. The first confirms your order and gives you the order ID and the private link. The next, for app and gift card methods, gives you the payment details. When payment is confirmed you receive another email, and when the order ships you receive the tracking email. If you have a status on the page but no matching email, check spam and promotions folders, because the status is always the most up to date source.

### What you can leave alone
A status that is moving normally needs no action. For example, payment detected on-chain will turn into payment confirmed on its own. Processing after confirmation will turn into shipped on its own. You do not need to message us to ask for it, and doing so does not speed it up. Save your messages for the times when a status has not changed for longer than expected.

### When a status asks you to act
Awaiting payment and payment details sent are the two that need action from you, because the next step depends on your payment. If you see either for longer than you expect, pay or upload proof, or contact us for help. If you see proof submitted for longer than a business day, contact us, because it may need extra information.

### Cancelled orders
If you see cancelled and did not expect it, contact us with your order ID. If payment arrives after an order has been cancelled, tell us right away so that we can match it and reinstate or refund the order, depending on the situation.

### Frequently asked questions in depth
**What is the difference between payment detected and payment confirmed?** Detected means a crypto transfer is visible on the network but not fully confirmed. Confirmed means we have matched it to your order and the order can be processed.

**Why does my app order say payment details sent for so long?** Because it is waiting for you to pay and upload proof. Pay the exact amount, add your order ID in the note and upload a screenshot.

**Will I be told if my order is under review?** Yes. If an order is reviewed for accuracy and security, we contact you the same day.

**Is there a status for returns?** Returns are handled by our team after you contact us and receive an RMA form. We explain each step by email.

faq.q: What does awaiting payment mean?
faq.a: We have your order but no confirmed payment yet. Pay by your chosen method and, where needed, upload proof.

faq.q: What does proof submitted mean?
faq.a: You uploaded a screenshot, hash or gift card details and a team member is checking them, normally within business hours.

faq.q: What does payment detected on-chain mean?
faq.a: A crypto transfer is visible on the network but not fully confirmed. It usually moves on automatically.

faq.q: What happens after payment confirmed?
faq.a: The order enters processing, which takes 24 to 72 business hours, and then ships with a tracking email.

faq.q: Why was my order cancelled?
faq.a: Usually because payment was not received in time, at your request before it shipped, or because it could not be fulfilled lawfully. Contact us if it was unexpected.

faq.q: What if my status does not change?
faq.a: Contact us with your order ID and the status you see, and when it last changed.

title: How to Change or Cancel an Order Before It Ships
summary: Need to swap a flavor, fix an address or cancel? The sooner you contact us, the more we can do. Here is the process.
body:
Mistakes happen: a wrong flavor, a typo in the address, a change of mind about the payment method. Many of them can be fixed if you contact us early, and the earlier the better, because an order gets harder to change the further it moves through processing and shipping. This guide explains what can usually be changed and what cannot, how to ask, how cancellations and refunds work, how to switch payment methods without paying twice, how to correct an address, what to do about orders you have already paid for and how to avoid needing changes in the first place. It follows our published [shipping policy](/shipping/) and [refund policy](/refunds/) and is written for adults aged 21 and over.

## What can usually be changed
Before payment is confirmed and the order is processed, we can often update flavors, strengths, pack sizes, quantities and shipping details. If you have not yet paid, changes are simple: we update the order, recalculate the total and send you fresh payment details so you pay the right amount once. If your order has been paid but is not yet processing, changes are still often possible, but we may need to adjust the total, and either collect or return the difference. Once an order is processing, changes get harder, because items may already be picked.

## What cannot be changed
After the package is handed to the carrier, we cannot change the address or the contents. At that point the parcel is in the carrier's hands and we have no control over its route. If the address was wrong, contact us straight away, because we may be able to ask the carrier for help, but we cannot promise a change. For in-transit issues, see [what to do if your package is delayed](/blog/what-to-do-if-your-package-is-delayed/).

## How to ask
Contact us right away with your order ID using the [contact page](/contact/), the support chat, WhatsApp or email. Tell us exactly what to change, for example "change item 2 from 12mg to 9mg" or "update the address to 123 Main St, Apt 4". Include the order ID, the name and email on the order and your phone number. We will reply to confirm. Do not assume a change is made until we confirm it in writing, and do not pay a new amount until we have sent updated details.

## Changing the items
- **Strength or pack size:** tell us the product and the option you want. We update the order and recalculate the price from our catalog.
- **Quantity:** tell us the new quantity. Remember that the minimum order is $100 and that free shipping applies at $200 or more after discount.
- **Adding an item:** possible if the order has not been processed. We will send updated details.
- **Removing an item:** possible before processing, as long as the order stays above the minimum.

If a change moves your order across a threshold, we explain the effect on the total before you pay. See [minimum order and free shipping explained](/blog/minimum-order-and-free-shipping-explained/).

## Cancelling
If payment has not been confirmed yet, we can usually cancel without issue. Tell us the order ID and that you want to cancel, and we confirm. If you paid, refunds follow our [refund policy](/refunds/), which includes a restocking fee in some cases and applies within 30 days of purchase. Cancelling before the order is processed is the simplest case, and we will explain what applies to your order. Refunds go back through the payment method the payment was received through, minus a 15% restocking fee where it applies. See [refund and return policy explained](/blog/refund-and-return-policy-explained/).

## Changing payment method
Switching between methods is simplest before we send payment details or before you pay. Contact us first so you do not pay twice. For example, if you chose Cash App and would rather use crypto to take the 10% discount, tell us before you pay, and we will update the order, recalculate the total and send the right details. If you have already paid by one method, switching is more complicated, and we will advise on the best way. See [payment methods compared](/blog/payment-methods-compared/).

## Fixing an address
Tell us the corrected address in writing and wait for confirmation. Include the full address with the apartment or suite number. Note that delivery needs an adult signature at that address, so make sure someone aged 21 or older can receive it. If the order has shipped, contact us immediately, and we will see whether the carrier can help. If the carrier returns the parcel because the address was wrong or no one could sign, we refund minus the 15% restocking fee and the shipping cost. See [shipping address tips](/blog/shipping-address-tips/).

## Orders you have already paid for
If you paid and want to change or cancel, contact us quickly, because processing starts once payment is confirmed. We will tell you what is possible. If the order is still waiting in the queue, changes are usually easy. If it has been processed, we will explain the options, which may include accepting the order and then using our returns process for eligible items. Opened or used e-liquid, devices and accessories cannot be returned, and Puffco products do not qualify for refunds or exchanges, so check before you buy those.

## Avoiding issues
Most changes are avoidable with a few habits:

- **Double-check your cart** before you submit: options, quantities and totals.
- **Double-check your address,** including the apartment number, and make sure an adult can sign.
- **Review your confirmation email** immediately after ordering, and tell us about mistakes straight away.
- **Choose the payment method you will actually use,** so you do not need to switch.
- **Read** [order status meanings](/blog/order-status-meanings/) so you know where your order is.

## Frequently asked questions in depth
### How long do I have to change an order?
There is no fixed window, but the earlier the better. Before payment is confirmed is easiest. Once the order is processing, changes get harder, and once the carrier has it, we cannot change it.

### Will changing my order delay it?
Small changes before processing usually do not. Larger changes may add a little time while we update the order and, if needed, new payment details.

### Can I cancel just one item?
Often yes before processing, as long as the order stays above the $100 minimum. After processing, our returns process applies to eligible items.

### What if I paid by crypto and want to cancel?
Contact us right away. Because crypto transfers are final, we explain how a refund is returned, in the coin used, less the 15% restocking fee where it applies.

### What if I do not get a reply?
Customer service hours are Monday to Friday, 8AM to 5PM Arizona time. Message again on WhatsApp or by phone, and include your order ID.

## Related reading
See [how ordering works](/blog/how-ordering-works/) and [how to contact support](/blog/how-to-contact-support/). Browse [vape juice](/shop/vape-juice/) and [disposable vapes](/shop/disposables/). All products are for adults aged 21 and over, and nicotine is addictive.

## Examples of changes and how we handle them
### Example 1: wrong strength, not yet paid
You ordered a 12mg bottle and meant 9mg, and you have not paid yet. You contact us with the order ID. We change the option, the price recalculates from the catalog, we send updated payment details if needed and you pay the new amount once.

### Example 2: wrong address, already paid, not yet processed
You notice a typo in your street number after paying. You contact us at once. We correct the address in writing, confirm back to you and mark the order, and it ships to the right place.

### Example 3: change of mind about the payment method
You chose Cash App and now prefer crypto for the discount. You tell us before paying. We switch the method, the total drops by 10% on the product subtotal, and we send the crypto payment window or the details you need.

### Example 4: the parcel has shipped, the address was wrong
You realize the apartment number was missing. You contact us immediately with the tracking number. We contact the carrier to see what is possible. If the carrier cannot help, the parcel may be returned, and a refund minus the 15% restocking fee and shipping cost applies.

### A final reminder
Contact us early, tell us exactly what to change and wait for our written confirmation. A clear message with your order ID, the change you want and your contact details gets the fastest result, and it protects you from paying twice or receiving the wrong items.

### Frequently asked questions in depth
**Do changes affect the 10% discount?** The discount applies to the product subtotal for the payment method you choose, so a change to the items changes the discount too. We show the new total before you pay.

**Can I add a gift card payment after ordering?** Please tell us before you pay and we will switch the method and send the buy and upload links.

**What if I change my mind after the parcel arrives?** Our returns policy applies: contact us within 30 days, and unopened items in original packaging can be returned, less a 15% restocking fee. Opened or used items cannot be returned.

**What if I cannot reach you quickly?** Message us on WhatsApp, use the support chat or call. The sooner we see your message, the more we can do.

title: What to Do If Your Package Is Delayed
summary: Late parcels happen. Follow this checklist to find out where yours is and when to contact us for help.
body:
A package that has not arrived when you expected it is stressful, especially when you are running low on a product you use every day. In most cases a delay has an ordinary explanation, and there is a clear sequence of checks that finds it. This guide walks through that sequence in the order that saves the most time: work out whether the parcel is actually late, read the tracking correctly, look for a delivery notice, confirm the address, contact the carrier and then contact us. It also explains what happens if a parcel is returned, lost, stolen or damaged, based on our published [shipping policy](/shipping/). It is written for adults aged 21 and over.

## 1. Check the timeline honestly
Delivery has two parts. First comes processing: 24 to 72 business hours after your payment is confirmed, during which we prepare and ship the order. Second comes carrier transit: our published estimates are about 3 to 7 business days for the West Coast (Arizona, Nevada, Washington and Idaho) and about 11 to 18 business days for the eastern half of the US. Business days are Monday to Friday, and weekends and federal holidays do not count. Add the two together and count forward from the day your payment was confirmed, not the day you placed the order.

Here is a worked example. You pay on a Monday. Processing runs until Wednesday or Thursday. If you live in the east, transit adds 11 to 18 business days, so delivery could fall in the third to fifth week. If you live in Arizona, delivery could fall the week after shipping. A parcel that is five business days into an eleven-day estimate is not late, however long it feels. See [shipping times from Phoenix, Arizona](/blog/shipping-times-from-phoenix-arizona/) for a fuller picture.

## 2. Look at tracking
Open your tracking email or your private order page. Our page tells you whether payment is confirmed and whether the order has shipped. The carrier's tracking page tells you where the parcel is. Updates can pause for several days in regional carrier networks, so a tracking history that has not moved for two or three days is not unusual. Look for the last event: label created, accepted, in transit, out for delivery, delivery attempted or delivered. Each tells you something different. See [how to track your order](/blog/how-to-track-your-order/) for what each event means.

## 3. Look for a delivery notice
Because an adult must sign for every delivery, carriers often leave a notice after a missed attempt. Check your door, your mailbox, your building's package area and your phone for a call or a text. If you find a notice, follow its instructions straight away: many carriers let you schedule a redelivery, choose a time window or collect the parcel from a depot with ID. If the carrier makes several unsuccessful attempts it may return the parcel, which can add weeks, so act quickly.

## 4. Confirm your address
Make sure the address on your order is correct, including apartment, suite and unit numbers and the ZIP code. A small error can send a parcel astray or make it undeliverable. Your confirmation email and your private order page show the address you submitted. If it is wrong, contact us immediately. We cannot change the address after the parcel is handed to the carrier, but the sooner we know, the more we can try. See [shipping address tips](/blog/shipping-address-tips/).

## 5. Contact the carrier
If tracking shows delivered but you do not have the parcel, call the carrier with your tracking number. Ask where and when it was delivered, who signed and whether a photo or signature is on file. Because signature is required, a delivered status should have a signature record. Check with neighbors, building staff and others at the address, because someone may have signed on your behalf where the carrier allows it. If the carrier cannot account for the parcel, tell us what you learned.

## 6. Contact us
If the estimated window has passed, email, message or call us with your order ID. Business contact options are on the [contact page](/contact/), and customer service hours are Monday to Friday, 8AM to 5PM Arizona time. Include your order ID, the tracking number, the carrier name, the date you expected delivery and what you have already checked. We will look at the order and the tracking, contact the carrier where that helps and tell you what we find. A short, complete message gets the quickest answer.

## What if the tracking never started?
A label that was created but never scanned means the carrier has not yet taken the parcel into its network. Sometimes that is a delay of a day or two. If it has been longer than that, tell us, and we will check with the carrier. It is not something you can fix at your end, but telling us promptly helps.

## Returned packages
If a carrier returns an undelivered package, for example because no one was available to sign, a refund is available minus the 15% restocking fee and the shipping cost, per the shipping policy. You will not lose the whole amount, but you will lose the fees, which is why it is worth planning for the signature. If you see a notice, arrange redelivery before the parcel is sent back. See [adult signature on delivery](/blog/adult-signature-on-delivery-what-to-expect/).

## Lost, stolen or damaged
Our shipping policy explains how these cases are handled, including package protection where it applies. If your parcel is lost or stolen, or you did not receive protection and want to discuss it, call or email us and we will explain what is possible. For damage, photograph the items and the invoice immediately and email our support team with the photos, as the policy says, and we will help you reorder damaged items. See [damaged or missing items](/blog/damaged-or-missing-items-what-to-do/).

## How to avoid delays next time
- **Order early.** Do not wait until you are almost out, especially in the east.
- **Pay promptly.** Processing starts when payment is confirmed.
- **Use an address where an adult will be.** A missed signature is the most common cause of delay.
- **Include every address detail.** Apartment numbers and ZIP codes matter.
- **Keep your phone on.** The carrier may call.
- **Watch for tracking updates** and any delivery notice.
- **Allow extra time around holidays.**

## Frequently asked questions in depth
### How long should I wait before contacting you?
If your order is inside the estimate for your region, give it time. If it is outside, contact us. If tracking shows an exception, such as a returned parcel, contact us straight away.

### Can you speed up a delayed parcel?
We cannot make a carrier move faster, but we can contact the carrier, check for problems and advise you. Sometimes a call from us is enough to find a stuck parcel.

### Can I get my money back if it is very late?
If a parcel is lost or returned, our policy describes the refund and replacement options. If it is simply slow, the estimates apply. Contact us and we will explain what applies to your order.

### Should I order again while I wait?
Please contact us first. Ordering again can lead to duplicate parcels, and we can usually tell you whether the first is likely to arrive.

### What if the address is in a remote area?
Delivery to remote areas can take longer, and some excluded territories are not covered by free shipping. Contact us if you are unsure. See [where we ship and where we do not](/blog/where-we-ship-and-where-we-do-not/).

## A checklist before you contact us
1. Counted processing plus transit from the day payment was confirmed.
2. Checked the carrier's tracking page and our order page.
3. Looked for a delivery notice and any missed-delivery messages.
4. Confirmed the address on your order.
5. Spoken to anyone else at the address.
6. Collected your order ID and tracking number.

With those in hand, we can usually resolve the question in one reply. Browse [disposable vapes](/shop/disposables/) and [vape juice](/shop/vape-juice/) when you are ready to order again. All products are for adults aged 21 and over, and nicotine is addictive.

## A short guide to talking to the carrier
Carriers deal with thousands of calls, and a prepared caller gets better results. Have your tracking number, the delivery address and the date you expected the parcel. Ask for the last scan location and time, whether a delivery was attempted, whether a signature was recorded and whether there is a hold or an exception on the parcel. Write down the name or reference number of the person you speak to. If the carrier says it will investigate, ask when you can expect an update, and share that with us so that we can follow up on our side too.

## Staying calm while you wait
Most delayed parcels do arrive. Long routes, regional networks and signature attempts explain the majority of delays, and a parcel that is slow is not the same as a parcel that is lost. If you are close to running out of a product, tell us, and we will talk through your options. Avoid placing a second order before we have checked, because you might end up with two parcels and a more complicated situation to sort out.

faq.a: Add our 24 to 72 business hours of processing to the carrier estimate for your region (3 to 7 business days West Coast, 11 to 18 eastern half), counting from payment confirmation and excluding weekends and holidays.

faq.q: What if tracking has not updated for days?
faq.a: Updates can pause for several days in regional carrier networks. Check the last event and compare with the estimate before worrying.

faq.q: What if it says delivered but I do not have it?
faq.a: Call the carrier with your tracking number, ask who signed, check with others at the address and then contact us.

faq.q: What happens if the carrier returns the parcel?
faq.a: A refund is available minus the 15% restocking fee and the shipping cost, per the shipping policy.

faq.q: Who should I contact first?
faq.a: Check tracking and the address, then contact the carrier if it says delivered, and contact us with your order ID if the estimate has passed.

faq.q: What if it arrives damaged?
faq.a: Photograph the items and invoice immediately and email us. We will help you reorder damaged items.

title: Damaged or Missing Items: What to Do Right Away
summary: If your parcel arrives damaged or something is missing, act quickly. Here is what photos to take and how to contact us.
body:
We pack every order carefully, but parcels pass through several hands before they reach you, and sometimes something goes wrong: a box is crushed, a bottle leaks, an item is missing or the wrong product is inside. When it happens, speed and evidence make all the difference. This guide explains exactly what to do in the first minutes, what to photograph, how to check the invoice, how to contact us, what we do next, what the policy covers and does not cover and how to reduce the risk of damage in the first place. It follows our published [shipping policy](/shipping/) and [refund policy](/refunds/) and is written for adults aged 21 and over.

## Take photos immediately
Before you do anything else, photograph the evidence. Take pictures of the outside of the box from several angles, including any damage or tears, the shipping label with your name, address and tracking number, the damaged items where they sit in the box and the invoice inside. Our shipping policy says to take a picture of the items and the invoice included in your package straight away, and to email our Customer Support Team with the pictures, so that we can reorder the damaged items for you. Keep the packaging, including the padding, until we have resolved the issue, because it shows how the parcel was packed and how it was handled.

### Good photos in practice
- **Use good light** and avoid glare on the box and bottles.
- **Show context.** One wide shot of the open box, then close-ups of each problem.
- **Include the label and the invoice** so the photos clearly belong to your order.
- **Do not clean up** before you photograph. Leaks and stains are evidence.
- **Take a short video** if a bottle is leaking, which can show the problem better than a still image.

## Check the invoice
Compare each item to the invoice. Tick off each product, option and quantity. For missing items, note exactly which products are absent, including the flavor, strength and pack size. For wrong items, note what you received and what you ordered. The invoice lists your order ID and the items, so it is the reference we both use. If you ordered several products, check each one, because a missing item is easy to overlook when the box looks full.

## Email us promptly
Send the photos and your order ID to our support email, or use the [contact page](/contact/). You can also message us on WhatsApp or call during business hours, Monday to Friday, 8AM to 5PM Arizona time, but email is best for photos. Tell us what you expected and what you found. A message that includes the order ID, the tracking number, the date of delivery, a clear description of the problem and the photos lets us act without asking follow-up questions. Contact us on the day you receive the parcel if you can, because prompt reports are easier to resolve.

### A message that works
"Order OSV-XXXXXX, delivered on [date]. The box arrived crushed on one side and two bottles of [product] are leaking. Photos attached: outside of the box, the label, the invoice and each bottle. I have kept the packaging."

## What we do
We review your photos and the order, then arrange a replacement or other resolution under our policies. Our shipping policy says we will reorder damaged items for you when you send photos of the items and the invoice. We may ask a follow-up question or ask you to keep the packaging for a short time. In a case of a missing item, we check how the order was packed and what the carrier reports, and we tell you what we will do. We aim to resolve problems quickly and fairly, and we explain the result clearly. See the [shipping policy](/shipping/) and [refund policy](/refunds/).

## Lost or stolen shipments
If your parcel never arrives or goes missing after delivery, call us at the number on our [contact page](/contact/) or email us. Our shipping policy describes how these cases are handled, including package protection where it applies, so we will check what applies to your order. Do not assume nothing can be done: tell us what happened, and we will explain your options. For late parcels, see [what to do if your package is delayed](/blog/what-to-do-if-your-package-is-delayed/).

## What is not covered
Opened or used items cannot be returned under our policy, so a product you have used and later find unsatisfactory is not covered by the damage process. Some product types, such as Puffco products, do not qualify for refunds or exchanges even if unopened, so check the [refund policy](/refunds/) before you buy. Damage that happens after delivery, such as a bottle you drop at home, is not damage in transit. And claims made long after delivery are harder to assess, which is why we ask you to report problems promptly.

## What about leaks?
E-liquid bottles can leak in transit if they are knocked, or if pressure changes affect them. We pack bottles sealed and upright where possible, with padding, but leaks can still happen. If a bottle has leaked, photograph it and the stained packaging, and handle it with care, wiping spills with paper towels and washing your hands. Keep the bottle away from children and pets. A leaking bottle should be reported as damage with photos, and we will tell you what to do with it.

## What about devices that do not work?
A device that arrives damaged is treated like any other damaged item. A device that appears undamaged but does not work is different: contact us with a description, and we will help you troubleshoot and tell you what applies. Our guides on [why a vape will not charge](/blog/vape-wont-charge-fixes/) and [why it is not hitting](/blog/why-is-my-vape-not-hitting/) may solve simple problems. Do not try to open or repair a device.

## Prevent damage
- **Choose accurate addresses** so parcels do not bounce around between facilities.
- **Be available for signature** so the parcel does not spend days in transit between attempts.
- **Open the parcel carefully** and photograph before you move anything.
- **Report promptly,** on the day you receive the parcel if possible.
- **Keep the packaging** until the matter is resolved.

## Frequently asked questions in depth
### How soon should I report damage?
As soon as you can, ideally the same day. Prompt reports are easier to verify and resolve.

### Do I have to send the damaged item back?
We will tell you if we need it. In many cases photos are enough, and we may ask you to dispose of a leaking product responsibly.

### Will I be charged for a replacement?
For items damaged in transit that you report with photos, our shipping policy says we reorder them for you. We will explain exactly what we are sending.

### What if only part of the order is damaged?
Tell us which items. We deal with the damaged items and the rest of the order stands.

### What if the box is fine but an item is missing?
Check the invoice, check all packing material and contact us with photos of the contents and the invoice.

## Related
See [how ordering works](/blog/how-ordering-works/), [order status meanings](/blog/order-status-meanings/) and [discreet packaging](/blog/discreet-packaging-what-to-expect/) for what a parcel looks like. Browse [vape juice](/shop/vape-juice/) and [disposable vapes](/shop/disposables/). All products are for adults aged 21 and over, and nicotine is addictive.

## Worked example: a crushed box and a leaking bottle
You receive a parcel with a dented corner and a damp patch. Before you do anything else, you take a photo of the outside, then another of the label. You open the box carefully and photograph the contents where they sit. One bottle has leaked onto the invoice. You photograph the bottle, the stain and the invoice, and you take a short video of the leak. You wipe the spill with paper towels, wash your hands and keep the bottle upright in a bag away from children and pets. You email us with your order ID, the tracking number, the date of delivery and the photos. We reply, confirm what we will do and ask you to keep the packaging for a few days. The whole process takes you about fifteen minutes, and because the evidence is clear, we can act at once.

## What you can expect from the outcome
Every case is different, but the aim is always to put things right. For items damaged in transit that you report with photos, our shipping policy says we reorder them for you. For missing items, we check the packing record and the carrier's information, and explain what we will do. For anything outside the policy, such as an opened item you have changed your mind about, we explain why it cannot be covered and what other options exist. We will always tell you plainly what we can and cannot do.

### Frequently asked questions about claims
**Can I report damage by phone only?** You can call us, but please follow up by email with photos, because photos are the evidence we need. A call is useful for explaining the situation and agreeing the next step.

**What if the carrier left the parcel in poor condition but the contents look fine?** Photograph the packaging anyway and check each item carefully. If everything works and nothing leaks, there may be nothing to claim, but keeping the photos costs nothing.

faq.q: What should I do first if something arrives damaged?
faq.a: Photograph the outside of the box, the label, the damaged items and the invoice immediately, and keep the packaging.

faq.q: How do I report it?
faq.a: Email the photos and your order ID to our support email or use the contact page. WhatsApp and phone also work in business hours.

faq.q: What will you do?
faq.a: We review your photos and the order, then arrange a replacement or other resolution under our policies. Our shipping policy says we reorder damaged items for you.

faq.q: What if an item is missing?
faq.a: Compare the invoice with the contents, note exactly what is absent and email us with photos and your order ID.

faq.q: What is not covered?
faq.a: Opened or used items cannot be returned, Puffco products do not qualify for refunds or exchanges, and damage after delivery is not transit damage.

faq.q: How soon should I report?
faq.a: As soon as possible, ideally on the day you receive the parcel.

title: Our Refund and Return Policy Explained in Plain English
summary: Returns are accepted within 30 days with some restrictions and a restocking fee. Here is what qualifies, what does not and how to start.
body:
Our refund and return policy is on its own page, and it is short and specific. This article explains it in plain English, with examples, so you know what to expect before you buy and what to do if you need to return something. If anything here differs from the [refund policy](/refunds/) page, the policy page applies. It is written for adults aged 21 and over, and it is general information about our own policy, not legal advice.

## The 30-day window
Returns and exchanges must be requested within 30 days of the purchase date. The clock starts on the day you purchased, not the day the parcel arrives, so with the longer carrier times in the east, do not wait. If you think you may want to return something, check it as soon as it arrives and contact us early. Requests made after 30 days cannot be accepted.

## How to start a return
Contact us before sending anything back so that we can issue an RMA form. RMA stands for return merchandise authorization, and it is the paper that ties your return to your order. Returns without an RMA cannot be guaranteed a refund or exchange. Use the [contact page](/contact/), email, WhatsApp or phone to begin. Tell us your order ID, which item you want to return and why. We will reply with instructions and the RMA form, and the mailing address for returns:

Attention: Returns, 4908 E McDowell Road STE 103, Phoenix, Arizona 85008.

## What a refund includes
After we receive the product, we issue your refund back through the same payment method the payment was received through, whether that is Cash App, Apple Pay, Chime, cryptocurrency or a gift card, minus a 15% restocking fee. Shipping fees are not refunded, and you are responsible for the cost of shipping the product back to us. We do not provide prepaid return labels, and we recommend adding insurance and tracking when you send it, because you are responsible until we receive it.

### A worked example
You buy two bottles at $12.00 each and a device at $40.00, a $64.00 product total, and pay by Chime with $15.00 shipping, $79.00 in all. You return the unopened device within 30 days. We issue a refund of the device price less 15%: $40.00 minus $6.00 is $34.00, returned through Chime. The $15.00 shipping is not refunded, and you paid to ship the device back. The bottles stay with you.

### How the discount affects a refund
If you paid by crypto or gift card, the 10% discount was applied to your product subtotal. A refund is calculated from what you actually paid for the returned item, so it already reflects the discount, less the 15% restocking fee.

## Exchanges
We are happy to exchange within 30 days of purchase. When the returned items are received, a customer service representative will call to clarify what you would like in exchange and place your order with you over the phone. You are only responsible for the remaining amount if the new item is worth more. A standard shipping fee applies to exchange orders where the order does not qualify for free shipping. Contact us first so we can send the RMA form.

## What we cannot accept
Because of FDA regulation and hygiene, some items cannot be returned:

- **Opened and used e-liquid.**
- **Opened and used devices and accessories.**
- **Products not purchased on onestopvapestore.com.**
- **Shipping fees,** which are not refundable.
- **Partially returned or opened sample packs and bundle deals.**
- **Puffco products,** which do not qualify for refunds or exchanges even if unopened.

If you are not sure whether an item qualifies, ask before you open it. Once opened, a product cannot be returned, and that includes testing a flavor, so decide carefully, especially on a larger bottle or a bundle.

## Returned by the carrier
If a carrier returns an undelivered package, for example because no one was available to sign, we process a refund minus the 15% restocking fee and the shipping cost, as described in the [shipping policy](/shipping/). That is a different situation from a customer return, and it does not need an RMA. To avoid it, plan for the signature. See [adult signature on delivery](/blog/adult-signature-on-delivery-what-to-expect/).

## Damaged, defective or wrong items
If your parcel arrives damaged or you receive the wrong item, do not follow the standard return route. Photograph the items and the invoice immediately and email us, and we will help you reorder damaged items, as described in the shipping policy. See [damaged or missing items](/blog/damaged-or-missing-items-what-to-do/). A product that arrives damaged is handled differently from one you simply decide you do not want.

## How long does a refund take?
After we receive your return, we check it, issue the refund and tell you. How long it takes to appear depends on the payment method: app payments are usually quick, crypto depends on the network and gift card refunds are handled as we explain at the time. Because crypto transfers are final, refunds are returned in the coin used, and we explain the details when we arrange it.

## Tips for a smooth return
- **Contact us early,** within the 30-day window, and wait for the RMA form.
- **Keep the original packaging** and the invoice.
- **Photograph the items** before you send them.
- **Add tracking and insurance** to your return parcel.
- **Put the RMA in the box.**
- **Keep the tracking number** until we confirm receipt.

## Frequently asked questions in depth
### Can I return something I opened by mistake?
Opened items cannot be returned. If you have a concern about a product, contact us before you open it, or tell us if it arrived damaged.

### Can I return part of an order?
Yes, eligible items can be returned individually within 30 days. Bundles and sample packs cannot be partially returned.

### Who pays for return shipping?
You do. We do not provide prepaid return labels.

### Will you refund the shipping I paid?
No. Shipping fees are not refunded, except in the carrier-returned case described above, where the shipping cost is deducted from the refund.

### Can I exchange instead of refunding?
Yes, within 30 days. A team member will call to arrange it.

### Why is there a restocking fee?
The fee covers the cost of handling, inspecting and restocking returned items. It is 15% of the refunded amount.

## Related
Read [how ordering works](/blog/how-ordering-works/), [how to change or cancel an order](/blog/how-to-change-or-cancel-an-order/) and [how to contact support](/blog/how-to-contact-support/). Browse [disposable vapes](/shop/disposables/) and [vape juice](/shop/vape-juice/). All products are for adults aged 21 and over, and nicotine is addictive.

## A step-by-step return from start to finish
1. **Check the window.** You are within 30 days of purchase.
2. **Check eligibility.** The item is unopened, in original packaging, bought from us and not a Puffco product or a partly returned bundle.
3. **Contact us.** Email or call with your order ID and the item you want to return, and say whether you want a refund or an exchange.
4. **Receive the RMA form.** We send it with the return address.
5. **Pack the item.** Use the original packaging, include the RMA form and the invoice, and add tracking and insurance.
6. **Ship it.** You pay the postage, and you keep the tracking number.
7. **We receive and check it.** We confirm that it is unopened and in good condition.
8. **We issue the refund or arrange the exchange.** A refund goes back through the original payment method, less the 15% restocking fee. An exchange is arranged by phone.

## Planning purchases with the policy in mind
If you are trying a new flavor or product, buy a size you are happy to keep, because opened items cannot be returned. If you are buying a device for the first time, read the product page carefully, check the strength and compatibility and ask us if you are unsure, because a question before you buy is much easier than a return afterward. And if you are buying Puffco products, remember that they do not qualify for refunds or exchanges.

## Frequently asked questions about specific situations
### I bought the wrong strength. Can I return it?
If it is unopened and in original packaging, within 30 days and not a Puffco product, yes, with an RMA and the 15% restocking fee, or exchange it for the strength you wanted. If it is opened, it cannot be returned.

### A device arrived and does not turn on. What now?
Contact us with a description and, if you can, a short video. Try the steps in our guides on [charging](/blog/vape-wont-charge-fixes/) and [troubleshooting](/blog/why-is-my-vape-not-hitting/). If it is defective on arrival, we will tell you what to do. Do not try to open the device.

### Can I return an item I bought for someone else?
Returns are handled with the original purchaser, because the refund goes back through the payment method used. If the recipient wants to return it, the purchaser should contact us.

### What if I paid with crypto and the price has changed?
Refunds are based on the dollar amount you paid for the returned item, less the restocking fee, and are returned in the coin used. The coin amount depends on the rate when the refund is made, and we explain how it is calculated when we arrange it.

### How do I know my return arrived?
Use tracking on your return parcel, and contact us if it shows delivered but we have not confirmed receipt. We will check our incoming returns.

title: How to Contact Support: Email, Phone and WhatsApp
summary: Reach our team by email, phone or WhatsApp. Here is the fastest way to get help and what to include so we can solve it first time.
body:
We offer several ways to reach our team, and each suits a different need. Some are best for quick questions, others for photos and written records, others for urgent problems. This guide explains each channel, when to use it, what to include in your message so we can help quickly, our customer service hours, what to check before you contact us and how to avoid scams that imitate support. It is written for adults aged 21 and over.

## Our hours
Customer service hours are Monday to Friday, 8AM to 5PM Arizona time. Messages sent outside those hours are answered on the next business day, and we do not process orders on weekends or federal holidays. Arizona does not observe daylight saving time, so during US summer the Arizona time matches Pacific time, and during winter it matches Mountain time. If you are in the east, remember the time difference when you plan a call.

## The support chat
On every page of the website, a chat button at the bottom right opens a support panel with quick answers to common questions and one-tap ways to contact us by WhatsApp, phone or email. If live chat is enabled, a Live chat button appears too. It is the fastest route to the right channel from wherever you are on the site.

## WhatsApp
Message us on WhatsApp for quick questions, order updates or to receive payment details in chat. Use the button on our website so that the message starts with your order reference. Our number is +1 774-734-1372. WhatsApp is convenient on a phone, and you can send photos and screenshots in the chat. For anything that needs a written record, such as damage or a refund, follow up by email as well. See [ordering via WhatsApp](/blog/ordering-via-whatsapp/).

## Email
Email is best for photos, receipts and anything that needs a written record. Our support address is sales@onestopvapestore.com. Include your order ID and a clear description. Attach photos or screenshots directly, and keep each message to one topic so it is easy to follow. Email is the right choice for damage reports, return requests, wholesale enquiries and anything you may want to refer to later.

## Phone
Call during business hours for urgent issues, at 774-734-1372. A call is useful when you need to talk something through, such as an exchange, a lost parcel or a payment problem. Have your order ID ready, and the email address you used. If you reach voicemail, leave your name, order ID and a good time to call back.

## The contact form
The form on the [contact page](/contact/) sends your message to our order dashboard and emails you a confirmation. Choose the subject that matches your query so it reaches the right person, and include your order ID in the message. It is a good route when you want a written record without opening your email app.

## What to include
A complete message gets a faster reply. Include:

- **Your order ID,** which starts with OSV-.
- **The email address and name** you used on the order.
- **A clear description** of the problem or question.
- **Photos** for damage or wrong items.
- **A screenshot** for payment questions.
- **The tracking number** for delivery questions.
- **What you would like us to do,** such as replace, refund, check or explain.

## How we respond
We aim to answer quickly during business hours, and we reply in the same channel where we can. If we need more information we will ask. If an issue needs investigation, such as a lost parcel, we tell you what we are doing and when to expect an update. We do not ask for passwords, PINs, card numbers, private keys or recovery phrases through any channel.

## Which channel for which problem?
- **Quick question about an order:** WhatsApp or the support chat.
- **Payment question or proof:** the private order page, then email or WhatsApp.
- **Damage or missing items:** email with photos.
- **Return or refund:** email or phone, and wait for the RMA.
- **Delayed parcel:** email or WhatsApp with the tracking number.
- **Wholesale pricing:** the [wholesale page](/wholesale/) or email.
- **Account, privacy or data requests:** email from the address on your order.

## Before you contact us
Many answers are in the [FAQ](/faq/), the [shipping policy](/shipping/) and the [refund policy](/refunds/). You can also read [order status meanings](/blog/order-status-meanings/), [how to track your order](/blog/how-to-track-your-order/) and [how payment details reach you](/blog/how-payment-details-reach-you/). Checking first can answer your question in a minute, and it helps us when you do write, because you can tell us what you have already tried.

## Avoiding scams
Scammers sometimes imitate stores' support channels. Use only the contact details on our website and in our official emails. We never ask you to pay to a personal number or account that we have not provided through your order, we never ask for codes or recovery phrases and we never pressure you to pay quickly or keep a payment secret. If a message looks suspicious, contact us through the [contact page](/contact/) to check it. See [gift card code security tips](/blog/gift-card-code-security-tips/) and [how payment details reach you](/blog/how-payment-details-reach-you/).

## Wholesale questions
Retailers can use the [wholesale page](/wholesale/) for volume pricing, and our [wholesale ordering guide](/blog/wholesale-ordering-guide/) explains how larger orders work.

## Frequently asked questions in depth
### Which channel is fastest?
During business hours, WhatsApp and the support chat are usually fastest for simple questions. Email is best for anything that needs photos or a record.

### Can I contact you at the weekend?
You can send a message at any time, and we answer on the next business day. Automatic crypto payments continue to be matched at weekends.

### Do I need an order ID?
It is not required to ask a general question, but for anything about an order it is the quickest way for us to find it.

### Can someone else contact you for me?
We can speak to the person named on the order. If someone else contacts us for you, they will need the order ID and the details on the order, and we may confirm with you directly.

### What if I forgot my order ID?
Give us the name, email and approximate time and amount of the order, and we will find it.

Browse [vape juice](/shop/vape-juice/) and [disposable vapes](/shop/disposables/). All products are for adults aged 21 and over, and nicotine is addictive.

## Tips for getting a fast, useful answer
### Write one message, not five
A single message with everything we need is quicker to handle than a series of short ones. Put your order ID in the first line, describe the problem in two or three sentences and say what you would like us to do. If you have photos, attach them to the same message.

### Be specific about timing
Tell us when you ordered, when you paid, when the order shipped and when you expected it. Specific dates let us check the right records and tell you what is happening.

### Keep the thread together
Reply to our message rather than starting a new one, so that the history stays in one place. If you contact us through a different channel about the same issue, mention the earlier message.

### Be patient with complex cases
Some issues, such as a lost parcel or a disputed payment, need investigation with a carrier or a payment provider. We tell you what we are doing and when to expect an update, and we will follow up with you.

## Examples of good messages
**A payment question:** "Order OSV-A1B2C3. I paid $195.00 by Chime at 3:20pm today and uploaded a screenshot at 3:25pm. Status still shows proof submitted. Can you confirm it was received?"

**A delivery question:** "Order OSV-A1B2C3, tracking 123456789. Shipped on the 4th, estimate for my region was 11 to 18 business days, and tracking has shown no movement for six days. Can you check with the carrier?"

**A return request:** "Order OSV-A1B2C3, bought on the 1st. I would like to return one unopened bottle of [product] in original packaging. Please send an RMA form."

**A wholesale enquiry:** "I run a vape shop in [state] and would like volume pricing on [brands]. My business details are below."

Each message states the order, the facts and the request, so we can reply without asking anything first.

## When something is urgent
If a problem cannot wait, call during business hours and explain that it is urgent. Examples include a parcel that is about to be returned, a payment that may be made to the wrong details or a suspected scam. Follow up with an email so that there is a written record. For emergencies of a medical nature, contact a doctor or the relevant emergency service, not us.

## Feedback and suggestions
If you have feedback about our service, a suggestion for the website or a compliment for a team member, tell us. We read every message, and practical suggestions, such as a missing guide or an unclear page, often lead to changes. Use the contact form or email and mark the message as feedback, so it reaches the right person. If you were unhappy with how a problem was handled, say so plainly, with the order ID, and we will review it and respond.

faq.a: The wholesale page, or email us for volume pricing.

title: Ordering via WhatsApp: How the Chat Option Works
summary: Prefer chat? Place your order on the site, and open WhatsApp to send your order summary. Here is how the two connect.
body:
You can place an order and message us on WhatsApp in the same step. It is still a full order on our website, not a separate chat-only process, which means it gets an order ID, a private status page and email confirmations just like any other order. WhatsApp is simply a convenient way to talk to us about it. This guide explains how the option works, why we save the order on the site, what to expect in the chat for each payment method, how to send screenshots, how to stay protected from scams and when WhatsApp is the best channel. It is written for adults aged 21 and over.

## How it works
At checkout, fill in your details, confirm you are 21 or older and choose your payment method. Then choose "Place order and message us on WhatsApp" instead of the standard place-order button. We save your order, send your confirmation email and open WhatsApp with a message that includes your order reference, the items, the total and the payment method. You send that message to us, and a team member replies. If WhatsApp does not open automatically, use the link on the confirmation page, or message us at +1 774-734-1372 with your order ID.

## Why we save it on the site
A saved order gets an ID, a private status page and an email confirmation. It also lets us send payment details, track proof of payment and keep a written record of what you ordered and what you paid. Chat messages alone can be lost or misread, and the saved order gives both of us a clear reference. It also means that the price is calculated by our server from the catalog, so the total in your message is exactly what we will charge.

## What to expect in chat
What we send depends on your payment method.

### Cash App, Apple Pay and Chime
We reply with the payment details, and a link to your private tap-to-copy page. You pay the exact amount, add your order ID in the note and upload a screenshot. See [how payment details reach you](/blog/how-payment-details-reach-you/) and the guides for [Cash App](/blog/cash-app-payments-guide/), [Apple Pay](/blog/apple-pay-payments-guide/) and [Chime](/blog/chime-payments-guide/).

### Gift cards
We reply with the buy link for your card and your private upload link. You buy the card, then upload the code and receipt. See [how gift card payment works](/blog/how-gift-card-payment-works/).

### Cryptocurrency
Crypto payments use the payment window on the site, which shows the amount, a QR code and the address. Chat is for questions. We never send crypto addresses in chat as a substitute for the window, and you should copy the address from the window, not from a message. See [how to pay with Bitcoin](/blog/how-to-pay-with-bitcoin/).

## Sending screenshots
You can upload proof on the private order page or send images in chat. The page is easier to track, so we recommend it, because uploads attach directly to your order. If you send images in chat, include your order ID in the message so we can match it. See [how to upload a payment screenshot](/blog/how-to-upload-a-payment-screenshot/).

## Staying protected
Only trust our official number listed on the [contact page](/contact/). We will never ask you to pay to a personal number or account that we have not already provided through your order, and we will never ask for card numbers, PINs, passwords, private keys or recovery phrases in chat. If someone messages you claiming to be from the store from a different number, do not pay and contact us through the website. If a message pressures you to pay urgently or keep a payment secret, stop. See [gift card code security tips](/blog/gift-card-code-security-tips/).

## When WhatsApp is the best channel
- **Quick questions** about an order, a product or a payment.
- **Receiving payment details** in a chat you can see on your phone.
- **Sending a photo** of a card or a receipt.
- **Checking on a parcel** with your order ID.

For anything that needs a formal record, such as a damage claim or a return, follow up by email as well. See [how to contact support](/blog/how-to-contact-support/).

## Good to know
You still need an email address, because confirmations, tracking and your private link go there. Delivery still needs an adult aged 21 or older to sign. The minimum order, the free-shipping rule, the 10% discount for crypto and gift cards and the returns policy are the same as for any order. See [how ordering works](/blog/how-ordering-works/).

## Hours and response
WhatsApp messages are answered during our customer service hours, Monday to Friday, 8AM to 5PM Arizona time. If you message us outside those hours, we reply on the next business day. Your order is saved on the site either way, and you can follow it from your private page. Automatic crypto payments continue to be matched outside business hours.

## Common problems
### WhatsApp does not open
Use the link on the confirmation page, or open WhatsApp yourself and message +1 774-734-1372 with your order ID. If you use a computer, WhatsApp Web works too.

### I closed the chat before sending
Your order is still saved. Message us with your order ID and we will continue from there.

### I sent the message from a different number
Tell us, and give us your order ID and the name and email on the order, so we can confirm it is you.

### I want to change the order
Tell us in the chat with your order ID. See [how to change or cancel an order](/blog/how-to-change-or-cancel-an-order/).

## Frequently asked questions in depth
### Is it cheaper to order through WhatsApp?
No. The price is the same, and the discount depends on your payment method, not the channel.

### Can I order entirely in chat without using the website?
We need the order to be placed on the website so that it can be priced and saved. Use the WhatsApp option at checkout, and we will take it from there.

### Can I pay inside WhatsApp?
No. Payment is made through the method you chose, for example your payment app or a crypto wallet, using the details we send.

### Will my chat be private?
WhatsApp messages are between you and us. Do not include sensitive items like passwords or recovery phrases, and only send gift card details through the private link.

Browse [disposable vapes](/shop/disposables/) and [vape juice](/shop/vape-juice/). All products are for adults aged 21 and over, and nicotine is addictive.

## A worked example of a WhatsApp order
You add products worth $230 to your cart and go to checkout. You enter your details, confirm you are 21 or older and choose Cash App. You tap "Place order and message us on WhatsApp". The order is saved with an ID such as OSV-A1B2C3, and WhatsApp opens with a message containing the reference, the items, the total of $230.00 and the method. You send it. A team member replies with the Cash App details and a link to your private payment page. You pay $230.00 with the order ID in the note, take a screenshot and upload it on the page. We confirm the payment, you receive an email, and the order moves into processing. If you had chosen crypto, the payment window would have given you the amount and address immediately, and the chat would have been for any questions.

## Why people like the WhatsApp option
Some customers prefer a conversation to a form, because they can ask a question about a product, a payment or a delivery right when they need to. Others like to see payment details in a chat on their phone, where copying and pasting is easy. Either way, the order itself lives on the site, so you get the benefits of both: a clear record and a human to talk to.

## Frequently asked questions about chat orders
### Can I pay for an order by sending money in WhatsApp?
No. Use only the payment method you chose at checkout, with the details we send from our official number and your private payment page.

### Can I change my order in the chat?
Yes, tell us what you want to change with your order ID, and wait for our confirmation. We update the order and send new details if the total changes.

### Can I place a second order in the same chat?
Yes, but each order needs its own order ID and payment. Please mention which order you are talking about in each message.

### Is there a difference for wholesale customers?
Wholesale customers can use WhatsApp too. Volume pricing is arranged through the [wholesale page](/wholesale/) or by messaging us, and we will confirm how to place the order.

### What if I need to speak to someone urgently?
Call us during business hours at 774-734-1372. WhatsApp is best for questions that can wait a little for a reply.

## Privacy in chat
Treat WhatsApp like any messaging app: only share what is needed for the order. Your order ID, the items and the payment method are fine. Your gift card details belong on the private upload page, not in a group chat or a forwarded message. Never share passwords, PINs, private keys or recovery phrases, and do not forward our payment details to others. If you want to stop a conversation, tell us, and we will continue by email.

faq.q: Is a WhatsApp order a real order?
faq.a: Yes. It is saved on our site with an ID, a private status page and an email confirmation, and the chat is a convenient way to talk to us about it.

faq.q: What do you send in chat?
faq.a: Payment details for Cash App, Apple Pay and Chime, and the buy link for gift cards. Crypto uses the payment window on the site.

faq.q: Can I send screenshots in chat?
faq.a: Yes, with your order ID, but uploading on the private order page is easier to track.

faq.q: Is the price different on WhatsApp?
faq.a: No. The price and discounts depend on your cart and payment method, not the channel.

faq.q: How do I know it is really you?
faq.a: Only trust the official number on our contact page. We never ask for passwords, PINs, recovery phrases or payments to personal numbers.

faq.q: When do you reply?
faq.a: During customer service hours, Monday to Friday, 8AM to 5PM Arizona time. Messages outside those hours are answered the next business day.

title: Order Confirmation Email Not Arriving? Try These Fixes
summary: If you did not receive our confirmation or payment email, check spam, spelling and filters first. Here is the full checklist.
body:
We send an email for every order, plus another with payment details where your method needs them, and later emails when payment is confirmed and when your order ships. If you have placed an order and the email has not arrived, do not worry: it is usually a simple filtering or typing problem, and there are clear checks to find it. This guide walks through the checks in the order that solves most cases fastest, explains why emails go missing, what to do for each type of email, how to protect future messages from being filtered and how to get what you need if the email never arrives. It is written for adults aged 21 and over.

## Which emails you should receive
It helps to know what to look for. After you place an order you should receive an order confirmation with your order ID, the items, the total and a private link to your order page. If you chose Cash App, Apple Pay, Chime or gift cards, you should also receive an email with payment details and a link to the private payment page. When payment is confirmed you receive a confirmation, and when the order ships you receive a tracking email. Emails come from our official address and always show your order ID. If you have received the first but not the second, see the section on payment-detail emails below.

## 1. Look in spam and promotions
Search your mailbox for the order ID or for "One Stop Vape Store". Check the spam or junk folder, and if you use Gmail, the Promotions and Updates tabs. If you find our message, mark it as not spam and move it to your inbox, so that future emails arrive normally. Mailbox filters sometimes treat a message from a new sender as suspicious, particularly when it contains links and a private code.

## 2. Check the address you entered
A single typo means the email goes elsewhere. Your order page, which you may still have open, shows what you submitted. Check the spelling of the domain, such as gmail.com, and the characters before the @. If it is wrong, contact us straight away with your order ID and the correct address. We will confirm your identity and resend the messages. Do not try to place the order again, because that creates a duplicate.

## 3. Wait a few minutes
Email delivery can lag, especially during busy periods or when your provider runs extra security checks. Wait ten minutes before assuming it did not send, and refresh your mailbox. If it has been much longer, move on to the next checks.

## 4. Check inbox filters and security gateways
Rules you or your employer have set can send messages to a folder or block them. Security gateways at work, school and some internet providers sometimes block commercial email or messages with links. Look at your filter rules and any blocked-sender lists. If you use a work or school address, try a personal email address for the order instead, and ask us to resend to it.

## 5. Add us to your contacts
Add our order email address to your contacts or trusted senders list. Many providers deliver messages from contacts to the inbox and are more cautious with unknown senders. After you add us, ask us to resend the email.

## 6. Use WhatsApp or the order page
If you placed an order via WhatsApp, we can send details there. Your confirmation page also has a private link that you can bookmark, so you do not depend on the email to reach your order. If you still have that page open, copy the link before you close it. The page shows the status, the amount due and payment instructions where relevant. See [how to track your order](/blog/how-to-track-your-order/).

## 7. Contact us
Reach us through the [contact page](/contact/) with your order ID, or with the time and amount of your order and the name you used. We can resend the confirmation, the payment details or the private link. Our customer service hours are Monday to Friday, 8AM to 5PM Arizona time. See [how to contact support](/blog/how-to-contact-support/).

## For payment-detail emails
These come after you order for Cash App, Apple Pay, Chime and gift cards. They are sent as soon as the order is saved, usually within minutes in business hours, but they can take longer outside those hours. If the first email arrived but the payment-detail email did not, check the same places, and then contact us. See [how payment details reach you](/blog/how-payment-details-reach-you/). Do not pay until you have received details from us, and never pay to details sent by anyone else.

## For tracking emails
A tracking email arrives after your order is processed and shipped. If your status shows shipped on your order page but you have no tracking email, check spam, and contact us with your order ID. We can resend the tracking number. See [shipping times from Phoenix, Arizona](/blog/shipping-times-from-phoenix-arizona/).

## Why emails go missing
- **Typos** in the address.
- **Spam filters** treating a new sender as suspicious.
- **Full inboxes** that cannot accept new messages.
- **Work or school gateways** that block commercial messages.
- **Forwarding rules** that send mail somewhere you do not look.
- **Provider delays** during busy periods.

Understanding the cause helps you fix it once, so that every future email arrives.

## How to protect future emails
Add our address to your contacts, mark our messages as not spam, avoid using a work address for personal orders and keep enough space in your mailbox. If you use several addresses, use the one you check most often. When you place an order, double-check the address you type.

## Frequently asked questions in depth
### Should I place the order again if the email did not arrive?
Please do not. A second order would be a duplicate. Contact us first, and we will find the first order and resend the email.

### Can you send the details to a different address?
Yes. Contact us from the address on the order, or give us the details of the order, and we will confirm your identity and update the address.

### I deleted the email by mistake.
Contact us with your order ID and we will resend it, or open your private order page if you saved the link.

### Why did I receive an email about an order I did not place?
Someone may have mistyped your address. Do not click links in messages you did not expect, and contact us with the order ID so we can sort it out.

## What we never ask for in email
We never ask for passwords, PINs, card numbers, private keys or recovery phrases. If an email claiming to be from us asks for them, do not respond, and tell us. See [gift card code security tips](/blog/gift-card-code-security-tips/).

## Related
Learn the usual timeline in [how ordering works](/blog/how-ordering-works/) and the meaning of each step in [order status meanings](/blog/order-status-meanings/). Browse [vape juice](/shop/vape-juice/) and [disposable vapes](/shop/disposables/). All products are for adults aged 21 and over, and nicotine is addictive.

## A worked example
You place an order at 2:15pm and choose Chime. By 2:30pm you have an order confirmation but not the payment details. You check spam and find nothing. You open the private order page from the confirmation email, and it says payment details will be sent. You wait ten minutes, then message us on WhatsApp with your order ID. A team member replies that the payment-detail email was sent and bounced because of a typo in an earlier attempt, resends it and also sends the details in chat. You pay, upload a screenshot and the order moves on. The delay was a few minutes, and the fix was simple, because you had your order ID and the private link.

## Keeping a backup
After any order, take a moment to save your order ID somewhere other than your email, such as a note on your phone, and bookmark the private order link. If an email goes missing, you can still reach your order, and we can find it in seconds. A backup costs nothing and saves worry.

## What to do if you do not use email much
If email is not your usual channel, tell us when you order and ask us to send details by WhatsApp. Your private order page also gives you everything you need to follow the order, and you can bookmark it on your phone. When you place the order, copy the order ID into your notes. With those two things, you do not depend on an inbox, and you can reach us quickly with the information we need.

## Mailboxes that are often problematic
Some free and regional email services filter more aggressively than others, and some corporate and school addresses block messages from senders they have not seen before. If you have had trouble receiving messages from online shops in the past, use a different address for your order, or add us to your contacts before you check out. A major webmail service with a strong spam filter that you check daily is usually the most reliable choice.
