- [Dragon Berries Geek Bar CLR 50K](/shop/disposables/dragon-berries-geek-bar-clr-50k/) — $18.99, 50,000 Puffs, 50mg (5%)
- [Sour Fcuking Fab Geek Bar Pulse 2](/shop/disposables/sour-fcuking-fab-geek-bar-pulse-2/) — $17.99, 50mg (5%)
- [Lemon Heads Geek Bar Pulse X 2 50K](/shop/disposables/lemon-heads-geek-bar-pulse-x-2-50k/) — $19.99, 50,000 Puffs, 50mg (5%)
- [Watermelon Crush Geek Bar Pulse X 2 50K](/shop/disposables/watermelon-crush-geek-bar-pulse-x-2-50k/) — $19.99, 50,000 Puffs, 50mg (5%)

## Flavor profiles in the Geek Bar range
Reading the product names across the Geek Bar catalog, the flavors group like this:

- **Berry:** 56 products. Berry flavors balance sweetness and tartness. Blue raspberry, strawberry and mixed-berry blends are among the most reliable crowd-pleasers in vaping.
- **Candy And Soda:** 34 products. Candy and soda flavors recreate confectionery and drinks, with a sweet-sour pop that stands out.
- **Cooling And Ice:** 32 products. Cooling flavors add a crisp, chilled edge. Instead of changing the fruit or dessert at the core of a recipe, they sharpen it, which is why so many fruit flavors ship in an “ice” version.
- **Citrus:** 22 products. Citrus flavors lead with acidity and brightness. They tend to feel light and refreshing, and they pair naturally with cooling notes.
- **Melon:** 22 products. Melon flavors are soft, watery and mellow, and they work well on their own or blended with berry and ice.
- **Tropical:** 21 products. Tropical flavors lean sweet and aromatic, with a rounder, juicier body than most orchard fruit.
- **Orchard And Stone Fruit:** 21 products. Orchard and stone fruits read familiar and balanced, with a gentle sweetness that suits all-day vaping.
- **Grape:** 9 products. Grape flavors are deep and jammy, often with a candy-like edge.
- **Dessert And Cream:** 4 products. Dessert flavors build a smooth, creamy body that feels mellow and rich.
- **Tobacco:** 1 products. Tobacco-style flavors recreate a traditional profile with a mellow, toasty depth.

Flavor is personal, and the same recipe can taste sweeter or sharper depending on your device and your own palate, so treat these groupings as a guide. If you are new to the brand, start with a flavor family you already enjoy, because it makes it easier to judge the product itself. Our [vape flavor profiles guide](/blog/vape-flavor-profiles-explained/) explains how these families work, and [how cooling ice flavors work](/blog/how-cooling-ice-flavors-work/) covers the most popular finish.

## How to choose a Geek Bar product
**Start with the puff count, but read it sensibly.** The number is the manufacturer's estimate, not a guarantee. Habits, draw length and temperature all change how long a device lasts, so use puff count to compare devices against each other rather than to predict an exact lifespan.

**Check the charging port.** Rechargeable models with a USB-C port can be topped up on a standard cable, which extends their useful life. Non-rechargeable models are lighter but finish when the battery does.

**Think about screens and airflow.** Some devices include a small display showing battery and e-liquid levels, and some offer adjustable airflow. Neither is essential, but both make a large-capacity device easier to live with.

**Compare cost per puff.** A higher price for a device with far more puffs can cost less per puff than a cheaper, smaller one. The section on value below shows the numbers for this brand.

## Strengths and options
Geek Bar products in our catalog are listed at 50mg (5%) and 0mg. Strength tells you how much nicotine a product contains, and it is the single most important number to read before you order. Higher is not better: pick the level that matches what you currently use, and remember that nicotine is addictive and products are for adults only. Our [nicotine strength guide](/blog/nicotine-strength-guide/) explains how mg and percentage figures relate.

Where a Geek Bar listing offers more than one strength or pack size, you choose it on the product page and the price updates to match.

## Value and pricing
Geek Bar products here range from $15.99 to $24.99, with an average of $20.79. As an example, Pink Lemonade Berry Geek Bar CLR 50K lists 50,000 Puffs at $18.99, which works out to about $0.38 per 1,000 puffs. Sour Mango Pineapple Geek Bar Pulse X 25k lists 25,000 Puffs at $17.99, or about $0.72 per 1,000 puffs. Treat these as comparison figures, because real-world puff counts vary with how you vape. Our guide to [comparing prices per puff](/blog/how-to-compare-vape-prices-per-puff/) shows the method in detail.

Buying more at once usually lowers the effective price, and orders of $200 or more after discounts ship free. Paying with cryptocurrency or a supported gift card saves a further 10%, which can make a bigger order noticeably cheaper. If you run a shop and need larger volumes, read our [guide to bulk buying](/blog/bulk-buying-vapes-save-money/) and the [wholesale ordering guide](/blog/wholesale-ordering-guide/).

## Using and caring for Geek Bar products
Charge rechargeable models on a hard, dry surface with a standard cable and unplug them when full. Keep the device upright and at room temperature, away from direct sun and hot cars. Take gentle draws instead of long, forceful ones to avoid a burnt taste, and never open or modify the device. When it is finished, take it to an electronics or battery recycling point where available.

Keep every device, bottle and pouch away from children and pets. When you are finished with a battery-powered device, follow our guide on [how to dispose of vapes and batteries](/blog/how-to-dispose-of-vapes-and-batteries/). If you ever doubt that a product is genuine, read [how to spot counterfeit vapes](/blog/how-to-spot-counterfeit-vapes/).

## A buyer's checklist for Geek Bar
Before you place an order, run through this short list. It takes a minute and prevents most of the problems customers contact us about:

- **Confirm you are buying the right type.** A disposable, a refillable pod, a bottle of e-liquid and a pouch are different products, even when the flavor name matches.
- **Read the strength.** Compare the milligram or percentage figure with what you currently use, and start lower if you are unsure.
- **Check the options on the page.** Where a listing offers strengths or pack sizes, choose them above the Add to Cart button so the price and your order match.
- **Look at capacity and size.** Puff count, bottle volume or pouches per can tell you how long a purchase should last.
- **Compare value, not just price.** A larger device, bottle or can often costs less per puff, milliliter or pouch.
- **Have an adult ready to sign.** Delivery requires a signature from someone aged 21 or older, so choose an address where that is possible.
- **Choose your payment method early.** Cryptocurrency and gift cards save 10%, while Cash App, Apple Pay and Chime are handled through your private order page.
- **Keep your order email.** It contains the private link to your order, your tracking updates and the payment page.

## Common mistakes to avoid
- **Buying the highest strength by default.** Higher numbers are not better, and a strength that is too high for you is the most common reason people are unhappy with a purchase.
- **Ignoring compatibility.** Pods, coils and accessories are specific to a device, so match the exact product name before you order spares.
- **Storing products in the heat.** Cars, windowsills and bags left in the sun shorten the life of batteries and degrade flavor.
- **Expecting identical results from every device.** Flavor and vapor vary with the hardware and how you draw, so judge a flavor over several uses before you decide.
- **Forgetting about delivery.** A missed signature delays a parcel, so plan around the carrier's tracking updates.

## Understanding the labels and specifications
Product pages and packaging use a small set of terms repeatedly. **Nicotine strength** is shown in milligrams per milliliter or as a percentage, and 50mg is the same as 5%. **Puff count** is the manufacturer's estimate of how many draws a device can provide, and real results vary with how you use it. **Capacity** describes the volume of e-liquid in a pod or bottle. **Pack size** tells you how many units come in a listing, such as a single device or a five-pack bundle.

Reading these four figures together lets you compare any two products fairly. If two listings look similar, the one with the lower price per puff, per milliliter or per pouch is usually the better value, provided the strength is one you are comfortable with. Our [guide to reading a product page](/blog/how-to-read-a-vape-product-page/) walks through a real example, and the [glossary of vape terms](/blog/vape-glossary-terms-a-to-z/) explains the less common words.

## Using nicotine products responsibly
Every product we sell is intended only for adults aged 21 and over, and nicotine is addictive. Keep products out of reach of children and pets, never share them with anyone underage, follow the manufacturer's instructions and use them only where it is lawful and considerate to do so. Laws on vapor products and flavors differ by state and city, and it is your responsibility to know the rules where you live. Our guides to [state and local vape laws](/blog/state-and-local-vape-laws-explained/), [what 21+ age verification means](/blog/what-21-plus-age-verification-means/) and the [FDA and vaping products](/blog/fda-and-vaping-products-what-adults-should-know/) are a good place to start.

Every order is placed on our secure checkout. Pick your options on the product page, add the items to your cart and choose a payment method: Cash App, Apple Pay, Chime, cryptocurrency or gift cards. Cryptocurrency and supported gift cards save 10% on your order total, which is explained in [how the crypto discount works](/blog/crypto-discount-how-it-works/) and [how gift card payment works](/blog/how-gift-card-payment-works/). You can compare every option in [payment methods compared](/blog/payment-methods-compared/).

The minimum order is $100, and orders of $200 or more after discounts ship free. Smaller orders pay a flat $15 shipping fee. We process orders within 24 to 72 business hours at our Stock Warehouse in Phoenix, Arizona, and ship with a regional carrier and a tracking number. Because these are vapor products, an adult aged 21 or older must sign for delivery under the PACT Act, so see [adult signature on delivery](/blog/adult-signature-on-delivery-what-to-expect/) and our [shipping times guide](/blog/shipping-times-from-phoenix-arizona/) before you order.

Returns are accepted within 30 days for unopened items in their original packaging, with a 15% restocking fee, and refunds go back through the payment method you used. Read the [refund and return policy explained](/blog/refund-and-return-policy-explained/) for the details. - **Citrus:** 1 products. Citrus flavors lead with acidity and brightness. They tend to feel light and refreshing, and they pair naturally with cooling notes.

Buying more at once usually lowers the effective price, and orders of $200 or more after discounts ship free. Paying with cryptocurrency or a supported gift card saves a further 10%, which can make a bigger order noticeably cheaper. If you run a shop and need larger volumes, read our [guide to bulk buying](/blog/bulk-buying-vapes-save-money/) and the [wholesale ordering guide](/blog/wholesale-ordering-guide/).

Use as directed on the packaging, take short puffs, keep the device upright and away from heat and do not open or modify it. Dispose of used devices at an electronics recycling point where available.

Keep every device, bottle and pouch away from children and pets. When you are finished with a battery-powered device, follow our guide on [how to dispose of vapes and batteries](/blog/how-to-dispose-of-vapes-and-batteries/). If you ever doubt that a product is genuine, read [how to spot counterfeit vapes](/blog/how-to-spot-counterfeit-vapes/).

Before you place an order, run through this short list. It takes a minute and prevents most of the problems customers contact us about:

- **Read the strength.** Compare the milligram or percentage figure with what you currently use, and start lower if you are unsure.
- **Check the options on the page.** Where a listing offers strengths or pack sizes, choose them above the Add to Cart button so the price and your order match.
- **Look at capacity and size.** Puff count, bottle volume or pouches per can tell you how long a purchase should last.

- **Candy And Soda:** 11 products. Candy and soda flavors recreate confectionery and drinks, with a sweet-sour pop that stands out.
- **Berry:** 10 products. Berry flavors balance sweetness and tartness. Blue raspberry, strawberry and mixed-berry blends are among the most reliable crowd-pleasers in vaping.
- **Orchard And Stone Fruit:** 6 products. Orchard and stone fruits read familiar and balanced, with a gentle sweetness that suits all-day vaping.
- **Tropical:** 5 products. Tropical flavors lean sweet and aromatic, with a rounder, juicier body than most orchard fruit.
- **Melon:** 4 products. Melon flavors are soft, watery and mellow, and they work well on their own or blended with berry and ice.
- **Citrus:** 3 products. Citrus flavors lead with acidity and brightness. They tend to feel light and refreshing, and they pair naturally with cooling notes.
- **Dessert And Cream:** 2 products. Dessert flavors build a smooth, creamy body that feels mellow and rich.

**Start with the puff count, but read it sensibly.** The number is the manufacturer's estimate, not a guarantee. Habits, draw length and temperature all change how long a device lasts, so use puff count to compare devices against each other rather than to predict an exact lifespan.

**Check the charging port.** Rechargeable models with a USB-C port can be topped up on a standard cable, which extends their useful life. Non-rechargeable models are lighter but finish when the battery does.

**Think about screens and airflow.** Some devices include a small display showing battery and e-liquid levels, and some offer adjustable airflow. Neither is essential, but both make a large-capacity device easier to live with.

Charge rechargeable models on a hard, dry surface with a standard cable and unplug them when full. Keep the device upright and at room temperature, away from direct sun and hot cars. Take gentle draws instead of long, forceful ones to avoid a burnt taste, and never open or modify the device. When it is finished, take it to an electronics or battery recycling point where available.

Keep every device, bottle and pouch away from children and pets. When you are finished with a battery-powered device, follow our guide on [how to dispose of vapes and batteries](/blog/how-to-dispose-of-vapes-and-batteries/). - **Candy And Soda:** 19 products. Candy and soda flavors recreate confectionery and drinks, with a sweet-sour pop that stands out.
- **Tropical:** 9 products. Tropical flavors lean sweet and aromatic, with a rounder, juicier body than most orchard fruit.
- **Orchard And Stone Fruit:** 9 products. Orchard and stone fruits read familiar and balanced, with a gentle sweetness that suits all-day vaping.
- **Tobacco:** 8 products. Tobacco-style flavors recreate a traditional profile with a mellow, toasty depth.

Charge rechargeable models on a hard, dry surface with a standard cable and unplug them when full. Keep the device upright and at room temperature, away from direct sun and hot cars. body:

## What ice tastes like in a vape
Ice versions add a cooling finish to a base flavor, usually fruit. The chill brightens sweet recipes and can make them feel fresher. Cooling flavors add a crisp, chilled edge. Instead of changing the fruit or dessert at the core of a recipe, they sharpen it, which is why so many fruit flavors ship in an “ice” version. Flavor is personal, so treat any description as a guide: the same recipe can taste sweeter, sharper or fuller depending on the device, how you draw and what you vaped before.

If you are choosing ice for the first time, try one product from a brand you already trust before stocking up, and compare two or three variations (plain, iced and blended) so you learn which style you prefer. Our [vape flavor profiles guide](/blog/vape-flavor-profiles-explained/) explains how the main flavor families work, and [best disposable vapes for flavor lovers](/blog/best-disposable-vapes-for-flavor-lovers/) is a good next read.

## How ice is blended
Reading the product names in our catalog, ice is most often combined with berry, orchard and stone fruit, tropical, melon and candy and soda notes:

- **Berry:** 149 products. Berry flavors balance sweetness and tartness. Blue raspberry, strawberry and mixed-berry blends are among the most reliable crowd-pleasers in vaping.
- **Orchard And Stone Fruit:** 99 products. Orchard and stone fruits read familiar and balanced, with a gentle sweetness that suits all-day vaping.
- **Tropical:** 83 products. Tropical flavors lean sweet and aromatic, with a rounder, juicier body than most orchard fruit.
- **Melon:** 58 products. Melon flavors are soft, watery and mellow, and they work well on their own or blended with berry and ice.
- **Candy And Soda:** 42 products. Candy and soda flavors recreate confectionery and drinks, with a sweet-sour pop that stands out.

Common name pairings you will see include fog ice, nicotine ice, stamp ice, mixpro ice and punch ice. Pairings like these are how makers keep a familiar flavor interesting: the second note changes the sweetness, acidity or finish without hiding the main flavor. ice also appears with a cooling finish, which is covered in [how cooling ice flavors work](/blog/how-cooling-ice-flavors-work/).

The same flavor can behave differently in each format. In a disposable, the flavor is fixed and consistent for the life of the device. Most ice products here are vape juice. E-liquid is the flavored liquid you add to a refillable device. You choose the bottle size, the nicotine type and strength, and the PG/VG balance, which gives you more control than a disposable and often a lower cost per milliliter.

Strawberry banana is a smoothie-style classic: sweet strawberry with creamy banana. We currently list **25 products** with strawberry banana in the name across 4 categories at One Stop Vape Store. This guide explains what strawberry banana tastes like in vapes, how it is usually blended, where to find it, which brands make it and how to choose the right product, using the live catalog so the numbers match the shop.

## What strawberry banana tastes like in a vape
Strawberry banana is a smoothie-style classic: sweet strawberry with creamy banana. Berry flavors balance sweetness and tartness. Blue raspberry, strawberry and mixed-berry blends are among the most reliable crowd-pleasers in vaping. Flavor is personal, so treat any description as a guide: the same recipe can taste sweeter, sharper or fuller depending on the device, how you draw and what you vaped before.

If you are choosing strawberry banana for the first time, try one product from a brand you already trust before stocking up, and compare two or three variations (plain, iced and blended) so you learn which style you prefer. Our [vape flavor profiles guide](/blog/vape-flavor-profiles-explained/) explains how the main flavor families work, and [best disposable vapes for flavor lovers](/blog/best-disposable-vapes-for-flavor-lovers/) is a good next read.

## How strawberry banana is blended
Reading the product names in our catalog, strawberry banana is most often combined with berry, tropical and cooling and ice notes:

- **Berry:** 25 products. Berry flavors balance sweetness and tartness. Blue raspberry, strawberry and mixed-berry blends are among the most reliable crowd-pleasers in vaping.
- **Tropical:** 25 products. Tropical flavors lean sweet and aromatic, with a rounder, juicier body than most orchard fruit.
- **Cooling And Ice:** 4 products. Cooling flavors add a crisp, chilled edge. Instead of changing the fruit or dessert at the core of a recipe, they sharpen it, which is why so many fruit flavors ship in an “ice” version.

Common name pairings you will see include geek strawberry banana, fruit strawberry banana, frozen strawberry banana, lost strawberry banana and ut strawberry banana. Pairings like these are how makers keep a familiar flavor interesting: the second note changes the sweetness, acidity or finish without hiding the main flavor. strawberry banana also appears with a cooling finish, which is covered in [how cooling ice flavors work](/blog/how-cooling-ice-flavors-work/).

## Where to find strawberry banana
- **Disposable Vapes:** 15 products, from $12.49 to $24.99. [Browse disposable vapes](/shop/disposables/).
- **Vape Juice:** 8 products, from $9.99 to $13.99. [Browse vape juice](/shop/vape-juice/).

- **Nixodine Devices:** 1 products, from $14.99 to $14.99. [Browse Nixodine devices](/shop/nixodine/).

The same flavor can behave differently in each format. In a disposable, the flavor is fixed and consistent for the life of the device. In an e-liquid, you control strength, bottle size and PG/VG ratio, so you can fine-tune how the flavor comes across. In a pouch, the flavor is released slowly through the lip. Choosing the format first, then the flavor, usually leads to a better result than the other way around.

## Choosing the right format for strawberry banana
Most strawberry banana products here are disposable vapes. Disposable vapes arrive pre-filled and pre-charged, so there is nothing to refill and no coil to replace. You use the device until the flavor or battery runs out, then dispose of it responsibly. The appeal is simplicity: no settings, no maintenance and no compatibility questions.

**Start with the puff count, but read it sensibly.** The number is the manufacturer's estimate, not a guarantee. Habits, draw length and temperature all change how long a device lasts, so use puff count to compare devices against each other rather than to predict an exact lifespan.

**Check the charging port.** Rechargeable models with a USB-C port can be topped up on a standard cable, which extends their useful life. Non-rechargeable models are lighter but finish when the battery does.

**Think about screens and airflow.** Some devices include a small display showing battery and e-liquid levels, and some offer adjustable airflow. Neither is essential, but both make a large-capacity device easier to live with.

**Compare cost per puff.** A higher price for a device with far more puffs can cost less per puff than a cheaper, smaller one. The section on value below shows the numbers for this brand.

## Keeping strawberry banana flavor fresh
Charge rechargeable models on a hard, dry surface with a standard cable and unplug them when full. Keep the device upright and at room temperature, away from direct sun and hot cars. Take gentle draws instead of long, forceful ones to avoid a burnt taste, and never open or modify the device. When it is finished, take it to an electronics or battery recycling point where available. Flavor fades with heat, light and a worn coil, so store products cool and dark, and if a favorite starts to taste flat, a fresh coil or pod usually fixes it. Our guide to [fixing faded vape flavor](/blog/vape-flavor-fading-fixes/) covers the common causes.

Rotating between two or three flavors can also keep strawberry banana tasting fresh, because your palate adapts to a flavor you vape constantly. Many adults keep strawberry banana as a main flavor and add a seasonal or contrasting flavor alongside it.

## A buyer's checklist for strawberry banana products
Before you place an order, run through this short list. It takes a minute and prevents most of the problems customers contact us about:

- **Confirm you are buying the right type.** A disposable, a refillable pod, a bottle of e-liquid and a pouch are different products, even when the flavor name matches.
- **Read the strength.** Compare the milligram or percentage figure with what you currently use, and start lower if you are unsure.
- **Check the options on the page.** Where a listing offers strengths or pack sizes, choose them above the Add to Cart button so the price and your order match.
- **Look at capacity and size.** Puff count, bottle volume or pouches per can tell you how long a purchase should last.
- **Compare value, not just price.** A larger device, bottle or can often costs less per puff, milliliter or pouch.
- **Have an adult ready to sign.** Delivery requires a signature from someone aged 21 or older, so choose an address where that is possible.
- **Choose your payment method early.** Cryptocurrency and gift cards save 10%, while Cash App, Apple Pay and Chime are handled through your private order page.
- **Keep your order email.** It contains the private link to your order, your tracking updates and the payment page.

## Common mistakes to avoid
- **Buying the highest strength by default.** Higher numbers are not better, and a strength that is too high for you is the most common reason people are unhappy with a purchase.
- **Ignoring compatibility.** Pods, coils and accessories are specific to a device, so match the exact product name before you order spares.
- **Storing products in the heat.** Cars, windowsills and bags left in the sun shorten the life of batteries and degrade flavor.
- **Expecting identical results from every device.** Flavor and vapor vary with the hardware and how you draw, so judge a flavor over several uses before you decide.
- **Forgetting about delivery.** A missed signature delays a parcel, so plan around the carrier's tracking updates.

## Understanding the labels and specifications
Product pages and packaging use a small set of terms repeatedly. **Nicotine strength** is shown in milligrams per milliliter or as a percentage, and 50mg is the same as 5%. **Puff count** is the manufacturer's estimate of how many draws a device can provide, and real results vary with how you use it. **Capacity** describes the volume of e-liquid in a pod or bottle. **Pack size** tells you how many units come in a listing, such as a single device or a five-pack bundle.

Reading these four figures together lets you compare any two products fairly. If two listings look similar, the one with the lower price per puff, per milliliter or per pouch is usually the better value, provided the strength is one you are comfortable with. Our [guide to reading a product page](/blog/how-to-read-a-vape-product-page/) walks through a real example, and the [glossary of vape terms](/blog/vape-glossary-terms-a-to-z/) explains the less common words.

title: Crypto Payment FAQ: Fast Answers Before You Pay
summary: Which coins, which networks, how long it takes and what to do if something goes wrong. Quick answers about paying with crypto.
body:
This page collects the questions we hear most about paying with cryptocurrency at One Stop Vape Store, with short answers and links to the full guides. Whether you already hold crypto or are thinking about using it for the first time, you will find the coins we accept, how the 10% discount works, how to choose a network, how payments are detected, what fees to expect, what to do if something goes wrong and how it compares with other methods. It is written for adults aged 21 and over and is not financial advice.

## Which coins do you accept?
We accept Bitcoin (BTC), USDT on Ethereum (ERC20) and Tron (TRC20), USDC on Solana, Ethereum (ETH), BNB on BNB Smart Chain (BEP20) and Solana (SOL). Each has its own guide: [Bitcoin](/blog/how-to-pay-with-bitcoin/), [USDT](/blog/usdt-erc20-vs-trc20-which-network/), [USDC on Solana](/blog/pay-with-usdc-on-solana/), [Ethereum](/blog/pay-with-ethereum-eth/), [BNB](/blog/pay-with-bnb-smart-chain/) and [Solana](/blog/pay-with-solana-sol/).

## Is there a discount?
Yes, 10% off the product subtotal when you pay with cryptocurrency or a supported gift card. It is applied automatically at checkout. Shipping is added after the discount, and free shipping applies to orders of $200 or more after the discount. See [how the discount works](/blog/crypto-discount-how-it-works/) for worked examples, including how the discount can bring a cart below the free-shipping line.

## Where do I find the address?
In the payment window after you choose Cryptocurrency at checkout. It shows your order reference, the amount in your chosen coin, a QR code, the address and copy buttons. See [scanning the QR code and copying the address](/blog/scan-wallet-qr-code-and-copy-address/). Never type the address by hand.

## How is the amount calculated?
Your order is priced in US dollars. The window converts your dollar total, after the discount, into the coin you chose at the live rate. The rate refreshes about every 30 seconds, so the coin amount can change slightly while the dollar value stays the same. For stablecoins like USDT and USDC the amount is essentially the dollar total. If the window has been open a while, refresh it and use the new amount.

## Which network should I choose?
The one shown in the window. The network is the blockchain that carries the transfer, and an address on one network is not valid on another. Read [what is a crypto network](/blog/what-is-a-crypto-network/) for a plain-language explanation, and [USDT on ERC20 or TRC20](/blog/usdt-erc20-vs-trc20-which-network/) if you are choosing between two networks for USDT.

## How is my payment detected?
Automatically on most networks. After you press "I have paid", our system reads public blockchain data for the shop wallet and looks for a transfer that fits your order: the right network and address, the right token, a dollar value close to your total, a recent time and a transaction that has not paid another order. BNB payments are confirmed by our team after you upload a screenshot. See [how we detect your crypto payment](/blog/how-we-detect-your-crypto-payment/).

## How long does it take?
Solana and Tron usually confirm within seconds to a couple of minutes. Ethereum and BNB Smart Chain usually take a few minutes. Bitcoin is usually visible within a minute or two and final after a block, often around ten minutes. After payment is confirmed, the order enters processing, which takes 24 to 72 business hours before it ships.

## I do not own crypto. What now?
You can buy it with a card or bank transfer from a provider such as MoonPay, Coinbase, Transak or Changelly, and send it to the address in our window. See [how to buy crypto with a card](/blog/how-to-buy-crypto-with-a-card/). Compare the provider's fees with the 10% saving first. A supported gift card also earns the discount without any crypto; see [how gift card payment works](/blog/how-gift-card-payment-works/).

## Can I pay from an exchange?
Yes, as long as the exchange allows withdrawals to external addresses. Choose the right network, paste the address, add the withdrawal fee on top if it is deducted from the amount and keep the transaction ID. See [sending crypto from an exchange to a wallet](/blog/send-crypto-from-an-exchange-to-a-wallet/).

## Do I pay network fees?
Yes, to the network, not to us. We charge nothing extra for crypto. Fees vary by network: Solana is a fraction of a cent, Tron and BNB Smart Chain are cheap, Bitcoin and Ethereum vary with demand. See [crypto network fees explained](/blog/crypto-network-fees-explained/).

## What if I used the wrong network?
Stop, do not send more funds and contact us right away with your order reference and the transaction hash. We will tell you honestly whether anything can be done. See [what to do after sending crypto on the wrong network](/blog/sent-crypto-on-the-wrong-network/).

## What if the payment looks short?
An underpaid status means we found a transfer smaller than your total. Send the missing balance to the same address and network, and add the transaction hash. See [why your crypto payment shows underpaid](/blog/why-your-crypto-payment-shows-underpaid/).

## Do I need to upload a screenshot?
Usually not for crypto, but a transaction hash and screenshot help when a manual check is needed. See [how to upload a payment screenshot](/blog/how-to-upload-a-payment-screenshot/).

## Do you ever ask for my private key or recovery phrase?
Never. We use only public blockchain data to match payments. Do not share private keys, seed phrases or two-factor codes with anyone, including anyone claiming to be from us.

## Can I get a refund?
If a refund is ever due, it goes back through the payment method the payment was received through, less the 15% restocking fee where it applies. Returns are accepted within 30 days for unopened items in original packaging, and opened or used items cannot be returned. See [refund and return policy explained](/blog/refund-and-return-policy-explained/). Because crypto transfers are final, refunds are returned in the coin used, and we will explain the details.

## Can I pay in two parts?
Please send a single transaction for the full amount if you can. If you need to split a payment, contact us before you send so we can note it against your order and match both transfers.

## Which coin is best for a small order?
Solana, Tron and BNB Smart Chain usually have the lowest fees, which leaves most of the discount intact. A stablecoin avoids price movement. For a larger order, any supported coin is fine. See [payment methods compared](/blog/payment-methods-compared/).

## Which coin is best if I want an exact amount?
A stablecoin such as USDT or USDC, because the amount equals your dollar total. Volatile coins such as Bitcoin, Ethereum, BNB and Solana can move between the quote and the payment, which is why a small tolerance exists.

## What do I do after my payment is confirmed?
Nothing. You receive an email, and your order status changes to payment confirmed. We process orders within 24 to 72 business hours at our Phoenix, Arizona Stock Warehouse and ship with tracking by a regional carrier. An adult aged 21 or older must sign on delivery. See [shipping times from Phoenix, Arizona](/blog/shipping-times-from-phoenix-arizona/) and [adult signature on delivery](/blog/adult-signature-on-delivery-what-to-expect/).

## Who can I ask for help?
Use the [contact page](/contact/), message us on WhatsApp, call or email. Customer service hours are Monday to Friday, 8AM to 5PM Arizona time. Include your order reference and, if relevant, the transaction hash.

## Where can I read more?
Browse the full set of payment guides in [payment methods compared](/blog/payment-methods-compared/), and start shopping with our [disposable vapes](/shop/disposables/) and [vape juice](/shop/vape-juice/). All products are for adults aged 21 and over, and nicotine is addictive.

## A short glossary
- **Wallet:** an app or device that holds your keys and lets you send and receive crypto.
- **Exchange:** a platform where you can buy, sell and hold crypto, and often withdraw it to a wallet.
- **Address:** where a payment is sent, like an account number for one network.
- **Network:** the blockchain that carries a transfer, such as Bitcoin, Ethereum, Tron, Solana or BNB Smart Chain.
- **Transaction hash:** a unique code for a transfer, also called a transaction ID or TXID.
- **Gas or network fee:** the cost of processing a transaction, paid to the network.
- **Stablecoin:** a coin designed to track the US dollar, such as USDT or USDC.
- **Confirmation:** a block added to the chain that includes your transaction.

If any of these terms is new, read [what is a crypto network](/blog/what-is-a-crypto-network/) and [crypto network fees explained](/blog/crypto-network-fees-explained/) before you pay. Taking a few minutes to learn the vocabulary makes the payment window much easier to follow.

## A final word before you pay
Crypto payments are straightforward when you follow the steps: choose the coin and network, copy the address, send the exact amount with any fees on top and press the button. Most problems come from one of three habits: choosing the wrong network, typing an address by hand or forgetting an exchange fee. Avoid those three, and your payment will almost always match on the first try. If you ever feel unsure, pause and contact us before you send. A short message costs nothing, and it can save a lot of trouble.

## Quick answers on timing
**How soon should I pay after placing the order?** As soon as you can, ideally within 24 hours, because unpaid orders may be released. **How soon will my order ship?** Orders enter processing once payment is confirmed, which takes 24 to 72 business hours before shipping. **What if I pay at the weekend?** Automatic networks still match your payment, and processing continues on the next business day. **What if I need the order urgently?** Tell us when you place it, and we will advise on the quickest route.

faq.q: How is my payment matched to my order?
faq.a: Automatically on most networks, by reading public blockchain data. BNB payments are confirmed by our team after you upload a screenshot.

faq.q: Do I pay a fee for crypto?
faq.a: Not to us. You pay the network fee to the network, and any exchange fee to your platform.

faq.q: What if I send on the wrong network?
faq.a: Stop, do not resend, and contact us with your order reference and transaction hash. We cannot promise recovery.

faq.q: Do you ever ask for my private keys?
faq.a: Never. We use only public blockchain data. Do not share private keys, seed phrases or two-factor codes with anyone.

title: How to Use Your Private Order and Payment Page
summary: Your order link opens a private page with payment details, tap-to-copy fields and a receipt uploader. Here is what each part does.
body:
After you order, a private page tracks everything about your order. It needs no account and no password, only the link in your email. On it you can see your order ID, the amount due, the current status, the payment details for your method, an upload box for proof and a WhatsApp button. It is the single place to follow an order from payment to delivery. This guide walks through every part of the page, explains what each section is for, how to use the copy buttons and the upload box on a phone, what to do if the page does not open, how it keeps your order private and how it connects with your emails. It is written for adults aged 21 and over.

## Opening the page
Use the link in your confirmation or payment email. The link includes a unique token, so keep it to yourself: anyone with the link can view the order. You do not need to sign in or create an account. Bookmark the page on your phone or computer, or keep the email, so that you can return at any time. If you placed the order through WhatsApp, the link is also in your confirmation email.

## The summary
At the top you see your order ID, the amount due and the current status. The order ID, such as OSV-XXXXXX, is the reference you give us in any message. The amount due shows the total after any discount and including shipping. The status shows where the order is: awaiting payment, payment details sent, proof submitted, payment detected, payment confirmed, shipped or cancelled. See [order status meanings](/blog/order-status-meanings/) for what each means and what to do.

## The items and totals
Below the summary you can see the items you ordered, with the option you chose, such as strength or pack size, the quantity and the line price. The totals show the subtotal, any discount for crypto or gift cards, shipping and the total. Check these against what you expected. If anything is wrong, contact us straight away, before you pay. See [how to change or cancel an order](/blog/how-to-change-or-cancel-an-order/).

## Payment details
The page shows payment details according to the method you chose.

### Cash App, Apple Pay and Chime
Each detail appears in its own box with a tap-to-copy button. Tap the button, switch to your payment app and paste. You will see the amount to pay and the note to include, which is your order ID. Pay the exact amount. See the guides for [Cash App](/blog/cash-app-payments-guide/), [Apple Pay](/blog/apple-pay-payments-guide/) and [Chime](/blog/chime-payments-guide/).

### Cryptocurrency
You see the wallet address, the network, the amount and a QR code, plus an automatic status checker that tells you when a payment is detected and confirmed. Copy the address with the copy button, and check the network before you send. See [how to pay with Bitcoin](/blog/how-to-pay-with-bitcoin/) and [how we detect your crypto payment](/blog/how-we-detect-your-crypto-payment/).

### Gift cards
You see the buy link for your card and the steps to follow, with an upload box for the code and receipt. See [how gift card payment works](/blog/how-gift-card-payment-works/).

## Uploading proof
Use the upload box to add screenshots, receipt photos or gift card photos. You can add up to four images, and they are compressed on your device before they are sent, so large photos upload quickly. You can add a transaction hash or a card code and a note. Wait for the confirmation that the upload succeeded before you close the page. See [how to upload a payment screenshot](/blog/how-to-upload-a-payment-screenshot/) for tips on clear images.

## The WhatsApp link
A button opens WhatsApp with a message about your order if you prefer chat. The message includes your order reference, so that we find the order immediately. Use it for questions, and use the upload box for proof. See [ordering via WhatsApp](/blog/ordering-via-whatsapp/).

## Tracking
After your order ships, the page shows that it has shipped, and the tracking email has the carrier and number. Use the carrier's page for the latest movement. See [how to track your order](/blog/how-to-track-your-order/).

## If the page says "not found"
The link may be incomplete. Copy the whole link from the email, including the part after the question mark, because the token is what opens the page. Some email programs break long links across lines, so try copying it again, or open it from a different device. If it still does not work, contact us through the [contact page](/contact/) with your order ID, and we will send a fresh link.

## If the page looks out of date
Refresh the page. Statuses change as events happen, and the page shows the latest. If it still looks wrong, for example you paid but it says awaiting payment, wait a few minutes and check again, then contact us if it has not changed. Some payments are confirmed by a person, which takes longer outside business hours.

## Using the page on a phone
The page works on any phone. Use the copy buttons to paste into your payment app, switch back to the page to upload proof and use the screenshot function on your phone to capture the confirmation. If you use two devices, you can open the link on both, as long as you keep it private.

## Privacy
Do not share the link. Only people with it can view the order, and it shows your items, your totals and your payment status. If you think someone else has seen it, contact us. Read about [privacy](/blog/why-we-need-your-email-and-phone/) and see our [privacy policy](/privacy/). We never ask for passwords, PINs, private keys or recovery phrases on the page or anywhere else.

## Frequently asked questions in depth
### How long does the link work?
It works for as long as the order exists in our records, so you can return to it for tracking and questions. If it stops working, we can send a fresh link.

### Can I change my order from the page?
The page is for following and paying. To change an order, contact us with your order ID.

### Does the page show my full address?
It shows what you need to confirm the order. Your delivery details are stored with the order and used for shipping.

### Is the page secure on public Wi-Fi?
The site uses HTTPS. As a general habit, avoid entering sensitive information on networks you do not trust, and do not share the link.

### What if I have two orders?
Each order has its own page and link. Use the right link for the right order, and quote the order ID when you contact us.

## Related
Start with [how ordering works](/blog/how-ordering-works/) and [how payment details reach you](/blog/how-payment-details-reach-you/). Browse [vape juice](/shop/vape-juice/) and [disposable vapes](/shop/disposables/). All products are for adults aged 21 and over, and nicotine is addictive.

## Walkthrough: a Cash App order from the page
You open the private link from your email on your phone. The summary shows OSV-A1B2C3, the amount of $195.00 and the status payment details sent. You scroll to the payment details. The $Cashtag has a copy button, so you tap it. You switch to the Cash App, paste the handle, enter 195.00 and type your order ID in the note. You confirm and take a screenshot of the receipt. You return to the page, tap the upload box, choose the screenshot, add a short note saying the payment was sent at 3:20pm and tap send. The page confirms the upload and the status changes to proof submitted. A few minutes later, we confirm the payment, you receive an email and the status becomes payment confirmed.

## Walkthrough: a crypto order from the page
You choose USDT on Tron at checkout, and the page shows the address, the network and the amount. You copy the address, check the network label and open your wallet. You paste the address, enter the amount and confirm. Back on the page, the status checker shows payment sent, then detected and then confirmed. You do not have to upload anything unless we ask. If the status stays on waiting, you add the transaction hash in the upload box and contact us.

## Troubleshooting the upload box
If the upload box will not accept an image, check the file type, because common image formats work best, and check the size. Try a screenshot instead of a photo, or crop it. If it still fails, switch network between Wi-Fi and mobile data, and try again. If nothing works, email the image to us from the address on your order with your order ID, and we will attach it to the order.

## Frequently asked questions about using the page
### Why does the status not change when I pay?
Some statuses change automatically, such as a crypto payment being detected, while others are updated by a person after a check, such as an app or gift card payment. Upload your proof, and allow time in business hours.

### Can I use the page after the order is delivered?
Yes. It remains a record of your order, with the items, totals and status. If it stops working, we can send a fresh link.

### Does the page work in any browser?
Yes, on any modern browser on a phone, tablet or computer. If something does not display correctly, try refreshing or opening the link in another browser.

faq.q: Do I need an account to use the order page?
faq.a: No. The page needs only the private link in your email, which contains a unique token.

faq.q: What can I do on the page?
faq.a: See your order ID, items, totals and status, copy payment details, view crypto payment status, upload proof and open WhatsApp.

faq.q: How do I upload proof?
faq.a: Use the upload box to add up to four images, plus a transaction hash or card code and a note. Wait for the success message.

faq.q: What if the page says not found?
faq.a: Copy the whole link from the email, including the part after the question mark. If it still fails, contact us for a fresh link.

faq.q: Is the link private?
faq.a: Only people with the link can view the order, so do not share it.

faq.q: Can I change my order from the page?
faq.a: No. Contact us with your order ID to change or cancel an order.
